Sub ASNGonder()
	Set STOK60E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60E")
	Set STOK60T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60T")
	Set MTable=Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
	KullaniciAdi = trim(MTable.F1)
	KullaniciSifre = trim(MTable.F2)
	Doc.RUN_APP_CANCEL

	if trim(KullaniciAdi) = "" or trim(KullaniciSifre) = "" Then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Kullanýcý adý ve þifre girmelisiniz." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	End if
	if Trim(STOK60E.XNITELIK0) = "ASN_OK" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Bu irsaliyenin ASN 'si daha önce gönderilmiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	SeferNumarasi = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"SEFER_NO",0)
	if trim(SeferNumarasi) = "" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Kullanýcý tanýmlý alanlarda sefer numarasý girilmemiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	PlakaNo = STOK60E.BOX1_3
	if trim(PlakaNo) = "" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Plaka Numarasý girilmemiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo", MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
'	if trim(STOK60E.EXTERNALEVRAKNO) = "" Then
'		k = doc.d7msgbox("Ýrsaliye numarasýný girmediniz." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo",MB_OK)
'		exit sub
'	End if

	SevkAdresKodu = STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
	Select case trim(SevkAdresKodu)
		case "D1D4T" 				'ÝNÖNÜ KAMYON
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4T"
		case "D1D4T-FR" 				'ÝNÖNÜ KAMYON FRP ATELYESÝ
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4T"
		case "D1D4H" 				'ÝNÖNÜ MOTOR
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4H"
		case "D1D4F"	 				'GÖLCÜK
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4F"
'		case "ARKOTO"	 				'GÖLCÜK
'			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4F"
		case "DBPAA"	 				'ARKOTO
			FabrikaKodu = "DBPAA"
		case "AUF9A"					'KARTAL YP DEPO
			FabrikaKodu = "AUF9A"
		case "CVR1B"					'KARTAL YP DEPO
			FabrikaKodu = "CVR1B"
		case "D1D4Y" 				'KOCAELÝ YEDEK PARÇA
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4Y"
		case else
			k = Doc.d7msgbox("Sevk adresi girilmemiþ veya tanýmsýz" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
			exit sub
	End Select
	if not AmbalajVarmi then
		EH = Doc.d7msgbox("Hiç konteyner gönderilmemektedir" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Onaylýyor musunuz.", "dinamo",MB_YESNO)
		if EH <> 6 then 
			k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
			exit sub
		end if
	End if
	KodDurumu = KodKontrol
	if trim(KodDurumu) <> "" then
		msgbox KodDurumu
		k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	SandikDurumu = SandikAdediKontrol
	if trim(SandikDurumu) <> "" then
		msgbox SandikDurumu
		k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	
	Doc.CreateTableObject "ZZZ=STOK60T","TMPCOPY"		
	Set S60 = Doc.GetTableObject("ZZZ")
	Set ST60 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60T")
	S60.CopyTable(ST60)
	S60.GroupBy("KOD")

	Set Fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	ASNFolder = trim(Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm) & "abdat"
	if not fso.FolderExists(ASNFolder) Then
		fso.CreateFolder ASNFolder
	End if
	dosyaAdi = ASNFolder & "\asn" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO) & ".xml"
	Set ASN = Fso.CreateTextFile(dosyaAdi,True)

	Set xmlDoc = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLDOM")
	xmlDoc.async = False
	
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "XML Dosyasý oluþturuluyor"
	Call Header(ASN)
	Call SatirYaz(ASN)
	Call Footer(ASN)

	ASN.Close
	xmlDoc.Load(dosyaAdi)
	Set IE = CreateObject("InternetExplorer.Application")
	IE.Navigate("file:\\" & dosyaAdi)
	IE.TheaterMode = true
	IE.Visible = true

	EH = doc.d7Msgbox("Oluþturulan ASN uygun mu?","dinamo",MB_YESNO)
	if EH <> 6 then 
		k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "ford.com.tr 'ye baðlanýlýyor"
	cookieStr = FOSNConnect(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
	if trim(cookieStr) = "" Then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("FOSN 'e baðlanýlamadý", "Hata!", MB_OK)
		Exit Sub
	End if

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "ASN gönderiliyor"
	sonuc = sendData(xmlDoc, cookieStr, dosyaAdi)

	xmlDoc.LoadXML(sonuc)
	if trim(xmldoc.xml) = "" Then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("ASN Gönderilemedi , " & ret,"dinamo",MB_OK)
	else
		ret = xmldoc.documentElement.selectSingleNode("RETURN").Text
		if ret <> "0" or ret <> 0 then 
			k = Doc.d7MsgBox("ASN Gönderilemedi , " & ret,"dinamo",MB_OK)
			k = Doc.d7MsgBox(xmlDoc.xml,"dinamo",MB_OK)
		else
			k = Doc.d7MsgBox("Ýþlem Tamam","dinamo",MB_OK)
			STOK60E.XNITELIK0 = "ASN_OK"
			Doc.RunCommand("MT_SAVE")
		end if
	end if
	Set Fso = Nothing
	Set xmlDoc = Nothing

	Call GetASNPage(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
End Sub
Sub Header(ASN)
	IrsaliyeNo = "A " & cstr(right(string(10,"0") & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1)),6))
	'IrsaliyeNo = "A " & cstr(right(string(10,"0") & trim(STOK60E.EXTERNALEVRAKNO),6))
	TransContNum = trim(Sender & IrsaliyeNo)
	ShippedFrom = Sender
	SeferNumarasi = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"SEFER_NO",0)
	ASNAmaci = "00"

	IrsaliyeTarihi = replace(STOK60E.TARIH,"/","")
	IrsaliyeTarihi = Mid(IrsaliyeTarihi,3)
	IrsaliyeSaati = Doc.Saat(6)
	TahminiVarisTarihi = IrsaliyeTarihi
	TahminiVarisSaati = IrsaliyeSaati
	NetAgirlik = "0.000"
	BrutAgirlik = "0.000"
	TasimaSekli = "M"
	PlakaNo = ucase(replace(STOK60E.BOX1_3," ",""))
	ResmiIrsaliyeNo = IrsaliyeNo
	NavlunFaturaNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"NAVLUN_FAT",0)
	TasiyiciKodu = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"TASIYICI",0)

	ASN.WriteLine("<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""windows-1254""?>")
	ASN.WriteLine("<?xml-stylesheet type=""text/xsl"" href=""http://www.diyalog.com/asn.xsl""?>")
	ASN.WriteLine("<ASN>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<HEADER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<TRANSACTION_CONTROL_NUMBER>" & TransContNum & "</TRANSACTION_CONTROL_NUMBER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<SENDER>" & trim(Sender) & "</SENDER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<RECEIVER>" & trim(FabrikaKodu) & "</RECEIVER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "</HEADER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<ASN_NUMBER>" & trim(IrsaliyeNo) & "</ASN_NUMBER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<SHIPPED_FROM>" & trim(Sender) & "</SHIPPED_FROM>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<SHIP_TO_PLANT>" & trim(FabrikaKodu) & "</SHIP_TO_PLANT>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<INTERMEDIATE_CONSIGNEE></INTERMEDIATE_CONSIGNEE>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<CONVEYANCE_NO>" & trim(SeferNumarasi) & "</CONVEYANCE_NO>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<ASN_PURPOSE>" & ASNAmaci & "</ASN_PURPOSE>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<DATE_CREATED>" & IrsaliyeTarihi & "</DATE_CREATED>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<TIME_CREATED>" & IrsaliyeSaati & "</TIME_CREATED>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<DATE_SHIPPED>" & IrsaliyeTarihi & "</DATE_SHIPPED>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<TIME_SHIPPED>" & IrsaliyeSaati & "</TIME_SHIPPED>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_DATE>" & TahminiVarisTarihi & "</EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_DATE>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_TIME>" & TahminiVarisSaati & "</EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_TIME>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<NET_WEIGHT>" & NetAgirlik & "</NET_WEIGHT>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<GROSS_WEIGHT>" & BrutAgirlik & "</GROSS_WEIGHT>")

	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<MODE_OF_TRANSPORT>" & trim(TasimaSekli) & "</MODE_OF_TRANSPORT>")

Sub SatirYaz(ASN)
	if trim(FabrikaKodu) = "D1D4F" then 'GÖLCÜK
		Birim = "EA"
	else
		Birim = "AD"
	end if
	CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
	for i = 1 to S60.GetRecCount()
		if trim(S60.KOD(i)) <> "" then
			Ambalaj = S60.FATURASIZMI(i)
			Kod = S60.KOD(i)
'			if trim(Ambalaj) = "E" then
'				StokKodu = Kod
'			else
				StokKodu = trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(Kod,CHKodu))
'			end if
			Miktar = S60.SF_MIKTAR(i)
'			Birim = S60.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
			PART_CUM_QTY = 0
			PART_PRIOR_CUM_QTY = 0 
			SiparisNo = S60.SIPNO(i)
			MusteriSipNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO",SiparisNo,"")
			PART_PO_NO = trim(MusteriSipNo)
			if trim(Ambalaj) <> "E" then
				KontSayisi = S60.BRUTAGIRLIK(i)
				ParcaTuru = "PP"
				ParcaKodu = trim(StokKodu)
				if trim(cstr(KontSayisi)) = "" or trim(cstr(KontSayisi)) = "0" then
					kontParcaSayisi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",Kod,"")
					kontParcaSayisi = Doc.Round(kontParcaSayisi,0)
					ParcaKontSayisi = Doc.Div(Miktar,kontParcaSayisi)
					ParcaKontSayisi = Doc.Ceil(ParcaKontSayisi)
				else
					ParcaKontSayisi = Doc.CDbl(KontSayisi)
					kontParcaSayisi = Doc.Div(Miktar,ParcaKontSayisi)
					kontParcaSayisi = Doc.Ceil(kontParcaSayisi)
				end if
				KonteynerTipi = "BOX90"
			else
				ParcaTuru = "CT"
				ParcaKodu = " " & trim(StokKodu)
				kontParcaSayisi = "0000"
				ParcaKontSayisi = "0000"
				KonteynerTipi = ""
			end if
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(3) & "<PART>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<NO_PART>" & ParcaKodu & "</NO_PART>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_NO_TYPE>" & ParcaTuru & "</PART_NO_TYPE>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_QUANTITY>" & Miktar & "</PART_QUANTITY>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_UOM>" & Birim & "</PART_UOM>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_CUM_QTY>" & PART_CUM_QTY & "</PART_CUM_QTY>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_PRIOR_CUM_QTY>" & PART_PRIOR_CUM_QTY & "</PART_PRIOR_CUM_QTY>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_PO_NO>" & PART_PO_NO & "</PART_PO_NO>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<CONTAINERS>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(5) & "<CONTAINER>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(6) & "<CONTAINER_TYPE_CODE>" & KonteynerTipi & "</CONTAINER_TYPE_CODE>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(6) & "<PARTS_PER_CONT>" & KontParcaSayisi & "</PARTS_PER_CONT>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(6) & "<CONTS_PER_PART>" & ParcaKontSayisi & "</CONTS_PER_PART>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(5) & "</CONTAINER>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "</CONTAINERS>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(3) & "</PART>")        
		end if
	Next
End Sub
Sub Footer(ASN)
	ASN.WriteLin(cTab(2) & "</PARTS>")        
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "</WAYBILL>")
	ASN.WriteLine("</ASN>")
End Sub
Function cTab(sayi)
	for i = 1 to sayi
		cTab = cTab & Chr(9)
	Next
End Function
Function sendData(xmlDoc, cookieStr, xmlFile)
	Set xmlHTTP = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP.6.0")
	if Doc.Bugun <= "2007/02/27" Then
		postURL = "https://fosnapp.ford.com.tr/asnposter/postxmlasn.asp"
	Else
		postURL = "https://fosnapp.ford.com.tr/postxmlasn.aspx"
	End if

	xmlHTTP.Open "POST", postURL, false
	xmlHTTP.setRequestHeader "Cookie", cookieStr
	xmlHTTP.setRequestHeader "Content-Type", "text/xml"
	xmlHTTP.setRequestHeader "Content-Length", Len(xmlFile)

	xmlhttp.Send xmlDoc

	sendData = xmlHTTP.responseText

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Baðlantý kesiliyor"
	xmlHTTP.Open "POST", "https://login.ford.com.tr/logout.aspx", false
	xmlHTTP.Send
End Function
Function AmbalajVarMi()
	AmbalajVarMi = False
	for i = 1 to STOK60T.GetRecCount()
		Ambalaj = STOK60T.FATURASIZMI(i)
		if trim(Ambalaj) = "E" then
			AmbalajVarMi = True
			Exit Function
		end if
	Next
End Function
Function KodKontrol()
	for i = 1 to STOK60T.GetRecCount()
		StokKodu = STOK60T.KOD(i)
		if trim(StokKodu) <> "" then
			CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
			CHStokKodu = trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu))
			Ambalaj = STOK60T.FATURASIZMI(i)
			if trim(CHStokKodu) = "" then
				Hata = Hata & StokKodu & vbcrlf
			end if
		end if
	Next
	if Hata <> "" then
		Hata = Hata & "Ford stok kodu karþýlýðý girilmemiþ."
	end if
	KodKontrol = Hata
End Function
Function SandikAdediKontrol()
	for i = 1 to STOK60T.GetRecCount()
		StokKodu = STOK60T.KOD(i)
		if trim(StokKodu) <> "" then
			kontParcaSayisi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
			Ambalaj = STOK60T.FATURASIZMI(i)
			BrutAgirlik = STOK60T.BRUTAGIRLIK(i)
			if trim(Ambalaj) = "" and kontParcaSayisi = 0 and trim(BrutAgirlik) = "" then
				Hata = Hata & StokKodu & vbcrlf
			end if
		end if
	Next
	if Hata <> "" then
		Hata = Hata & "Konteyner parça adedi girilmemiþ."
	end if
	SandikAdediKontrol = Hata
End Function
Sub GetASNPage1()
	Set MTable=Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
	KullaniciAdi = trim(MTable.F1)
	KullaniciSifre = trim(MTable.F2)
	Call GetASNPage(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
End Sub
Sub GetASNPage(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "FOSN 'e baðlanýlýyor"
  Set MyIA = CreateObject("InternetExplorer.Application")
  ConnUrl = "https://login.ford.com.tr/authenticate4outprg.aspx?userid=" & KullaniciAdi & "&password=" & KullaniciSifre
  
  NRetcode = IEGoto(MyIA, ConnUrl)
  NRetcode = IEWaitReady(MyIA)
  Call my_delay(1000)
  HTMLTxt = MyIA.Document.Body.InnerHtml
   
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "ASN 'ler ekrana getiriliyor."
	ASNUrl = "https://fosnapp.ford.com.tr/Page_asn_journal.aspx"
	NRetcode = IEGoto(MyIA, ASNUrl)
	NRetcode = IEWaitReady(MyIA)
	Call my_delay(1000)
  
	MyIA.Visible = True
End Sub
Function IEWaitReady(ByVal IEObj)
	IEWaitReady = 0
	While IEObj.Busy or IEObj.ReadyState <> 4
	Wend
End Function
Function IEGoto(ByVal IEObj, ByVal URL)
	IEObj.Navigate (URL)
	IEWaitReady (IEObj)
	IEGoto = 0
End Function
Sub my_delay(delay_value)
	Dim i
	For i = 0 To delay_value
'		DoEvents
		k = k + 1
	Next
End Sub

	Set XMLHTTP = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP.6.0")
	XMLHTTP.Open "POST", urlx, False
	XMLHTTP.Send
	FOSNConnect = XMLHTTP.getAllResponseHeaders
End Function

Public S60, FabrikaKodu, STOK60E, STOK60T

' ---- GSDB KODU -------------
Public Const Sender = "AS3WA"

Sub ASNGonder()
	Set STOK60E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60E")
	Set STOK60T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60T")
	Set MTable=Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
	KullaniciAdi = trim(MTable.F1)
	KullaniciSifre = trim(MTable.F2)
	Doc.RUN_APP_CANCEL

	if trim(KullaniciAdi) = "" or trim(KullaniciSifre) = "" Then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Kullanýcý adý ve þifre girmelisiniz." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	End if
	if Trim(STOK60E.XNITELIK0) = "ASN_OK" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Bu irsaliyenin ASN 'si daha önce gönderilmiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	SeferNumarasi = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"SEFER_NO",0)
	if trim(SeferNumarasi) = "" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Kullanýcý tanýmlý alanlarda sefer numarasý girilmemiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	PlakaNo = STOK60E.BOX1_3
	if trim(PlakaNo) = "" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Plaka Numarasý girilmemiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo", MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
'	if trim(STOK60E.EXTERNALEVRAKNO) = "" Then
'		k = doc.d7msgbox("Ýrsaliye numarasýný girmediniz." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo",MB_OK)
'		exit sub
'	End if

	SevkAdresKodu = STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
	Select case trim(SevkAdresKodu)
		case "D1D4T" 				'ÝNÖNÜ KAMYON
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4T"
		case "D1D4T-FR" 				'ÝNÖNÜ KAMYON FRP ATELYESÝ
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4T"
		case "D1D4H" 				'ÝNÖNÜ MOTOR
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4H"
		case "D1D4F"	 				'GÖLCÜK
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4F"
'		case "ARKOTO"	 				'GÖLCÜK
'			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4F"
		case "DBPAA"	 				'ARKOTO
			FabrikaKodu = "DBPAA"
		case "AUF9A"					'KARTAL YP DEPO
			FabrikaKodu = "AUF9A"
		case "CVR1B"					'KARTAL YP DEPO
			FabrikaKodu = "CVR1B"
		case "D1D4Y" 				'KOCAELÝ YEDEK PARÇA
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4Y"
		case else
			k = Doc.d7msgbox("Sevk adresi girilmemiþ veya tanýmsýz" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
			exit sub
	End Select
	if not AmbalajVarmi then
		EH = Doc.d7msgbox("Hiç konteyner gönderilmemektedir" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Onaylýyor musunuz.", "dinamo",MB_YESNO)
		if EH <> 6 then 
			k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
			exit sub
		end if
	End if
	KodDurumu = KodKontrol
	if trim(KodDurumu) <> "" then
		msgbox KodDurumu
		k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	SandikDurumu = SandikAdediKontrol
	if trim(SandikDurumu) <> "" then
		msgbox SandikDurumu
		k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	
	Doc.CreateTableObject "ZZZ=STOK60T","TMPCOPY"		
	Set S60 = Doc.GetTableObject("ZZZ")
	Set ST60 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60T")
	S60.CopyTable(ST60)
	S60.GroupBy("KOD")

	Set Fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	ASNFolder = trim(Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm) & "abdat"
	if not fso.FolderExists(ASNFolder) Then
		fso.CreateFolder ASNFolder
	End if
	dosyaAdi = ASNFolder & "\asn" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO) & ".xml"
	Set ASN = Fso.CreateTextFile(dosyaAdi,True)

	Set xmlDoc = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLDOM")
	xmlDoc.async = False
	
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "XML Dosyasý oluþturuluyor"
	Call Header(ASN)
	Call SatirYaz(ASN)
	Call Footer(ASN)

	ASN.Close
	xmlDoc.Load(dosyaAdi)
	Set IE = CreateObject("InternetExplorer.Application")
	IE.Navigate("file:\\" & dosyaAdi)
	IE.TheaterMode = true
	IE.Visible = true

	EH = doc.d7Msgbox("Oluþturulan ASN uygun mu?","dinamo",MB_YESNO)
	if EH <> 6 then 
		k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "ford.com.tr 'ye baðlanýlýyor"
	cookieStr = FOSNConnect(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
	if trim(cookieStr) = "" Then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("FOSN 'e baðlanýlamadý", "Hata!", MB_OK)
		Exit Sub
	End if

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "ASN gönderiliyor"
	sonuc = sendData(xmlDoc, cookieStr, dosyaAdi)

	xmlDoc.LoadXML(sonuc)
	if trim(xmldoc.xml) = "" Then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("ASN Gönderilemedi , " & ret,"dinamo",MB_OK)
	else
		ret = xmldoc.documentElement.selectSingleNode("RETURN").Text
		if ret <> "0" or ret <> 0 then 
			k = Doc.d7MsgBox("ASN Gönderilemedi , " & ret,"dinamo",MB_OK)
			k = Doc.d7MsgBox(xmlDoc.xml,"dinamo",MB_OK)
		else
			k = Doc.d7MsgBox("Ýþlem Tamam","dinamo",MB_OK)
			STOK60E.XNITELIK0 = "ASN_OK"
			Doc.RunCommand("MT_SAVE")
		end if
	end if
	Set Fso = Nothing
	Set xmlDoc = Nothing

	Call GetASNPage(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
End Sub
Sub Header(ASN)
	IrsaliyeNo = "A " & cstr(right(string(10,"0") & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1)),7))
	'IrsaliyeNo = "A " & cstr(right(string(10,"0") & trim(STOK60E.EXTERNALEVRAKNO),7))
	TransContNum = trim(Sender & IrsaliyeNo)
	ShippedFrom = Sender
	SeferNumarasi = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"SEFER_NO",0)
	ASNAmaci = "00"

	IrsaliyeTarihi = replace(STOK60E.TARIH,"/","")
	IrsaliyeTarihi = Mid(IrsaliyeTarihi,3)
	IrsaliyeSaati = Doc.Saat(6)
	TahminiVarisTarihi = IrsaliyeTarihi
	TahminiVarisSaati = IrsaliyeSaati
	NetAgirlik = "0.000"
	BrutAgirlik = "0.000"
	TasimaSekli = "M"
	PlakaNo = ucase(replace(STOK60E.BOX1_3," ",""))
	ResmiIrsaliyeNo = IrsaliyeNo
	NavlunFaturaNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"NAVLUN_FAT",0)
	TasiyiciKodu = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"TASIYICI",0)

	ASN.WriteLine("<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""windows-1254""?>")
	ASN.WriteLine("<?xml-stylesheet type=""text/xsl"" href=""http://www.diyalog.com/asn.xsl""?>")
	ASN.WriteLine("<ASN>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<HEADER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<TRANSACTION_CONTROL_NUMBER>" & TransContNum & "</TRANSACTION_CONTROL_NUMBER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<SENDER>" & trim(Sender) & "</SENDER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<RECEIVER>" & trim(FabrikaKodu) & "</RECEIVER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "</HEADER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<ASN_NUMBER>" & trim(IrsaliyeNo) & "</ASN_NUMBER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<SHIPPED_FROM>" & trim(Sender) & "</SHIPPED_FROM>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<SHIP_TO_PLANT>" & trim(FabrikaKodu) & "</SHIP_TO_PLANT>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<INTERMEDIATE_CONSIGNEE></INTERMEDIATE_CONSIGNEE>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<CONVEYANCE_NO>" & trim(SeferNumarasi) & "</CONVEYANCE_NO>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<ASN_PURPOSE>" & ASNAmaci & "</ASN_PURPOSE>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<DATE_CREATED>" & IrsaliyeTarihi & "</DATE_CREATED>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<TIME_CREATED>" & IrsaliyeSaati & "</TIME_CREATED>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<DATE_SHIPPED>" & IrsaliyeTarihi & "</DATE_SHIPPED>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<TIME_SHIPPED>" & IrsaliyeSaati & "</TIME_SHIPPED>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_DATE>" & TahminiVarisTarihi & "</EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_DATE>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_TIME>" & TahminiVarisSaati & "</EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_TIME>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<NET_WEIGHT>" & NetAgirlik & "</NET_WEIGHT>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<GROSS_WEIGHT>" & BrutAgirlik & "</GROSS_WEIGHT>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<WEIGHT_UOM>KG</WEIGHT_UOM>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<CARRIER1>" & trim(TasiyiciKodu) & "</CARRIER1>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<MODE_OF_TRANSPORT>" & trim(TasimaSekli) & "</MODE_OF_TRANSPORT>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<FREIGHT_BILL_NO>" & trim(NavlunFaturaNo) & "</FREIGHT_BILL_NO>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<BILL_OF_LADING_NO>" & trim(PlakaNo) & "</BILL_OF_LADING_NO>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<LICENCE_PLATE_NO>" & trim(PlakaNo) & "</LICENCE_PLATE_NO>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<WAYBILL>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<PACKING_SLIP_NO>" & trim(ResmiIrsaliyeNo) & "</PACKING_SLIP_NO>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<PACKING_SLIP_DATE>" & IrsaliyeTarihi & "</PACKING_SLIP_DATE>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<PARTS>")        
End Sub
Sub SatirYaz(ASN)
	if trim(FabrikaKodu) = "D1D4F" or trim(FabrikaKodu) = "D1D4H" or trim(FabrikaKodu) = "D1D4T" then 'GÖLCÜK veya ÝNÖNÜ
		Birim = "EA"
	else
		Birim = "AD"
	end if
	CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
	for i = 1 to S60.GetRecCount()
		if trim(S60.KOD(i)) <> "" then
			Ambalaj = S60.FATURASIZMI(i)
			Kod = S60.KOD(i)
'			if trim(Ambalaj) = "E" then
'				StokKodu = Kod
'			else
				StokKodu = trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(Kod,CHKodu))
'			end if
			Miktar = S60.SF_MIKTAR(i)
'			Birim = S60.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
			PART_CUM_QTY = 0
			PART_PRIOR_CUM_QTY = 0 
			SiparisNo = S60.SIPNO(i)
			MusteriSipNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO",SiparisNo,"")
			PART_PO_NO = trim(MusteriSipNo)
			if trim(Ambalaj) <> "E" then
				KontSayisi = S60.BRUTAGIRLIK(i)
				ParcaTuru = "PP"
				ParcaKodu = trim(StokKodu)
				if trim(cstr(KontSayisi)) = "" or trim(cstr(KontSayisi)) = "0" then
						'AMBALAJ MIKTARI
					kontParcaSayisi = GetStdKoliAdet(KOD, CHKODU, FABRIKAKODU)
					'kontParcaSayisi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",Kod,"")
					kontParcaSayisi = Doc.Round(kontParcaSayisi,0)
					ParcaKontSayisi = Doc.Div(Miktar,kontParcaSayisi)
					ParcaKontSayisi = Doc.Ceil(ParcaKontSayisi)
				else
					ParcaKontSayisi = Doc.CDbl(KontSayisi)
					kontParcaSayisi = Doc.Div(Miktar,ParcaKontSayisi)
					kontParcaSayisi = Doc.Ceil(kontParcaSayisi)
				end if
				KonteynerTipi = "BOX90"
			else
				ParcaTuru = "CT"
				ParcaKodu = " " & trim(StokKodu)
				kontParcaSayisi = "0000"
				ParcaKontSayisi = "0000"
				KonteynerTipi = ""
			end if
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(3) & "<PART>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<NO_PART>" & ParcaKodu & "</NO_PART>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_NO_TYPE>" & ParcaTuru & "</PART_NO_TYPE>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_QUANTITY>" & Miktar & "</PART_QUANTITY>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_UOM>" & Birim & "</PART_UOM>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_CUM_QTY>" & PART_CUM_QTY & "</PART_CUM_QTY>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_PRIOR_CUM_QTY>" & PART_PRIOR_CUM_QTY & "</PART_PRIOR_CUM_QTY>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_PO_NO>" & PART_PO_NO & "</PART_PO_NO>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<CONTAINERS>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(5) & "<CONTAINER>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(6) & "<CONTAINER_TYPE_CODE>" & KonteynerTipi & "</CONTAINER_TYPE_CODE>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(6) & "<PARTS_PER_CONT>" & KontParcaSayisi & "</PARTS_PER_CONT>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(6) & "<CONTS_PER_PART>" & ParcaKontSayisi & "</CONTS_PER_PART>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(5) & "</CONTAINER>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "</CONTAINERS>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(3) & "</PART>")        
		end if
	Next
End Sub
Sub Footer(ASN)
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "</PARTS>")        
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "</WAYBILL>")
	ASN.WriteLine("</ASN>")
End Sub
Function cTab(sayi)
	for i = 1 to sayi
		cTab = cTab & Chr(9)
	Next
End Function
Function sendData(xmlDoc, cookieStr, xmlFile)
	Set xmlHTTP = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP.6.0")
	if Doc.Bugun <= "2007/02/27" Then
		postURL = "https://fosnapp.ford.com.tr/asnposter/postxmlasn.asp"
	Else
		postURL = "https://fosnapp.ford.com.tr/postxmlasn.aspx"
	End if

	xmlHTTP.Open "POST", postURL, false
	xmlHTTP.setRequestHeader "Cookie", cookieStr
	xmlHTTP.setRequestHeader "Content-Type", "text/xml"
	xmlHTTP.setRequestHeader "Content-Length", Len(xmlFile)

	xmlhttp.Send xmlDoc

	sendData = xmlHTTP.responseText

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Baðlantý kesiliyor"
	xmlHTTP.Open "POST", "https://login.ford.com.tr/logout.aspx", false
	xmlHTTP.Send
End Function
Function AmbalajVarMi()
	AmbalajVarMi = False
	for i = 1 to STOK60T.GetRecCount()
		Ambalaj = STOK60T.FATURASIZMI(i)
		if trim(Ambalaj) = "E" then
			AmbalajVarMi = True
			Exit Function
		end if
	Next
End Function
Function KodKontrol()
	for i = 1 to STOK60T.GetRecCount()
		StokKodu = STOK60T.KOD(i)
		if trim(StokKodu) <> "" then
			CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
			CHStokKodu = trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu))
			Ambalaj = STOK60T.FATURASIZMI(i)
			if trim(CHStokKodu) = "" then
				Hata = Hata & StokKodu & vbcrlf
			end if
		end if
	Next
	if Hata <> "" then
		Hata = Hata & "Ford stok kodu karþýlýðý girilmemiþ."
	end if
	KodKontrol = Hata
End Function
Function SandikAdediKontrol()
	for i = 1 to STOK60T.GetRecCount()
		StokKodu = STOK60T.KOD(i)
		if trim(StokKodu) <> "" then
			kontParcaSayisi = GetStdKoliAdet(StokKodu, CHKODU, FABRIKAKODU)
			'kontParcaSayisi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
			Ambalaj = STOK60T.FATURASIZMI(i)
			BrutAgirlik = STOK60T.BRUTAGIRLIK(i)
			if trim(Ambalaj) = "" and kontParcaSayisi = 0 and trim(BrutAgirlik) = "" then
				Hata = Hata & StokKodu & vbcrlf
			end if
		end if
	Next
	if Hata <> "" then
		Hata = Hata & "Konteyner parça adedi girilmemiþ."
	end if
	SandikAdediKontrol = Hata
End Function
Sub GetASNPage1()
	Set MTable=Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
	KullaniciAdi = trim(MTable.F1)
	KullaniciSifre = trim(MTable.F2)
	Call GetASNPage(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
End Sub
Sub GetASNPage(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "FOSN 'e baðlanýlýyor"
  Set MyIA = CreateObject("InternetExplorer.Application")
  ConnUrl = "https://login.ford.com.tr/authenticate4outprg.aspx?userid=" & KullaniciAdi & "&password=" & KullaniciSifre
  
  NRetcode = IEGoto(MyIA, ConnUrl)
  NRetcode = IEWaitReady(MyIA)
  Call my_delay(1000)
  HTMLTxt = MyIA.Document.Body.InnerHtml
   
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "ASN 'ler ekrana getiriliyor."
	ASNUrl = "https://fosnapp.ford.com.tr/Page_asn_journal.aspx"
	NRetcode = IEGoto(MyIA, ASNUrl)
	NRetcode = IEWaitReady(MyIA)
	Call my_delay(1000)
  
	MyIA.Visible = True
End Sub
Function IEWaitReady(ByVal IEObj)
	IEWaitReady = 0
	While IEObj.Busy or IEObj.ReadyState <> 4
	Wend
End Function
Function IEGoto(ByVal IEObj, ByVal URL)
	IEObj.Navigate (URL)
	IEWaitReady (IEObj)
	IEGoto = 0
End Function
Sub my_delay(delay_value)
	Dim i
	For i = 0 To delay_value
'		DoEvents
		k = k + 1
	Next
End Sub

Function FOSNConnect(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
	Dim urlx, XMLHTTP
	urlx = "https://login.ford.com.tr/authenticate4OutPrg.aspx?userid=" & KullaniciAdi & "&password=" & KullaniciSifre

	Set XMLHTTP = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP.6.0")
	XMLHTTP.Open "POST", urlx, False
	XMLHTTP.Send
	FOSNConnect = XMLHTTP.getAllResponseHeaders
End Function

Function GETKASAKODU(STOKKODU, CHKODU, SEVKADRESI)

	QSTR = "EVRAKNO='" + STOKKODU

	If Trim(CHKODU) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & CH_KODU = '" + Trim(CHKODU)
	End if

	If Trim(SEVKADRESI) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & SHIPTOCODE = '" + Trim(SEVKADRESI)
	End if

	QSTR = QSTR + "'"
	Set S0A = Doc.Select1("S0AKASA", "STOK0A", QSTR, "", -1)

	If S0A.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		GetKasaKodu = ""
	Else
		GetKasaKodu = Trim(S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1))
	End if

	Doc.DeleteTableObject "S0AKASA"

End Function

Function GETSTDKOLIADET(KOD, CHKODU, FABRIKAKODU)

	If Trim(CHKODU) <> "" Then

Sub Makro1()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("", "TABLO6")
	Set CRPTable1 = GetCRPTable("CRPTABLE")
	CRPTable1.Sort("BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE+REV_RTESTARIH")
	Set TI = Doc.Select2("ddddd", "LISTE_I", "", "", -1)
	TI.Empty

	For i = 1 to CRPTable1.GetRowCount()
		TezgahKodu = CRPTable1.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i)
		KapasiteTalebi = CRPTable1.TALEP(i)
		if KapasiteTalebi > 0 Then
			QStr = "BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE='"+TezgahKodu+"'"
			QStr = QStr & "&REV_RTESTARIH>='"+CRPTable1.REV_RTESTARIH(i)+"'"
			QStr = QStr & "&REV_RTESTARIH<='"+CRPTable1.REV_RTESTARIH2(i)+"'"
			Set List = Doc.Select2("dfsd", "LISTE_I", QStr, "", -1)
			Call AlternatiflereDagit(List, TI, CRPTable1, i)
		End if
	Next
	Call ExceleGonder(TI)
	LISTE_I.CopyTable(TI)
End Sub
Sub AlternatiflereDagit(List, TI, CRPTable1, satirNo)
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	Set TFile = fso.OpenTextFile("c:\crplog.txt", 2, true)
	BaslangicTarihi = CRPTable1.REV_RTESTARIH(satirNo)
	BitisTarihi = CRPTable1.REV_RTESTARIH2(satirNo)
	List.Sort("KAYNAKMIKTART")
	BaslangicTarihi1 = Doc.StrtoNorDate(BaslangicTarihi)
	For i = 1 to List.GetRowCount()	
		Doc.StatusBarMessage "Alternatif Tezgahlara Daðýtýlýyor : " & trim(List.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i)) & " - " & BaslangicTarihi1 & " - %%" & Round(i/List.GetRowCount* 100,0)
		if trim(List.BOMREC_ALTKODU(i)) <> "" Then
			AnaTezgah = List.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i)
			AlternatifArr = GetAlternatifTezgahList(List.BOMREC_CODE(i), List.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i), List.BOMREC_ALTKODU(i))
			AnaBos = GetBosKapasite(AnaTezgah, CRPTable1, BaslangicTarihi, BitisTarihi)
			EnBos = AnaBos + List.KAYNAKMIKTART(i)
			BosTezgah = AnaTezgah
			if AlternatifArr(0) <> "" Then
				For each AltTezgah in AlternatifArr
					AltBosKapasite = GetBosKapasite(AltTezgah, CRPTable1, BaslangicTarihi, BitisTarihi)
					logStr = "StokKodu : " & List.BOMREC_CODE(i) & VBCRLF
					logStr = logStr & ", Ana Tezgah : " & AnaTezgah & VBCRLF
					logStr = logStr & ", Yük : " & List.KAYNAKMIKTART(i) & VBCRLF
					logStr = logStr & ", Boþ Kap. : " & AnaBos & VBCRLF
					logStr = logStr & ", Alt. : " & AltTezgah & VBCRLF
					logStr = logStr & ", Alt Boþ. Kap. : " & AltBosKapasite & VBCRLF
'					MSGBOX logStr
					TFile.WriteLine LogStr
					if AltBosKapasite > EnBos Then
						EnBos = AltBosKapasite
						BosTezgah = AltTezgah
						TFile.WriteLine "Alternatif eklendi : " & BosTezgah
					End if
				Next
				if BosTezgah <> List.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i) Then
					List.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i) = BosTezgah
					Call KapasiteleriGuncelle(CRPTable1, AnaTezgah, BosTezgah, List.KAYNAKMIKTART(i), BaslangicTarihi)
				End if
			End if
		End if
	Next
	TI.AppendTable(List)
	TFile.Close
End Sub
Sub KapasiteleriGuncelle(CRPTable1, AnaTezgah, BosTezgah, Yuk, BaslangicTarihi)
	k = 0
	For i = 1 to CRPTable1.GetRowCount()
		if CRPTable1.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i) = AnaTezgah and CRPTable1.REV_RTESTARIH(i) = BaslangicTarihi Then
			CRPTable1.TALEP(i) = CRPTable1.TALEP(i) - Yuk
			CRPTable1.FARK(i) = CRPTable1.FARK(i) + Yuk
			CRPTable1.YUZDE(i) = Doc.Div(CRPTable1.TALEP(i), CRPTable1.KAPASITE(i)) * 100
'			MSGBOX CRPTable1.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i) & ", " & CRPTable1.FARK(i)
			k = k + 1
			if k = 2 Then Exit Sub
		End if
		if CRPTable1.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i) = BosTezgah and CRPTable1.REV_RTESTARIH(i) = BaslangicTarihi Then
			CRPTable1.TALEP(i) = CRPTable1.TALEP(i) + Yuk
			CRPTable1.FARK(i) = CRPTable1.FARK(i) - Yuk
			CRPTable1.YUZDE(i) = Doc.Div(CRPTable1.TALEP(i), CRPTable1.KAPASITE(i)) * 100
'			MSGBOX CRPTable1.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i) & ", " & CRPTable1.FARK(i)
			k = k + 1
			if k = 2 Then Exit Sub
		End if
	Next
End Sub
Function GetBosKapasite(AltTezgah, CRPTable1, BaslangicTarihi, BitisTarihi)
	QStr = "BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE='"+AltTezgah+"'&REV_RTESTARIH='"+BaslangicTarihi+"'"
	Set CRP1 = Doc.Select2("ddeerr33", "CRPTable", QStr, "", -1)
	if CRP1.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		GetBosKapasite = AddAltTezgahtoCRP(AltTezgah, CRPTable1, BaslangicTarihi, BitisTarihi)
	Else
		GetBosKapasite = CRP1.FARK(1)
	End if
End Function
Function AddAltTezgahtoCRP(AltTezgah, CRPTable1, BaslangicTarihi, BitisTarihi)
	satirNo = CRPTable1.AddRow
	CRPTable1.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(satirNo) = AltTezgah
	CRPTable1.REV_RTESTARIH(satirNo) = BaslangicTarihi
	CRPTable1.REV_RTESTARIH2(satirNo) = BitisTarihi
	CRPTable1.TALEP(satirNo) = 0
	CRPTable1.YUZDE(satirNo) = 0
	DonemlikKapasite = GetDonemlikKapasite(AltTezgah, BaslangicTarihi, BitisTarihi)
	CRPTable1.KAPASITE(satirNo) = DonemlikKapasite
	CRPTable1.FARK(satirNo) = DonemlikKapasite

	AddAltTezgahtoCRP = DonemlikKapasite
End Function
Function GetDonemlikKapasite(AltTezgah, BaslangicTarihi, BitisTarihi)
	HaftaIci = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("IMLT00", "B_KAPASITE", AltTezgah, "")
	Cumartesi = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("IMLT00", "B_KAPASITE6", AltTezgah, "")
	Pazar = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("IMLT00", "B_KAPASITE7", AltTezgah, "")

	ToplamKapasite = 0
	Aralik = Doc.CDateToInt(BitisTarihi) - Doc.CDateToInt(BaslangicTarihi)
	Set d7Date = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	For i = 0 to Aralik
		Tarih1 = Doc.StrDate_Increment(BaslangicTarihi, i)
		d7Date.SetDate(Tarih1)	
		haftaGun = d7Date.GetDOW()
		if haftaGun >= 1 and haftaGun <= 5 Then
			ToplamKapasite = ToplamKapasite + HaftaIci
		Elseif haftaGun = 6 Then
			ToplamKapasite = ToplamKapasite + Cumartesi
		Elseif haftaGun = 7 Then
			ToplamKapasite = ToplamKapasite + Pazar
		End if
	Next
	GetDonemlikKapasite = ToplamKapasite
End Function
Function GetAlternatifTezgahList(MamulKodu, TezgahKodu, AlternatifKodu)
	ReDim AltArr(0)
	QStr = "AKTIF_PASIF='*'&BOMREC_CODE='"+MamulKodu+"'"
	QStr = QStr & "&BOMREC_ALTKODU='"+AlternatifKodu+"'"
	QStr = QStr & "&BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE<>'"+TezgahKodu+"'"
	Set B01T = Doc.Select1("dddeerr", "BOMU01T", QStr, "", -1)
	if B01T.GetRowCount > 0 Then ReDim AltArr(B01T.GetRowCount - 1)
	For i = 1 to B01T.GetRowCount
		AltArr(i-1) = B01T.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i)
	Next
	GetAlternatifTezgahList = AltArr
End Function
Function GetBaslaBitis(Grid, AlanAdi)
	Dim TarihArr(1)
	GetBaslaBitis = TarihArr
	For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)
		if Grid(i,0) = AlanAdi Then
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			BaslangicTarihi = Right(Baslik,8)
			BaslangicTarihi = Left(BaslangicTarihi, 6) & "20" & Right(BaslangicTarihi, 2)
			if InStr(1, Baslik, "Gün") > 0 Then
				BitisTarihi = BaslangicTarihi
			Elseif InStr(1, Baslik, "Hafta") > 0 Then
				Set d7Date = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
				d7Date.SetDate(BaslangicTarihi)
				d7Date.HaftaninSonGununeGit()
				BitisTarihi = d7Date.GetNorDate()
			Elseif InStr(1, Baslik, "Ay") > 0 Then
				Set d7Date = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
				d7Date.SetDate(BaslangicTarihi)
				d7Date.AyinSonGununeGit()
				BitisTarihi = d7Date.GetNorDate()
			End if
			TarihArr(0) = BaslangicTarihi
			TarihArr(1) = BitisTarihi
			GetBaslaBitis = TarihArr
			Exit Function
		End if
	Next
End Function
Function GetCRPTable(TableStr)
	Dim MTable
	Set MTable = Doc.CreateTransactionalTableObject(TableStr & "=STACK","IO")

	MTable.Addfield2 "REV_RTESTARIH","DATE",10,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "REV_RTESTARIH2","DATE",10,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE","CHAR",24,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "TALEP","DOUBLE",10,2,"R","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "KAPASITE","DOUBLE",10,2,"R","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "FARK","DOUBLE",10,2,"R","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "YUZDE","DOUBLE",10,2,"R","",""

	For i = 1 to TABLO6.GetRowCount()
		TezgahKodu = TABLO6.KOD(i)
		if trim(TezgahKodu) <> "" and InStr(1, TezgahKodu, "======") = 0 Then
			For j = 2 to 40
				BaslaBitis = GetBaslaBitis(Grid, "REPCOL" & j)
				satirNo = MTable.AddRow			
				KapasiteTalebi = TABLO6.GetFieldValue("REPCOL" & j, i+3)
				Fark = TABLO6.GetFieldValue("REPCOL" & j, i+5)
				DolulukYuzdesi = TABLO6.GetFieldValue("REPCOL" & j, i+7)

				MTable.REV_RTESTARIH(satirNo) = BaslaBitis(0)
				MTable.REV_RTESTARIH2(satirNo) = BaslaBitis(1)
				MTable.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(satirNo) = TezgahKodu
				MTable.TALEP(satirNo) = KapasiteTalebi
				MTable.FARK(satirNo) = Fark
				MTable.YUZDE(satirNo) = DolulukYuzdesi
			Next
		End if
	Next
	Set GetCRPTable = MTable
End Function
Sub ExceleGonder(TI)
	Set Excel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb1 = Excel.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sh1 = Wb1.Sheets(1)
	Sh1.Cells(1,1).Value = "Mamul Kodu"
	Sh1.Cells(1,2).Value = "Tezgah Kodu"
	Sh1.Cells(1,3).Value = "Operasyon Kodu"
	Sh1.Cells(1,4).Value = "Tarih"
	Sh1.Cells(1,5).Value = "Süre"
	Sh1.Cells(1,6).Value = "Alternatif Kodu"
	For i = 1 to TI.GetRowCount()
		Sh1.Cells(i+1,1).Formula = "'" & TI.BOMREC_CODE(i)
		Sh1.Cells(i+1,2).Formula = "'" & TI.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i)
		Sh1.Cells(i+1,3).Formula = "'" & TI.BOMREC_OPERASYON(i)
		Sh1.Cells(i+1,4).Value = TI.REV_RTESTARIH(i)
		Sh1.Cells(i+1,5).Value = TI.KAYNAKMIKTART(i)
		Sh1.Cells(i+1,6).Value = TI.BOMREC_ALTKODU(i)
	Next
	Excel.Visible = True
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	if LISTET.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("D7KIDSLB", "")
	For i = 1 to LISTET.GetRowCount()
		Doc.Load_Voucher LISTET.EVRAKNO(i)
		For j = 1 to STOK20T.GetRowCount()
			if trim(STOK20T.SERINO(i)) <> "" Then
				if trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("D7KIDSLB", "KOD", Doc.LeftJustify(STOK20T.SERINO(j), 30), "")) <> "" Then
					Call EtiketGuncelle(STOK20T.SERINO(j), Doc1, STOK20T.SF_MIKTAR(j))
				End if
			End if
		Next
	Next
	Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
End Sub
Sub EtiketGuncelle(Serino, Doc1, Miktar)
	Set d7LB = Doc1.GetTableObject("D7KIDSLB")
	Doc1.Load_Voucher Serino
	d7LB.SF_MIKTAR = Miktar
	Doc1.Save_Voucher
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	For i = 1 to LISTET.GetRowCount()
		Doc.Load_Voucher(LISTET.EVRAKNO(i))
		if MMPS10E.STATUS <> "R" and trim(MMPS10E.FIXEDRECETE) <> "E" Then
		Else
			ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("1","M", MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU, MMPS10E.SF_PAKETSAYISI, MMPS10E.SF_PAKETICERIGI,"","","","","","","","") 
			Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
			For j = 1 to MMPS10T.GetRowCount()
				if trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(j)) = "I" Then
					SureArr = GetOpSure(Tbmrsys, MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(j), MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(j))
					MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(j) = SureArr(0)
					MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR1(j) = SureArr(1)
					MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR2(j) = SureArr(2)
				End if
			Next
			Doc.Save_Voucher
		End if
	Next
End Sub
Function GetOpSure(Tbmrsys, SiraNo, OperasyonKodu)
	Dim OpArray(2)
	OpArray(0) = 0
	OpArray(1) = 0
	OpArray(2) = 0

	For i = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(i) = "I" and Tbmrsys.BOMREC_SIRANO(i) & Tbmrsys.BOMREC_OPERASYON(i) = SiraNo & OperasyonKodu Then
'		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(i) = "I" and Tbmrsys.BOMREC_OPERASYON(i) = OperasyonKodu Then
			OpArray(0) = Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(i)
			OpArray(1) = Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK1(i)
			OpArray(2) = Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK2(i)
			Exit For
		End if
	Next
	GetOpSure = OpArray
End Function

Sub ASNGonder()
	Set STOK60E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60E")
	Set STOK60T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60T")
	Set MTable=Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
	KullaniciAdi = trim(MTable.F1)
	KullaniciSifre = trim(MTable.F2)
	Doc.RUN_APP_CANCEL

	if trim(KullaniciAdi) = "" or trim(KullaniciSifre) = "" Then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Kullanýcý adý ve þifre girmelisiniz." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	End if
	if Trim(STOK60E.XNITELIK0) = "ASN_OK" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Bu irsaliyenin ASN 'si daha önce gönderilmiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	SeferNumarasi = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"SEFER_NO",0)
	if trim(SeferNumarasi) = "" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Kullanýcý tanýmlý alanlarda sefer numarasý girilmemiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	PlakaNo = STOK60E.BOX1_3
	if trim(PlakaNo) = "" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Plaka Numarasý girilmemiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo", MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
'	if trim(STOK60E.EXTERNALEVRAKNO) = "" Then
'		k = doc.d7msgbox("Ýrsaliye numarasýný girmediniz." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "dinamo",MB_OK)
'		exit sub
'	End if

	SevkAdresKodu = STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
	Select case trim(SevkAdresKodu)
		case "D1D4T" 				'ÝNÖNÜ KAMYON
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4T"
		case "D1D4T-FR" 				'ÝNÖNÜ KAMYON FRP ATELYESÝ
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4T"
		case "D1D4H" 				'ÝNÖNÜ MOTOR
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4H"
		case "D1D4F"	 				'GÖLCÜK
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4F"
'		case "ARKOTO"	 				'GÖLCÜK
'			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4F"
		case "DBPAA"	 				'ARKOTO
			FabrikaKodu = "DBPAA"
		case "AUF9A"					'KARTAL YP DEPO
			FabrikaKodu = "AUF9A"
		case "CVR1B"					'KARTAL YP DEPO
			FabrikaKodu = "CVR1B"
		case "D1D4Y" 				'KOCAELÝ YEDEK PARÇA
			FabrikaKodu = "D1D4Y"
		case else
			k = Doc.d7msgbox("Sevk adresi girilmemiþ veya tanýmsýz" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
			exit sub
	End Select
	if not AmbalajVarmi then
		EH = Doc.d7msgbox("Hiç konteyner gönderilmemektedir" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Onaylýyor musunuz.", "dinamo",MB_YESNO)
		if EH <> 6 then 
			k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
			exit sub
		end if
	End if
	KodDurumu = KodKontrol
	if trim(KodDurumu) <> "" then
		msgbox KodDurumu
		k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	SandikDurumu = SandikAdediKontrol
	if trim(SandikDurumu) <> "" then
		msgbox SandikDurumu
		k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	
	Doc.CreateTableObject "ZZZ=STOK60T","TMPCOPY"		
	Set S60 = Doc.GetTableObject("ZZZ")
	Set ST60 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60T")
	S60.CopyTable(ST60)
	S60.GroupBy("KOD")

	Set Fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	ASNFolder = trim(Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm) & "abdat"
	if not fso.FolderExists(ASNFolder) Then
		fso.CreateFolder ASNFolder
	End if
	dosyaAdi = ASNFolder & "\asn" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO) & ".xml"
	Set ASN = Fso.CreateTextFile(dosyaAdi,True)

	Set xmlDoc = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLDOM")
	xmlDoc.async = False
	
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "XML Dosyasý oluþturuluyor"
	Call Header(ASN)
	Call SatirYaz(ASN)
	Call Footer(ASN)

	ASN.Close
	xmlDoc.Load(dosyaAdi)
	Set IE = CreateObject("InternetExplorer.Application")
	IE.Navigate("file:\\" & dosyaAdi)
	IE.TheaterMode = true
	IE.Visible = true

	EH = doc.d7Msgbox("Oluþturulan ASN uygun mu?","dinamo",MB_YESNO)
	if EH <> 6 then 
		k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "ford.com.tr 'ye baðlanýlýyor"
	cookieStr = FOSNConnect(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
	if trim(cookieStr) = "" Then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("FOSN 'e baðlanýlamadý", "Hata!", MB_OK)
		Exit Sub
	End if

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "ASN gönderiliyor"
	sonuc = sendData(xmlDoc, cookieStr, dosyaAdi)

	xmlDoc.LoadXML(sonuc)
	if trim(xmldoc.xml) = "" Then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("ASN Gönderilemedi , " & ret,"dinamo",MB_OK)
	else
		ret = xmldoc.documentElement.selectSingleNode("RETURN").Text
		if ret <> "0" or ret <> 0 then 
			k = Doc.d7MsgBox("ASN Gönderilemedi , " & ret,"dinamo",MB_OK)
			k = Doc.d7MsgBox(xmlDoc.xml,"dinamo",MB_OK)
		else
			k = Doc.d7MsgBox("Ýþlem Tamam","dinamo",MB_OK)
			STOK60E.XNITELIK0 = "ASN_OK"
			Doc.RunCommand("MT_SAVE")
		end if
	end if
	Set Fso = Nothing
	Set xmlDoc = Nothing

	Call GetASNPage(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
End Sub
Sub Header(ASN)
	IrsaliyeNo = "A " & cstr(right(string(10,"0") & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1)),7))
	'IrsaliyeNo = "A " & cstr(right(string(10,"0") & trim(STOK60E.EXTERNALEVRAKNO),7))
	TransContNum = trim(Sender & IrsaliyeNo)
	ShippedFrom = Sender
	SeferNumarasi = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"SEFER_NO",0)
	ASNAmaci = "00"

	IrsaliyeTarihi = replace(STOK60E.TARIH,"/","")
	IrsaliyeTarihi = Mid(IrsaliyeTarihi,3)
	IrsaliyeSaati = Doc.Saat(6)
	TahminiVarisTarihi = IrsaliyeTarihi
	TahminiVarisSaati = IrsaliyeSaati
	NetAgirlik = "0.000"
	BrutAgirlik = "0.000"
	TasimaSekli = "M"
	PlakaNo = ucase(replace(STOK60E.BOX1_3," ",""))
	ResmiIrsaliyeNo = IrsaliyeNo
	NavlunFaturaNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"NAVLUN_FAT",0)
	TasiyiciKodu = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"TASIYICI",0)

	ASN.WriteLine("<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""windows-1254""?>")
	ASN.WriteLine("<?xml-stylesheet type=""text/xsl"" href=""http://www.diyalog.com/asn.xsl""?>")
	ASN.WriteLine("<ASN>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<HEADER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<TRANSACTION_CONTROL_NUMBER>" & TransContNum & "</TRANSACTION_CONTROL_NUMBER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<SENDER>" & trim(Sender) & "</SENDER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<RECEIVER>" & trim(FabrikaKodu) & "</RECEIVER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "</HEADER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<ASN_NUMBER>" & trim(IrsaliyeNo) & "</ASN_NUMBER>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<SHIPPED_FROM>" & trim(Sender) & "</SHIPPED_FROM>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<SHIP_TO_PLANT>" & trim(FabrikaKodu) & "</SHIP_TO_PLANT>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<INTERMEDIATE_CONSIGNEE></INTERMEDIATE_CONSIGNEE>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<CONVEYANCE_NO>" & trim(SeferNumarasi) & "</CONVEYANCE_NO>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<ASN_PURPOSE>" & ASNAmaci & "</ASN_PURPOSE>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<DATE_CREATED>" & IrsaliyeTarihi & "</DATE_CREATED>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<TIME_CREATED>" & IrsaliyeSaati & "</TIME_CREATED>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<DATE_SHIPPED>" & IrsaliyeTarihi & "</DATE_SHIPPED>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<TIME_SHIPPED>" & IrsaliyeSaati & "</TIME_SHIPPED>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_DATE>" & TahminiVarisTarihi & "</EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_DATE>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_TIME>" & TahminiVarisSaati & "</EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_TIME>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<NET_WEIGHT>" & NetAgirlik & "</NET_WEIGHT>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<GROSS_WEIGHT>" & BrutAgirlik & "</GROSS_WEIGHT>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<WEIGHT_UOM>KG</WEIGHT_UOM>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<CARRIER1>" & trim(TasiyiciKodu) & "</CARRIER1>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<MODE_OF_TRANSPORT>" & trim(TasimaSekli) & "</MODE_OF_TRANSPORT>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<FREIGHT_BILL_NO>" & trim(NavlunFaturaNo) & "</FREIGHT_BILL_NO>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<BILL_OF_LADING_NO>" & trim(PlakaNo) & "</BILL_OF_LADING_NO>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<LICENCE_PLATE_NO>" & trim(PlakaNo) & "</LICENCE_PLATE_NO>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "<WAYBILL>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<PACKING_SLIP_NO>" & trim(ResmiIrsaliyeNo) & "</PACKING_SLIP_NO>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<PACKING_SLIP_DATE>" & IrsaliyeTarihi & "</PACKING_SLIP_DATE>")
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "<PARTS>")        
End Sub
Sub SatirYaz(ASN)
	if trim(FabrikaKodu) = "D1D4F" then 'GÖLCÜK
		Birim = "EA"
	else
		Birim = "AD"
	end if
	CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
	for i = 1 to S60.GetRecCount()
		if trim(S60.KOD(i)) <> "" then
			Ambalaj = S60.FATURASIZMI(i)
			Kod = S60.KOD(i)
'			if trim(Ambalaj) = "E" then
'				StokKodu = Kod
'			else
				StokKodu = trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(Kod,CHKodu))
'			end if
			Miktar = S60.SF_MIKTAR(i)
'			Birim = S60.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
			PART_CUM_QTY = 0
			PART_PRIOR_CUM_QTY = 0 
			SiparisNo = S60.SIPNO(i)
			MusteriSipNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","CHSIPNO",SiparisNo,"")
			PART_PO_NO = trim(MusteriSipNo)
			if trim(Ambalaj) <> "E" then
				KontSayisi = S60.BRUTAGIRLIK(i)
				ParcaTuru = "PP"
				ParcaKodu = trim(StokKodu)
				if trim(cstr(KontSayisi)) = "" or trim(cstr(KontSayisi)) = "0" then
						'AMBALAJ MIKTARI
					kontParcaSayisi = GetStdKoliAdet(KOD, CHKODU, FABRIKAKODU)
					'kontParcaSayisi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",Kod,"")
					kontParcaSayisi = Doc.Round(kontParcaSayisi,0)
					ParcaKontSayisi = Doc.Div(Miktar,kontParcaSayisi)
					ParcaKontSayisi = Doc.Ceil(ParcaKontSayisi)
				else
					ParcaKontSayisi = Doc.CDbl(KontSayisi)
					kontParcaSayisi = Doc.Div(Miktar,ParcaKontSayisi)
					kontParcaSayisi = Doc.Ceil(kontParcaSayisi)
				end if
				KonteynerTipi = "BOX90"
			else
				ParcaTuru = "CT"
				ParcaKodu = " " & trim(StokKodu)
				kontParcaSayisi = "0000"
				ParcaKontSayisi = "0000"
				KonteynerTipi = ""
			end if
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(3) & "<PART>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<NO_PART>" & ParcaKodu & "</NO_PART>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_NO_TYPE>" & ParcaTuru & "</PART_NO_TYPE>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_QUANTITY>" & Miktar & "</PART_QUANTITY>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_UOM>" & Birim & "</PART_UOM>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_CUM_QTY>" & PART_CUM_QTY & "</PART_CUM_QTY>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_PRIOR_CUM_QTY>" & PART_PRIOR_CUM_QTY & "</PART_PRIOR_CUM_QTY>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<PART_PO_NO>" & PART_PO_NO & "</PART_PO_NO>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "<CONTAINERS>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(5) & "<CONTAINER>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(6) & "<CONTAINER_TYPE_CODE>" & KonteynerTipi & "</CONTAINER_TYPE_CODE>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(6) & "<PARTS_PER_CONT>" & KontParcaSayisi & "</PARTS_PER_CONT>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(6) & "<CONTS_PER_PART>" & ParcaKontSayisi & "</CONTS_PER_PART>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(5) & "</CONTAINER>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(4) & "</CONTAINERS>")
			ASN.WriteLine(cTab(3) & "</PART>")        
		end if
	Next
End Sub
Sub Footer(ASN)
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(2) & "</PARTS>")        
	ASN.WriteLine(cTab(1) & "</WAYBILL>")
	ASN.WriteLine("</ASN>")
End Sub
Function cTab(sayi)
	for i = 1 to sayi
		cTab = cTab & Chr(9)
	Next
End Function
Function sendData(xmlDoc, cookieStr, xmlFile)
	Set xmlHTTP = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP.6.0")
	if Doc.Bugun <= "2007/02/27" Then
		postURL = "https://fosnapp.ford.com.tr/asnposter/postxmlasn.asp"
	Else
		postURL = "https://fosnapp.ford.com.tr/postxmlasn.aspx"
	End if

	xmlHTTP.Open "POST", postURL, false
	xmlHTTP.setRequestHeader "Cookie", cookieStr
	xmlHTTP.setRequestHeader "Content-Type", "text/xml"
	xmlHTTP.setRequestHeader "Content-Length", Len(xmlFile)

	xmlhttp.Send xmlDoc

	sendData = xmlHTTP.responseText

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Baðlantý kesiliyor"
	xmlHTTP.Open "POST", "https://login.ford.com.tr/logout.aspx", false
	xmlHTTP.Send
End Function
Function AmbalajVarMi()
	AmbalajVarMi = False
	for i = 1 to STOK60T.GetRecCount()
		Ambalaj = STOK60T.FATURASIZMI(i)
		if trim(Ambalaj) = "E" then
			AmbalajVarMi = True
			Exit Function
		end if
	Next
End Function
Function KodKontrol()
	for i = 1 to STOK60T.GetRecCount()
		StokKodu = STOK60T.KOD(i)
		if trim(StokKodu) <> "" then
			CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
			CHStokKodu = trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu))
			Ambalaj = STOK60T.FATURASIZMI(i)
			if trim(CHStokKodu) = "" then
				Hata = Hata & StokKodu & vbcrlf
			end if
		end if
	Next
	if Hata <> "" then
		Hata = Hata & "Ford stok kodu karþýlýðý girilmemiþ."
	end if
	KodKontrol = Hata
End Function
Function SandikAdediKontrol()
	for i = 1 to STOK60T.GetRecCount()
		StokKodu = STOK60T.KOD(i)
		if trim(StokKodu) <> "" then
			kontParcaSayisi = GetStdKoliAdet(StokKodu, CHKODU, FABRIKAKODU)
			'kontParcaSayisi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
			Ambalaj = STOK60T.FATURASIZMI(i)
			BrutAgirlik = STOK60T.BRUTAGIRLIK(i)
			if trim(Ambalaj) = "" and kontParcaSayisi = 0 and trim(BrutAgirlik) = "" then
				Hata = Hata & StokKodu & vbcrlf
			end if
		end if
	Next
	if Hata <> "" then
		Hata = Hata & "Konteyner parça adedi girilmemiþ."
	end if
	SandikAdediKontrol = Hata
End Function
Sub GetASNPage1()
	Set MTable=Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
	KullaniciAdi = trim(MTable.F1)
	KullaniciSifre = trim(MTable.F2)
	Call GetASNPage(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
End Sub
Sub GetASNPage(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "FOSN 'e baðlanýlýyor"
  Set MyIA = CreateObject("InternetExplorer.Application")
  ConnUrl = "https://login.ford.com.tr/authenticate4outprg.aspx?userid=" & KullaniciAdi & "&password=" & KullaniciSifre
  
  NRetcode = IEGoto(MyIA, ConnUrl)
  NRetcode = IEWaitReady(MyIA)
  Call my_delay(1000)
  HTMLTxt = MyIA.Document.Body.InnerHtml
   
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "ASN 'ler ekrana getiriliyor."
	ASNUrl = "https://fosnapp.ford.com.tr/Page_asn_journal.aspx"
	NRetcode = IEGoto(MyIA, ASNUrl)
	NRetcode = IEWaitReady(MyIA)
	Call my_delay(1000)
  
	MyIA.Visible = True
End Sub
Function IEWaitReady(ByVal IEObj)
	IEWaitReady = 0
	While IEObj.Busy or IEObj.ReadyState <> 4
	Wend
End Function
Function IEGoto(ByVal IEObj, ByVal URL)
	IEObj.Navigate (URL)
	IEWaitReady (IEObj)
	IEGoto = 0
End Function
Sub my_delay(delay_value)
	Dim i
	For i = 0 To delay_value
'		DoEvents
		k = k + 1
	Next
End Sub
Sub Makro1()
'Bir Tablo ve alanlar yarat
	Dim MTable
	Set MTable = Doc.CreateTableObject("MAKROTABLE=STACK","IO")
	MTable.Addfield2 "F1","CHAR",30,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "F2","CHAR",30,0,"L","",""

	Dim Par
	Set Par=Nothing
	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "MAKROFORMU1",SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME,Par
End Sub
Function FOSNConnect(KullaniciAdi, KullaniciSifre)
	Dim urlx, XMLHTTP
	urlx = "https://login.ford.com.tr/authenticate4OutPrg.aspx?userid=" & KullaniciAdi & "&password=" & KullaniciSifre

	Set XMLHTTP = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP.6.0")
	XMLHTTP.Open "POST", urlx, False
	XMLHTTP.Send
	FOSNConnect = XMLHTTP.getAllResponseHeaders
End Function
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GETKASAKODU(STOKKODU, CHKODU, SEVKADRESI)

	QSTR = "EVRAKNO='" + STOKKODU

	If Trim(CHKODU) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & CH_KODU = '" + Trim(CHKODU)
	End if

	If Trim(SEVKADRESI) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & SHIPTOCODE = '" + Trim(SEVKADRESI)
	End if

	QSTR = QSTR + "'"
	Set S0A = Doc.Select1("S0AKASA", "STOK0A", QSTR, "", -1)

	If S0A.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		GetKasaKodu = ""
	Else
		GetKasaKodu = Trim(S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1))
	End if

	Doc.DeleteTableObject "S0AKASA"

End Function
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GETSTDKOLIADET(KOD, CHKODU, FABRIKAKODU)

	QSTR = "EVRAKNO='" + KOD

	If Trim(CHKODU) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & CH_KODU = '" + Trim(CHKODU)
	End if

	If Trim(SEVKADRESI) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & SHIPTOCODE = '" + Trim(FABRIKAKODU)
	End if

	QSTR = QSTR + "'"
	Set S0A = Doc.Select1("S0AKASA", "STOK0A", QSTR, "", -1)

	If S0A.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		GetKasa = ""
	Else
		GetStdKoliAdet = Trim(S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1))
	End if

	Doc.DeleteTableObject "S0AKASA"

End Function

	Next

Sub Makro1()
	
	If LISTET.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("D7KIDSLB", "")

	'mps den alýnan ve statu sü OK olanlarý boþ yap
	Set d7LB= Doc.Select1("d7ktablo", "D7KIDSLB", "STATU='OK' & EVRAKTYPE='UP'", "", -1)
	'statu deðeri boþ olanlar
	'Set d7LB= Doc.Select1("d7ktablo", "D7KIDSLB", "STATU=''", "", -1)
	For i = d7LB.GetRecCount to 1 step -1
		If Doc.EscPressed() Then Exit Sub
		Doc.Load_Voucher d7LB.KOD(i)
		'statu deðeri boþ olanlar
		'D7KIDSLB.STATU ="OK"
		'mps den alýnan ve statu sü OK olanlarý boþ yap
		D7KIDSLB.STATU =""
		Doc.Save_Voucher
		kalan = d7LB.GetRecCount-i
		Doc.StatusBarMessage("(" & trim(d7LB.KOD(i)) & "-" & kalan  & ")" & "... (%%" & CStr(Int(i*100/d7LB.GetRecCount))  & ")")
	Next
	Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher

End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	Set S60T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60T")
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput() 
	res = pe1.Open(1,"h",-1,-1,"") 
	res = pe1.ClearMailAttachments() 
	res = pe1.SetMailSubject("PSW ONAYSIZ SEVK ÝRSALÝYESÝ") 
	res = pe1.AddMailReceiver("mustafa_ozan@hotmail.com",1) 
	'res = pe1.AddMailReceiver("okaralar@ardoksan.com",1) 
	SevkNo = Stok60E.EvrakNo
	SevkTr = Stok60E.Tarih
	mesaj = (SevkNo + "  Nolu, " + SevkTr + " tarihli, " + "PSW ONAYSIZ sevk irsaliyesi gönderimi.")
	res = pe1.SetMailText(mesaj)
	res = pe1.AddMailAttachment(DosyaAdi,0) 
	'res = pe1.SetMailWithDialog(1) mail TT 'un görüntülenmesi için 
	res = pe1.SetMailWithDialog(0) 'direkt gönderim için 
	res = pe1.Maildoc() 
	res = pe1.Close()
End Sub

Makro Kodu : BIRIMHESAP
Hangi Tablo için : STOK00
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : Liste Tabý_Stok Kartýndaki Ek Tanýmlar bölümündeki birim kýsmýný sacdaki en boy genisliðe göre hesap
Kod : 
Sub Makro1()

	If LISTET.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK00", "")
	For i = 1 to LISTET.GetRowCount()
		Doc.Load_Voucher LISTET.KOD(i)
		Set S00 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK00")
		DEGER_YOGUNLUK = S00.B_YOGUNLUK
		DEGER_YUKSEKLIK = S00.B_YUKSELIK
		DEGER_EN = S00.B_EN / 1000
		DEGER_BOY = S00.B_BOY / 1000
		ADETICINKG = DEGER_YOGUNLUK * DEGER_YUKSEKLIK * DEGER_EN * DEGER_BOY 
		S00.CONVUNITS_COEF_1 = ADETICINKG
		S00.CONVUNITS_1 = "1"
		S00.UNITS_1 = "AD"
		S00.UNITS_TYPE_1_3 = "E"
		nret = Doc.Save_Voucher()
	Next
	
End Sub

Makro Kodu : BIRIMHESA2
Hangi Tablo için : STOK00
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : tek tek_Stok Kartýndaki Ek Tanýmlar bölümündeki birim kýsmýný sacdaki en boy genisliðe göre hesap
Kod : 
Sub Makro1()

	Set S00 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK00")
	DEGER_YOGUNLUK = S00.B_YOGUNLUK
	DEGER_YUKSEKLIK = S00.B_YUKSELIK
	DEGER_EN = S00.B_EN / 1000
	DEGER_BOY = S00.B_BOY / 1000
	ADETICINKG = DEGER_YOGUNLUK * DEGER_YUKSEKLIK * DEGER_EN * DEGER_BOY 
	S00.CONVUNITS_COEF_1 = ADETICINKG
	S00.CONVUNITS_1 = "1"
	S00.UNITS_1 = "AD"
	S00.UNITS_TYPE_1_3 = "E"
	nret = Doc.Save_Voucher()

End Sub

Makro Kodu : CALBIL-SIL
Hangi Tablo için : SFDC32
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : LÝSTE TABINDAKÝ ÇALIÞMA BÝLDÝRÝMÝ KAYITLARINI SÝLER
Kod : 
Sub Makro1()

	KULLANICI=Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName)
	'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	If KULLANICI="D7KSUPER" Then
		If Listet.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
		For i = 1 TO Listet.GetRowCount()
			Doc.Load_Voucher Listet.EVRAKNO(i)
			Doc.Delete_Voucher
		Next
		Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
	End If
End Sub

Makro Kodu : SIP-K-YAP
Hangi Tablo için : STOK40
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : Liste tabýndaki Açýk Satýþ Sipariþleri kapatma
Kod : 
Sub Makro1()
	Dim S40T
	If LISTET.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
	For i = 1 to LISTET.GetRowCount()
		Doc.Load_Voucher LISTET.EVRAKNO(i)
		Set ST40 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40T")
		For j = 1 to ST40.GetRowCount()
			ST40.ACIKKAPALI(j) = "K" 
		Next
		Doc.Save_Voucher
	Next
	Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
End Sub

	Call CariYaz(CariKodu)
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub FarFormCariYaz
	CariKodu = "120-01-011"
	Call CariYaz(CariKodu)
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub CoskunozCariYaz
	CariKodu = "120-01-129"
	Call CariYaz(CariKodu)
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub KirpartCariYaz
	CariKodu = "120-01-138"
	Call CariYaz(CariKodu)
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub DarilmazCariYaz
	CariKodu = "120-01-008"
	Call CariYaz(CariKodu)
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub CariYaz(CariKodu)
	Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
	Set S70E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70E")
	Set S70T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")

	EvrakNo = Trim(S70E.EVRAKNO)

	If EvrakNo = "" Then
		ret = Doc.New_Voucher
		'S70E.RSEVKTARIH = S70E.TARIH
		'S70E.RSEVKSAAT = Doc.Saat(5)
	End If
	'*****************************************************************
	'Set S70E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60E")   
  'EvrakNo = S70E.EVRAKNO

	'nret = Doc.UFLD00_CREATEEDITTABLE("T_U0001", "STOK70E", EvrakNo)     
	'Set T_U1 = Doc.GetTableObject("T_U0001")   
	'K = T_U1.SetFieldValue("URFISNO", -1, "")   

	'T_U1.Exec "SAVE"
	'*****************************************************************  

	S70E.CH_KODU = CariKodu 
	Doc.CallFieldAfterValidate_Row "STOK70E", "CH_KODU", -1
		
	S70T.Empty

	If CariKodu <> "120-01-001" Then
		S70E.SHIPTOCODE = ""
		S70E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1 = ""
		S70E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_2 = ""
		S70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_1 = ""
		S70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_2 = ""
		S70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_3 = ""
	End If
	Doc.RunCommand "CMD_STOK60_SUZ"
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Sifirla
	Set S70E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70E")
	Set S60_KRITERLER = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60_KRITERLER")
	S60_KRITERLER.EMPTY

	Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
End Sub

'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub For_Standart_Bom_Products
	StandartBomForProduct = "PRODUCT" 
	Call Get_Standart_Bom_Table
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub For_Standart_Bom_Sample
	StandartBomForProduct = "SAMPLE" 
	Call Get_Standart_Bom_Table
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Get_Standart_Bom_Table
	Set MMGNL = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_MMGNL")
	UstLimit = Trim(MMGNL.USTLIM)
	
	SQL = "SELECT PLANT, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  STOKKODU PRODUCT_CODE, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  CATEGORY_KODU, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  CATEGORY_ADI, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  ( " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  CASE " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    WHEN CURRENT_STOCK IS NULL " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    THEN UN " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    ELSE SF_UNIT " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  END)UNIT_OF_MEASURE, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  CARRIER_KODU, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  CARRIER_ADI, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  COLOR_KODU, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  COLOR_ADI, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  SEGMENT_KODU, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  SEGMENT_ADI, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  ACTIVE_PASSIVE_ERP, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  CURRENT_STOCK, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  DATE_OF_PRODUCT_CREATION, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  VALIDFROM DATE_OF_FIRST_PRODUCTION, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  VALIDTO DATE_OF_LAST_PRODUCTION, " & vbcrlf 

	If StandartBomForProduct = "PRODUCT" Then
		SQL = SQL & "  'PRODUCT' PRODUCT_SAMPLE " & vbcrlf 
	ElseIf StandartBomForProduct = "SAMPLE" Then
		SQL = SQL & "  'SAMPLE' PRODUCT_SAMPLE " & vbcrlf 
	End If

	SQL = SQL & " FROM ( " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT DISTINCT(PRODUCT_NUMBER), " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    PLANT, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    UN, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    VALIDTO, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    VALIDFROM " & vbcrlf 

	If StandartBomForProduct = "PRODUCT" Then
		SQL = SQL & "  FROM AAPPRP2 " & vbcrlf 
	ElseIf StandartBomForProduct = "SAMPLE" Then
		SQL = SQL & "  FROM AAPPRP2S " & vbcrlf 
	End If

	SQL = SQL & "  ) AQW " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT KOD, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    SUM(SF_MIKTAR) CURRENT_STOCK, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    SF_UNIT " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  FROM STOK01 " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  GROUP BY KOD, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    SF_UNIT " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  )A " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " ON AQW.PRODUCT_NUMBER = A.KOD " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT CREA_TARIH DATE_OF_PRODUCT_CREATION, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    TEXT_TECH_2 ACTIVE_PASSIVE_ERP, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    AD PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    NAME2 STOKADI2, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    KOD STOKKODU, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    GK_1 S00_GK1, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    GK_2 S00_GK2, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    GK_3 S00_GK3, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    GK_4 S00_GK4, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    GK_6 S00_GK6, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    GK_7 S00_GK7, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    TEXT_TECH_1 SAPKODU " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  FROM STOK00 " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  )C " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " ON C.STOKKODU = AQW.PRODUCT_NUMBER " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT EVRAKNO GK2_EVRAKNO, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    KOD CATEGORY_KODU, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    AD CATEGORY_ADI " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  FROM GECOUST " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  WHERE EVRAKNO = 'STKGK2' " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  )BB " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " ON C.S00_GK2 = BB.CATEGORY_KODU " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT EVRAKNO GK3_EVRAKNO, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    KOD COLOR_KODU, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    AD COLOR_ADI " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  FROM GECOUST " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  WHERE EVRAKNO = 'STKGK3' " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  )BC " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " ON C.S00_GK3 = BC.COLOR_KODU " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT EVRAKNO GK4_EVRAKNO, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    KOD CARRIER_KODU, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    AD CARRIER_ADI " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  FROM GECOUST " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  WHERE EVRAKNO = 'STKGK4' " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  )BC " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " ON C.S00_GK4 = BC.CARRIER_KODU " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT EVRAKNO GK6_EVRAKNO, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    KOD SEGMENT_KODU, " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "    AD SEGMENT_ADI " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  FROM GECOUST " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  WHERE EVRAKNO = 'STKGK6' " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & "  )BD " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " ON C.S00_GK6 = BD.SEGMENT_KODU ) " & vbcrlf 
	SQL = SQL & " WHERE 1=1 " & vbcrlf 

	Set MTableT = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLET")
	If MTableT.TESISSEC = "1" Then
		SQL = SQL & "AND PLANT  = 'TR01' "
	ElseIf MTableT.TESISSEC = "2" Then
		SQL = SQL & "AND PLANT  = 'TR04' "
	ElseIf MTableT.TESISSEC = "3" Then
		SQL = SQL & "AND PLANT  IN ('TR01','TR04') "
	Else
		Msgbox "Tesis Seçimi Yapýnýz..."
		Exit Sub
	End If

	If UstLimit <> "" Then SQL = SQL & " AND ROWNUM <= '"&UstLimit&"' "
	
	Set SQLTbl_MM10 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("XXX52XX11_TT", SQL) 
	
	KayitSayisi = UstLimit
	KayitSayisi2 = SQLTbl_MM10.GetRecCount
	 
	If UstLimit <> "" Then
		If KayitSayisi>KayitSayisi2 Then 
			KayitSayisi = KayitSayisi2
		Else
			KayitSayisi = UstLimit
		End If
	Else
		KayitSayisi = KayitSayisi2
	End If

	'Call Tbl_B01T.PrintOut("", "E", false, "")   'excele çýktý alma	
	'exit sub

	Set Tbl_SD10 = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_MMTBL10")

	Tbl_SD10.Empty
	
	If KayitSayisi = 0 Then
		Msgbox "Uygun Kayýt Bulunamadý..."
		Exit Sub
	End If

	k = Doc.d7Msgbox("Toplam [" & KayitSayisi & "] Adet Kayýt Bulundu." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Liste Oluþturulsun mu?","Freedom",MB_YESNO)
	If k <> 6 then
		Exit Sub		
	End If	
	
	For i = 1 To KayitSayisi
		Doc.StatusBarMessage "Liste Hazýrlanýyor : " & Tbl_SD10.GetAppName & " - " & i & " / " & KayitSayisi
		
		ProductCode = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.PRODUCT_CODE(i))		
		ProductDesc = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION(i))	
		
		Category_Code = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.CATEGORY_KODU(i))	 
		Category_Name = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.CATEGORY_ADI(i))	 
		
		UnitOfMeasure = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.UNIT_OF_MEASURE(i))	 
		
		Carrier_Code = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.CARRIER_KODU(i))	 
		Carrier_Name = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.CARRIER_ADI(i))	

		Color_Code = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.COLOR_KODU(i))	 
		Color_Name = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.COLOR_ADI(i))	

		Segment_Code = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.SEGMENT_KODU(i))	 
		Segment_Name = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.SEGMENT_ADI(i))	
		
		ActivePasssifERP = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.ACTIVE_PASSIVE_ERP(i))	 
		If ActivePasssifERP = "" Then ActivePasssifERP = "YES"
		
		CurrentStock = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.CURRENT_STOCK(i))	
		
		DateOfProductCreation = SQLTbl_MM10.DATE_OF_PRODUCT_CREATION(i)
		DateOfFirstCreation = SQLTbl_MM10.DATE_OF_FIRST_PRODUCTION(i)
		DateOfLastCreation = SQLTbl_MM10.DATE_OF_LAST_PRODUCTION(i)
		ProductSample = Trim(SQLTbl_MM10.PRODUCT_SAMPLE(i))
			
		satirNo = Tbl_SD10.AddRow
		Tbl_SD10.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
		
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN01 = ProductCode 
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN02 = ProductDesc
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN03 = Category_Code
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN04 = Category_Name  
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN05 = UnitOfMeasure 
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN06 = Carrier_Code  
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN07 = Carrier_Name
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN08 = Color_Code 
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN09 = Color_Name  
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN10 = Segment_Code  
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN11 = Segment_Name
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN12 = ActivePasssifERP 
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN13 = CurrentStock 
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN14 = DateOfProductCreation 
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN15 = DateOfFirstCreation 
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN16 = DateOfLastCreation  
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN17 = ProductSample  
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN18 = ""  
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN19 = ""  
		Tbl_SD10.ALAN20 = ""  
	Next
	Tbl_SD10.SafePack	
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub MMRAPOR1_LISTELE

	If Sekme = "Hammadde" Then
		Set Tbl_MM1 = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_MMTBL1")
	ElseIf Sekme = "FG_PROD" Then
		Set Tbl_MM1 = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_MMTBL2")
	ElseIf Sekme = "FG_TRD" Then
		Set Tbl_MM1 = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_MMTBL3")
	End If
		
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")

	Tbl_MM1.Empty
	
	Call MMRAPOR1_TABLO_OLUSTUR

	If KayitSayisi = 0 Then
		Msgbox "Uygun Kayýt Bulunamadý..."
		Exit Sub
	End If

	k = Doc.d7Msgbox("[MM RAPOR 1] Listesi için" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Toplam [" & KayitSayisi & "] Adet Kayýt Bulundu." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Liste Oluþturulsun mu?","Freedom",MB_YESNO)
	If k <> 6 then
		Exit Sub		
	End If	
	
	For i = 1 To KayitSayisi
		Doc.StatusBarMessage "(MM RAPOR 1) için Liste Hazýrlanýyor : " & Tbl_MM1.GetAppName & " - " & i & " / " & KayitSayisi
		
		Plant = Trim(SQLTbl_MM1.PLANT(i))
		OldMaterialNumber = Trim(SQLTbl_MM1.KOD(i))	
		MevcutDepoKodu = Trim(SQLTbl_MM1.MEVCUTDEPOKODU(i))
		Quantity = SQLTbl_MM1.SF_MIKTAR(i)
		UnitOfMeasure = SQLTbl_MM1.SF_UNIT(i)
		Value = ""
		BatchNumber = SQLTbl_MM1.LOTNUMBER(i)
		SalesOrder = ""
		SalesOrderItem = ""
		SAPID = Trim(SQLTbl_MM1.SAPKODU(i))
		MevcutDepoAdi = Trim(SQLTbl_MM1.MEVCUTDEPOADI(i))
		StokAdi1 = Trim(SQLTbl_MM1.STOKADI1(i))
		StokAdi2 = Trim(SQLTbl_MM1.STOKADI2(i))
		Remark = Trim(SQLTbl_MM1.REMARK(i))
		StorageLocation = Trim(SQLTbl_MM1.ALAN02(i))

		BIRIMMALIYET_TL = Doc.Div(SQLTbl_MM1.MALIYET(i), SQLTbl_MM1.TOPLAM_MIKTAR(i))
		DVZBIRIM_ECU = DOC.DIV(SQLTbl_MM1.DVZMALIYET(i), SQLTbl_MM1.TOPLAM_MIKTAR(i))
		'IslemBirimiDegeri = SQLTbl_MM1.ISLEMBIRIMI(i)
		
		satirNo = Tbl_MM1.AddRow
		Tbl_MM1.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
		
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN01 = Plant 
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN02 = StorageLocation
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN03 = OldMaterialNumber
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN04 = Quantity  
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN05 = UnitOfMeasure 
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN06 = Value  
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN07 = BatchNumber 
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN08 = SalesOrder 
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN09 = SalesOrderItem  
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN10 = SAPID  
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN11 = MevcutDepoKodu 
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN12 = MevcutDepoAdi 
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN13 = StokAdi1
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN14 = StokAdi2 
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN15 = BIRIMMALIYET_TL
		Tbl_MM1.ALAN16 = DVZBIRIM_ECU
	Next
	Tbl_MM1.SafePack
	Tbl_MM1.Refresh

	If MTable.DETAYOZETSECENEGI = 2 Then
		TableStr = Tbl_MM1.GetAppName
		Set Tbl_MM1_Stack = Doc.Select2G("de3ft5", TableStr, "", "", "ALAN12+ALAN02+ALAN03+ALAN05+ALAN07+ALAN11", -1)	
		'Doc.ShowTableDynForm "de3ft5"

		KayitSayisi = 	Tbl_MM1_Stack.GetRecCount
		
		If KayitSayisi > 0 Then
			Tbl_MM1.Empty
			
			For j = 1 To KayitSayisi
				satirNo = Tbl_MM1.AddRow
				Tbl_MM1.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
				
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN01 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN01(j) 
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN02 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN02(j) 
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN03 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN03(j) 
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN04 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN04(j)  
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN05 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN05(j)  
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN06 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN06(j)  
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN07 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN07(j)  
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN08 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN08(j) 
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN09 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN09(j) 
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN10 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN10(j) 
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN11 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN11(j)
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN12 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN12(j) 
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN13 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN13(j)  
				Tbl_MM1.ALAN14 = Tbl_MM1_Stack.ALAN14(j)    
			Next
		End If	
	End If
	
	Set SQLTbl_MM1 = Nothing
End Sub

Sub MMRAPOR1_TABLO_OLUSTUR
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
	Set MMGNL = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_MMGNL")
	
	STOKGK1SECIMI = Trim(MTable.STOKKRITER1)
	STOKGK7SECIMI = Trim(MTable.STOKKRITER7)
	UstLimit = MMGNL.USTLIM

	Qstr = "SELECT * FROM "
	Qstr = Qstr & " ( "
	Qstr = Qstr & " (SELECT * FROM STOK01)A "
	Qstr = Qstr & " LEFT JOIN "

	Qstr = Qstr & " (SELECT KOD MEVCUTDEPOKODU, AD MEVCUTDEPOADI, GK_2 PLANT FROM GDEF00)B "
	Qstr = Qstr & " ON A.AMBCODE = B.MEVCUTDEPOKODU "
	
	Qstr = Qstr & " LEFT JOIN "
	Qstr = Qstr & " (SELECT KOD, REMARK FROM KTA_GDEF00)BT "
	Qstr = Qstr & " ON A.AMBCODE = BT.KOD "

	Qstr = Qstr & " LEFT JOIN "
	Qstr = Qstr & " (SELECT AD STOKADI1,  NAME2 STOKADI2, KOD, GK_1 S00_GK1, GK_7 S00_GK7, TEXT_TECH_1 SAPKODU FROM STOK00)C "
	Qstr = Qstr & " ON C.KOD = A.KOD "
	
	Qstr = Qstr & " LEFT JOIN "
	Qstr = Qstr & " (SELECT * FROM KTT_MMTBL8) D "
	Qstr = Qstr & " ON (Trim(EVRAKNO)='1' AND Trim(D.ALAN04)=Trim(A.KOD) AND Trim(D.ALAN03)=Trim(A.AMBCODE) AND D.ALAN06=A.LOTNUMBER) "
		
	Qstr = Qstr & " LEFT JOIN "
	Qstr = Qstr & " (SELECT "
	Qstr = Qstr & " KOD, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " SF_UNIT ISLEMBIRIMI, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " SUM(TL_TUTAR)+SUM(TL_NONMIKTARTUTAR) MALIYET, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " SUM(DVZ_TUTAR_ALT)+SUM(DVZ_NONMIKTUTAR_ALT) DVZMALIYET, "

	Qstr =

Sub Makro1
	Set FTP_INFO = Doc.CreateTableObject("FTP_INFO=STACK", "IO")
	FTP_INFO.AddField2 "SERVER_ADI", "CHAR", 100,0,"L","",""
	FTP_INFO.AddField2 "FIX_REMOTE_PATH", "CHAR", 100,0,"L","",""

	Set MTable = Doc.CreateTableObject("MAKROTABLE=STACK","IO")
	MTable.AddField2 "INDIRMEKONTROLU", "CHAR", 1, 0, "L", "", ""
	MTable.AddField2 "UID", "CHAR", 20, 0, "L", "", ""
	MTable.AddField2 "PASSWORD", "CHAR", 20, 0, "L", "", ""
	
	MTable.INDIRMEKONTROLU = "E"
	MTable.UID = "sozan"
	MTable.PASSWORD = "Ops300618"
	
	ServerName = "ftp://ftp.map.com.tr"
	InboxPath = "FORDOTO/Inbox/"
	
	FTP_INFO.SERVER_ADI = ServerName
	FTP_INFO.FIX_REMOTE_PATH = InboxPath

	Set FL = Doc.CreateTransactionalTableObject("FTP_DOSYA_LIST=STACK", "IO")
	FL.AddField2 "DOSYA_ADI", "CHAR", 100, 0, "L", "", ""
	FL.AddField2 "DOSYA_BOYUTU", "DOUBLE", 10,0,"R","",""
	FL.AddField2 "DEGISIKLIK_TARIHI", "DATE", 10,0,"L","",""
	FL.AddField2 "DEGISIKLIK_SAATI", "CHAR", 8,0,"L","",""
	FL.AddField2 "SELECTED", "CHAR", 1, 0, "R", "", ""
	FL.AddField2 "SEVKCODE", "CHAR", 10, 0, "L", "", ""

	Call MapaBaglan

End Sub
