Makro Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : OPS_2016 / Uygulama : MAKR7S
Makro Kodu : FRD-ASN2
Hangi Tablo için : STOK60
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : DENEME AÞAMASINDADIR YILDIZ KALIP YENÝ FORD VDA Ýrsaliye CQEMA KTT TABLOSU OLUÞTUR.
Kod : 
Public FirmaKodu, HesapNo, SenderId, sNO, Cnt715

Sub Makro1()
	SiparisDurumu= SiparisBagli
	if SiparisDurumu=FALSE then
		k = Doc.d7msgbox("Sipariþe baðlý deðil" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	End If
	
	SevkAdresKodu = STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
	if trim(SevkAdresKodu)="" then
		k = Doc.d7msgbox("Sevk adresi girilmemiþ veya tanýmsýz" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	End If

	PlantCodeCustomer = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J", "GK_2", STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE, ""))
	if PlantCodeCustomer="" then
		k = Doc.d7msgbox("Sevk adres kartý Grup Kodu2 seçilmemiþ. " & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	End If

	STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH=Doc.Bugun()
	IF TRIM(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH)="" THEN 
		k = doc.d7msgbox("SEVK TARIHINI GÝRÝNÝZ","FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		EXIT SUB
	END IF

	Saat=Doc.Saat(4)
	STOK60E.RSEVKSAAT=LEFT(Saat,2) & ":" & Right(Saat,2)
	
	IF TRIM(STOK60E.RSEVKSAAT)="" THEN 
		k = doc.d7msgbox("SEVK SAATÝNÝ GÝRÝNÝZ","FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		EXIT SUB
	END IF

	SYilAyGun = MID(Replace(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH, "/", "") ,3) 'SEVK TARÝHÝ
	CikisSaati = TRIM(STOK60E.RSEVKSAAT)
	NakliyeSuresi = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "SEVK_SURE", 0)

	SureKontrol = REPLACE(NakliyeSuresi ,":","")
	if Len(SureKontrol) <> 4 Then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Nakliye Süresi  ss:dd þeklinde girilmelidir.", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		Exit Sub
	End if

	'Msgbox "ASN OK  kontrolü devre dýþý. Gerçek iþlemde bu mesaj çýkmamasý lazým"
	if Trim(STOK60E.GK_1) = "ASN_OK" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Bu irsaliyenin ASN 'si daha önce gönderilmiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	SeferNumarasi = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"SEFER_NO",0)
	if trim(SeferNumarasi) = "" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Kullanýcý tanýmlý alanlarda sefer numarasý girilmemiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	
	Tasiyici= Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"TASIYICI",0)
	if trim(Tasiyici) = "" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Kullanýcý tanýmlý alanlarda TAÞIYICI girilmemiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	
	PlakaNo = STOK60E.BOX1_3
	if trim(PlakaNo) = "" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Plaka Numarasý girilmemiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "FreedomERP", MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	MeansOfTransport= Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"TRNSTYP",0)
	if trim(MeansOfTransport) = "" then
		k = doc.d7msgbox("Kullanýcý tanýmlý alanlarda Taþýma Tipi girilmemiþ" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	KodDurumu = KodKontrol
	if trim(KodDurumu) <> "" then
		msgbox KodDurumu
		k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	KasaDurumu = KasaKontrol
	if trim(KasaDurumu) <> "" then
		msgbox KasaDurumu
		k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "Freedom",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	Doc.Save_Voucher

	NavlunNo= trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "NAVLUN_FAT", 0)) 	
	SonASN = SonASNmi(NavlunNo,STOK60E.EVRAKNO)
	SonASN=1
	if SonASN>0 then
			NavlunMiktarKontrol = DoNavlunMiktarKontrol(NavlunNo)
			if NavlunMiktarKontrol>0 then
					k = doc.d7Msgbox("Ýþlem kesilmiþtir.", "Freedom",MB_OK)
				exit sub
			End If
			Set CevaTable= Doc.Select1("CevaTTT", "KTT_SEVKTBL2","ALAN02='"& NavlunNo &"'","",-1)
			if CevaTable.GetRecCount>0 then
				Set Doc4 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("_GNPRG55","")
				Set SEVKTBL2 = Doc4.GetTableObject("KTT_SEVKTBL2")
				Doc4.Load_Voucher  CevaTable.EVRAKNO(1)
				For i=1 to SEVKTBL2.GetRecCount
					if trim(SEVKTBL2.ALAN02(i))=NavlunNo then
							SEVKTBL2.SEFEROK1(i)="E"
					End If 
				Next
				Doc4.Save_Voucher()
				Doc4.LoadEmpty_Voucher()
			End If
	end if
	
	Set KumuleTable = GetOncekiKumuleSevkTable()
	TransportRefNo = trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO)
	FileID = "FORD.SCQEMAAS"
	FORDPLANT=RIGHT("         "& trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE),9)  'NAD+ST
	Dim EdiLine
	EdiLine = ""

	'71102FORD     C6W4A    0000100001080114

	EdiID= TRIM(Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "VDAID", 0))	

	IF EdiID="" THEN
		 'DNSYS firmasýnda sayaç oluþturulacaktýr.	5 karakter. Start with '00001' for the first transmission. 
		EdiID= Doc.Sayac0danAl("FRDVDA4913")
		Call KTA_Yaz(EdiID)
	END IF

	R711_01="711"
	R711_02="02"
	'Number which the supplier has issued to Ford. If no number is stipulated (only one number can be selected for the area of production), enter “Ford”, aligned to the left. 
	 ' If the ASN is sent to plants within the European spare parts area, the appropriate FCSD code must be entered as transmitted in the release (e.g. FCSD-G)
	R711_03 = "FORDOTOTR"
	R711_03=Doc.LeftJustify(R711_03, 9)
	
	TransmissionDate = MID(Replace(Doc.BuGun, "/", ""), 3)	
	TahminiVaris = SaatEkle(STOK60E.TARIH, CikisSaati, NakliyeSuresi)
	CikisSaati= REPLACE(CikisSaati,":","")	
	
	'711 04 Supplier code issued by Ford (GSDB code). The first four characters identify the supplier. The fifth identifies the plant to which the supplier supplies.
	R711_04 = "CQEMA    "	'Supplier ID
	R711_04= Doc.LeftJustify(R711_04, 9)

	' 711 05 Start with '00001' for the first transmission. For subsequent transmission, take the number from the memory. Right-aligned with leading zeroes.
	R711_05=ZeroJustify(EdiID-1,5) 
	
	'711 06 Ordinal number which increases by 1 for each transmission. For the first transmission, the old transmission number = new transmission number. Right-aligned with leading zeroes.
	R711_06=ZeroJustify(EdiID,5)
	
	'711 07 Form YYMMDD, year 2000 rule: YY greater than or equal 50, then YY is 19YY,
	'	if YY is less than 50, then YY is 20YY. 
	R711_07= TransmissionDate
	
	'711  08 Sub-supplier number  Also referred to as Intermediate Consignee Code / Contract Packer; mandatory for shipments to 
	'North American Ford plants, production and spare parts (NAAO and FCSD-NA)
	'Ford Avrupa için Ara sevk bilgisi buraya girilmesi gereklidir.
	'R711_08= Doc.LeftJustify(TRIM(Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "ARA_SEVK", 0)), 9)
	R711_08= Doc.LeftJustify(R711_08, 9)
	
	'711 09 Carrier code Not Required by Ford
	R711_09=""
	R711_09 = Doc.LeftJustify(R711_09, 9)

	' 711 10 Storage code  Not required by Ford; remains blank.
	R711_10=""
	R711_10 = Doc.LeftJustify(R711_10, 1)
	
	'711 12 Blank 
	R711_12=Space(70)

	EdiLine1= "71102"
	EdiLine1 = EdiLine1 & R711_03 & R711_04 & R711_05 & R711_06 & R711_07 & R711_08 & R711_09 & R711_10 & R711_11 & R711_12
'***************

	R712_01="712"
	R712_02="02"
	EdiLine2= "71202"
	
'712 03 Enter the number of the transit document or shipment, loading ref. no. from the forwarding order. Ford terminology also includes Shipment Ref. No. 
'Yurtdýþý FORD lar için Fatura no girilecektir.
	R712_03 = right(TransportRefNo,8)
	R712_03= ZeroJustify(R712_03, 8)
	
	' 712 04 Suppliers Plant Code  Not required by Ford; remains blank.
	R712_04 = ""
	R712_04= Doc.LeftJustify(R712_04, 3)

	'712 05  Carrier/forwarding agent   Not required by Ford; remains blank.
	R712_05 = ""
	R712_05= Doc.LeftJustify(R712_05, 3)

	'712 06 Carrier date of goods transfer: Date on which the shipment is transferred to the carrier/forwarding agent, form YYMMDD.
	R712_06= SYilAyGun
	
	'712 07 Carrier time of goods transfer:  Time at which the shipment is transferred to the carrier/ forwarding agent, form HHMM.
	R712_07= CikisSaati

	'712 08 Transport gross weight: To be entered by supplier in kilograms, right-aligned with leading zeroes and no positions after the decimal point.
	'712 09 Transport net weight: To be entered by supplier in kilograms, right-aligned with leading zeroes and no positions after the decimal point.
	Agirlik = GetToplamBrutAgirlik()
	NetAgirlik= Agirlik(0)
	BrutAgirlik= Agirlik(1)
	R712_08=  ZeroJustify(BrutAgirlik, 7)
	R712_09 = ZeroJustify(NetAgirlik, 7)


	' 712 10 Freight payment code: Not required by Ford; remains blank.
	R712_10 = ""
	R712_10 = Doc.LeftJustify(R712_10, 2)

	' 712 11 Carrier EDI code: Not required by Ford; remains blank.
	R712_11 = ""
	R712_11 = Doc.LeftJustify(R712_11, 1)
	
	'712 12 Number of packages: Is entered by the supplier and must agree with the corresponding number on the packing slips. Right-aligned with leading zeroes and no positions after the decimal point.	
	R712_12 = 0
	R712_12= ZeroJustify(R712_12, 4)

	'712 13 Carrier (Transport partner number): The Ford code for the regional carrier is to be entered here. See also Section C, item 2. Enter left-aligned.
	R712_13=Tasiyici
	R712_13= Doc.LeftJustify(R712_13, 14)
	
	' 712  14 Means of transport code :For trucks ‘01’ (vehicle registration no.) is used. For other codes cf. Appendix to B.
	R712_14= MeansOfTransport

'****** 712 15 Conveyance number: If transport is CEVA Logistic then to be entered transport number by CEVA else not required
' AÇIKLAMAYA GÖRE SEFER NO BURADA OLMASI GEREKÝYOR .
	R712_15 = trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "SEFER_NO", 0))
	R712_15= Doc.LeftJustify(trim(R712_15), 25)

	' 712 16 Tariff zone/Community tariff: Not required by Ford; remains blank
	R712_16 = ""
	R712_16 = Doc.LeftJustify(R712_16, 9)

	'712 17 Scheduled date of arrival: Is only required for direct delivery to the receiving plant; form YYMMDD
	DateOfArrival = Mid(TahminiVaris,3,6)
	R712_17=Doc.LeftJustify(DateOfArrival, 6)

	'712 18 Scheduled time of arrival:Is only required for direct delivery to the receiving plant; form HHMM
	TimeOfArrival = right(TahminiVaris,4)
	R712_18= Doc.LeftJustify(TimeOfArrival, 4)

	'712 19: Load metres : Currently not required by Ford; remains blank.
	LoadMetres = ""
	R712_19= Doc.LeftJustify(LoadMetres, 3)
	
	'712 20 Truck type code:Not required by Ford; remains blank.
	TruckTypeCode = ""
	R712_20= Doc.LeftJustify(TruckTypeCode, 1)

	'712 21 Blank 
	R712_21= Space(3)
	
	EdiLine2=  EdiLine2 & R712_03 & R712_04 & R712_05 & R712_06 & R712_07& R712_08 & R712_09
	EdiLine2=  EdiLine2 & R712_10 & R712_11 & R712_12 & R712_13 & R712_14 & R712_15 & R712_16 & R712_17
	EdiLine2=  EdiLine2 & R712_18 & R712_19 & R712_20 & R712_21
	
'*****************************************

	R713_01="713"
	R713_02="02"
	EdiLine3= "71302"
	
	' 713 03 Advice Note Number:Right-aligned with leading zeroes, only numeric characters. Cf. remark in Section C
	R713_03= ZeroJustify(TransportRefNo, 8)

	'713 04 Shipment date:Form YYMMDD must agree with carrier transfer date (712-06).
	R713_04= ZeroJustify(SYilAyGun, 6)

	'713 05 Receiving location:Enter code from release, left-aligned
	R713_05=Doc.LeftJustify(trim(PlantCodeCustomer), 5)

	'713 06 Type of shipment: Enter code in line with Appendix to B.
	TypeofShipment = "01" 'Sorulacak
	R713_06=Doc.LeftJustify(trim(TypeofShipment), 2)

	'713 07 Customer’s code:Not required by Ford; also not possible since related to part number. 
	CustomersCode = ""
	R713_07= Doc.LeftJustify(trim(CustomersCode), 4)

	' 713 08 Transaction/order number:Not required by Ford; remains blank.
	TransactionOrderNumber = ""
	R713_08=Doc.LeftJustify(trim(TransactionOrderNumber), 12)

	'713 09 Procedure code: Not required by Ford; remains blank.
	ProcedureCode = ""
	R713_09= Doc.LeftJustify(trim(ProcedureCode), 2)

	'713 10 Blank
	R713_10= Space(4)

	'713 11 Plant Code customer: To be entered by supplier corresponding to code in release. All packing slips must be made up for a specific plant. Enter left-aligned.
	R713_11= Doc.LeftJustify(trim(PlantCodeCustomer), 3)

	'713 12 Licence plate number :Required by Ford Kocaeli plant.
	R713_12= Doc.LeftJustify(trim(PlakaNo), 8)

	'713 13 Goods recipient number: Not required by Ford; remains blank.
	GoodsRecipientNumber = ""
	R713_13= Doc.LeftJustify(trim(GoodsRecipientNumber), 9)

	'713 14 ASN correction code:Standard is blank.
	ASNCorrectionCode = ""
	R713_14= Doc.LeftJustify(trim(ASNCorrectionCode), 1)

	'713 15 Storage location customer:Here, the storage location code from the release (record type 512, position 19) must be entered.
	StorageLocationCustomer = ""    '512 segmenti pos.19
	R713_15= Doc.LeftJustify(StorageLocationCustomer, 7)

	
	'713 16 Freight bill number:	9	K		Required by Ford Kocaeli plant.	
	'AÇIKLAMAYA BURAYA NAVLUN BÝLGÝSÝ YAZILACAKTIR.
	SupplierNumber = trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "NAVLUN_FAT", 0))
	R713_16 = Doc.LeftJustify(SupplierNumber, 9)

	' 713 17 Point of consumption:Not required by Ford; remains blank.	
	PointofConsumption = ""
	R713_17= Doc.LeftJustify(PointofConsumption, 14)

	'713 18 Release number:Not required by Ford; remains blank.
	ReleaseNumber = ""
	R713_18= Doc.LeftJustify(ReleaseNumber, 4)

	'713 19 Customer’s reference: Not required by Ford; remains blank.
	CustomersReference = ""
	R713_19=Doc.LeftJustify(CustomersReference, 6)

	'713 20 Blank
	R713_20= Space(19)
	
	EdiLine3 = EdiLine3 & R713_03 & R713_04 & R713_05 & R713_06 & R713_07 & R713_08 & R713_09
	EdiLine3 = EdiLine3 & R713_10 & R713_11 & R713_12 & R713_13 & R713_14 & R713_15 & R713_16 & R713_17
	EdiLine3 = EdiLine3 & R713_18 & R713_19 & R713_20
'*****************************************

		Set Doc2 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("_GNPRG56","")
		'Set Doc2 = Doc.DocPoolGetDocument("_GNPRG56")
		Set ASN4913E = Doc2.GetTableObject("KTT_ASN4913E")
		Set ASN4913T = Doc2.GetTableObject("KTT_ASN4913T")
		Doc2.Load_Voucher EdiID
		ASN4913T.Empty()
		
		ASN4913E.S60EVRAKN0=trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO)
		ASN4913E.S60CHKODU=trim(STOK60E.CH_KODU)
		ASN4913E.R711_01=R711_01
		ASN4913E.R711_02=R711_02
		ASN4913E.R711_03=R711_03
		ASN4913E.R711_04=R711_04
		ASN4913E.R711_05=R711_05
		ASN4913E.R711_06=R711_06
		ASN4913E.R711_07=R711_07
		ASN4913E.R711_08=R711_08
		ASN4913E.R711_09=R711_09
		ASN4913E.R711_10=R711_10
		ASN4913E.R711_11=R711_11
		
		ASN4913E.R712_01=R712_01
		ASN4913E.R712_02=R712_02
		ASN4913E.R712_03=R712_03

Kod : 
Sub Makro1

	KULLANICI=Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName)

	If KULLANICI = "FX" Then
		If LISTET.GetRowCount = 0 Then Exit Sub
		
		For i = 1 TO LISTET.GetRowCount
			Doc.Load_Voucher LISTET.EVRAKNO(i)
			
			Set S40T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40T")
			KayitSayisi = S40T.GetRecCount
			
			If KayitSayisi = 0 Then Exit Sub
			For j = 1 To KayitSayisi
				If Trim(S40T.ACIKKAPALI(j)) <> "K" Then S40T.ACIKKAPALI(j) = "K"
			Next
			Doc.Save_Voucher
		Next
		
		Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
	End If
	
End Sub

Makro Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : OPS_2016 / Uygulama : MAKR7S
Makro Kodu : OTOSP1-02
Hangi Tablo için : 
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : MAP dan SÝPARÝÞLERÝ AL - FORD (FOSN 'DE EKLENDÝ)
Kod : 
Public DosyaArr, OTOSP1E, ServerName, InboxPath, FtpUsername, FtpPassword, kullanici, EskiSiparisler, EKRANACIK
Public SipTable, TFile, satirLen, AlanArray, say, fff, OSP1E, OSP1L, OncekiSiparisKapatildimi, SiparisAktarildi, SevkKodu
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub ExceldenAktar
	Set WshShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
	myDir = WshShell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings("%USERPROFILE%") & "\Desktop\"
	Dosyayolu = myDir & "ongoru_aktar.xls"
	
	Set Excel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb1 = Excel.Workbooks.Open(DosyaYolu, False)

	Set Sh1 = Wb1.Sheets("aktar")
	
	AktarilacakSipSayisi = Sh1.Cells(Sh1.Rows.Count, "C").End(3).Row - 1
	
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("OTOSP1","")
	Set OTSP1E = Doc1.GetTableObject("OTOSP1E")
	Set OTSP1L = Doc1.GetTableObject("OTOSP1L")

	SipMusteriKodu = Trim(Sh1.Cells(2, 1).value)
	nret = Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher()	
	
	j=2
	
	While Trim(Sh1.Cells(j,3).value) <> ""
		Kod = Trim(Sh1.Cells(j, 3).value)
		UrunKodu = Trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK0GT", "STOKCODE", Doc.LeftJustify(SipMusteriKodu, 16)+Doc.LeftJustify(Kod, 24), "KOD+MSTOKCODE"))
		If UrunKodu = "" Then
			msgbox "Tanýmsýz Stok Kodu : [ " & Kod & " ]" & vbcrlf & "Kod Tanýmý Yapýlmalý. Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir." 
			Exit Sub
		End If
		j = j + 1
	Wend

	nret = Doc1.New_Voucher
	EvrakNo = Trim(OTSP1E.EVRAKNO)
	
	OTSP1E.CH_KODU = SipMusteriKodu
	OTSP1E.ACIKKAPALI = "K"
	OTSP1E.ACIKLAMA = "ISUZU ÖNGÖRÜLERÝ - [ " &  Doc.StrtoNordate(Doc.Bugun) & " ] - ( " & Doc.Saat(5) & " )"
	OTSP1L.Empty
		
	i=2
	
	While Trim(Sh1.Cells(i,3).value) <> ""
		Kod = Trim(Sh1.Cells(i, 3).value)
		UrunKodu = Trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK0GT", "STOKCODE", Kod, "MSTOKCODE"))
	
		If UrunKodu = "" Then
			msgbox "Tanýmsýz Stok Kodu Var! Kontrol Ediniz...."
			Exit Sub
		End If
		
		MustSipNo = Trim(Sh1.Cells(i, 2).value)
		SevkKodu = Trim(Sh1.Cells(i, 6).value)
		
		Miktar = Sh1.Cells(i, 5).value

		ImalatGarTarihi = Sh1.Cells(i, 8).value
		NoktaliTarihFormati1 = InStr(1, ImalatGarTarihi, ".")
   If NoktaliTarihFormati1 > 0 Then
			ImalatGarTarihi = Replace(ImalatGarTarihi, ".", "/")
		End If
		
		ImalatGarTarihi = Day(ImalatGarTarihi) & "/" & Month(ImalatGarTarihi) & "/" & Year(ImalatGarTarihi)

		MalzemeGarTarihi = Sh1.Cells(i, 9).value
		NoktaliTarihFormati2 = InStr(1, MalzemeGarTarihi, ".")
		
		If NoktaliTarihFormati2 > 0 Then
			MalzemeGarTarihi = Replace(MalzemeGarTarihi, ".", "/")
		End If
		
		MalzemeGarTarihi = Day(MalzemeGarTarihi) & "/" & Month(MalzemeGarTarihi) & "/" & Year(MalzemeGarTarihi)
		
		KesinTahmini = Trim(Sh1.Cells(i, 7).value)
		KesinTahmini = Left(KesinTahmini, 1)
		
		If	KesinTahmini = "K" Then
			KesinTahmini = "K"
		ElseIf KesinTahmini = "T" Then
			KesinTahmini = "T"
		End If
		
		TesTarihi = Sh1.Cells(i, 4).value
		NoktaliTarihFormati = InStr(1, TesTarihi, ".")

   If NoktaliTarihFormati > 0 Then
			TesTarihi = Replace(TesTarihi, ".", "/")
		End If
		
		TesTarihi = Day(TesTarihi) & "/" & Month(TesTarihi) & "/" & Year(TesTarihi)
				
		If Isnumeric(Miktar) Then
			If Miktar > 0 Then 
			
				OTSP1L.AddRow
				satirNo = OTSP1L.GetRecCount()
				OTSP1L.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
				
				Doc.StatusbarMessage "Müþteri Öngörüsüne Aktarýlýyor...... Evrak No = [" & EvrakNo & "] - Aktarýlan = {" & i & "} / Toplam Aktarýlacak = {" & AktarilacakSipSayisi & "}"

				OTSP1L.D_ID = Kod
				OTSP1L.SF_MIKTAR = Miktar

				OTSP1L.RTESTARIH = TesTarihi
				OTSP1L.PROGRAM_NO = MustSipNo
				OTSP1L.SHIPTOCODE = SevkKodu
				OTSP1L.SPSTATUSU = KesinTahmini
				OTSP1L.REF_TARIH_11 = ImalatGarTarihi
				OTSP1L.REF_TARIH_12 = MalzemeGarTarihi
			End If
		Else
			Msgbox i-1 & ". Satýrda Sayý Olarak Tanýmlanmayan Veri Var !!! "
		End If
		i = i + 1
	Wend
	
	nret = Doc1.Save_Voucher()
	If nret <> 0 Then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox(OTSP1E.EVRAKNO & " no.lu evrak kaydedilemedi. Ýþlem kesilmiþtir","Freedom ERP",MB_OK)
		Wb1.Close
		Excel.Quit
		nret = Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher()
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	nret = Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher()
	Msgbox EvrakNo & " Evrak Numarasý ile Öngörü Sipariþi Aktarýldý..."	
	Doc.Load_Voucher EvrakNo
	
	Wb1.Close
	Excel.Quit
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub FOSNSiparisleri
	Set Doc2 = Doc.CreateDocumentUI("FOSN","")
	Set OTSP1E = Doc2.GetTableObject("OTOSP1E")
	Set OTSP1T = Doc2.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")

	Set FSN = Doc.Select1("dd33f56jjj77", "OTOSP1E", "CH_KODU='120-01-001' & ACIKKAPALI='A' ", "", -1)
	FSN.GroupBy("EVRAKNO")
	
	KayitSayisi = FSN.GetRecCount
	
	If KayitSayisi > 0 Then
		For i = 1 To KayitSayisi
			EvrakNo = FSN.EVRAKNO(i)
			Doc2.Load_Voucher EvrakNo
		
			Doc.StatusBarMessage "Önceki Sipariþler Kapatýlýyor...." 
			OTSP1E.ACIKKAPALI = "X"
			Doc2.Save_Voucher
		Next
		Doc2.LoadEmpty_Voucher

Sub Makro1()

	'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	If Kullanici="FX" Then
		Set LST = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")
		If LST.GetRowCount = 0 Then Exit Sub
		For i = 1 TO LST.GetRecCount()
			Doc.Load_Voucher LST.KOD(i)
			Doc.Delete_Voucher
		Next
		Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
	End If
End Sub

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub EskiSiparisleriListele
	Call MapaBaglan
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub MapaBaglan
	Set par = Doc.CreateSobject("Parameters")
	ServerName = "ftp://ftp.map.com.tr"
	InboxPath = "FORDOTO/Inbox/"
	
	If Doc.IsBlank(OTOSP1E) Then Set OTOSP1E = Doc.GetTableObject("OTOSP1E")
	
	FtpUsername = "ozenpres"
	FtpPassword = "0z3npr3s"
		
	kullanici = Trim(OTOSP1E.UID)
	sifre = Trim(OTOSP1E.PASSWORD)

	If kullanici = "" or Trim(sifre) = "" Then
		kullanici = FtpUsername
		sifre = FtpPassword
		OTOSP1E.UID = FtpUsername
		OTOSP1E.PASSWORD =FtpPassword
		'Doc.d7msgBox "Kullanýcý Adý ve Parola Girilmeli", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
		'Exit Sub
	End If
	
	FileName = InboxPath & "*.*"
	
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "FTP'ye baðlanýlýyor..."
	DosyaArr = Doc.FtpFindFile(ServerName, kullanici, sifre, FileName, par)
 
	If Not Doc.d7isArray(DosyaArr) Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Dosya Listesi Alýnamadý", "", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End If
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub GetDosyaList()
	Call MapaBaglan

	Set FTP_INFO = Doc.CreateTableObject("FTP_INFO=STACK", "IO")
	FTP_INFO.AddField2 "SERVER_ADI", "CHAR", 100,0,"L","",""
	FTP_INFO.AddField2 "FIX_REMOTE_PATH", "CHAR", 100,0,"L","",""

	FTP_INFO.SERVER_ADI = ServerName
	FTP_INFO.FIX_REMOTE_PATH = InboxPath

	Set FL = Doc.CreateTransactionalTableObject("FTP_DOSYA_LIST=STACK", "IO")
	FL.AddField2 "DOSYA_ADI", "CHAR", 100,0,"L","",""
	FL.AddField2 "DOSYA_BOYUTU", "DOUBLE", 10,0,"R","",""
	FL.AddField2 "DEGISIKLIK_TARIHI", "DATE", 10,0,"L","",""
	FL.AddField2 "DEGISIKLIK_SAATI", "CHAR", 8,0,"L","",""
	FL.AddField2 "SELECTED", "CHAR", 1, 0, "R", "", ""

	FL.SetRowAID 1,1,1
	FL.Empty

	For i = 0 to uBound(DosyaArr,1)
		satirNo = FL.AddRow
		
		Doc.StatusBarMessage "Aktarýlýyor : " & i+1 & uBound(DosyaArr,1) + 1

		DosyaAdi = DosyaArr(i,0)
		DosyaBoyutu = doc.Cdbl(DosyaArr(i,2))
		YaratilmaZamani = DosyaArr(i,3)
		SonErisimZamani = DosyaArr(i,4)
		SonDegisiklikZamani = DosyaArr(i,5)
		
		Arr1 = Split(trim(SonDegisiklikZamani), " ")
		
		If uBound(Arr1) = 1 Then
			DegisiklikTarihi = Arr1(0)
			DegisiklikSaati = Arr1(1)
		Else
			DegisiklikTarihi = ""
			DegisiklikSaati = ""
		End If

		If Doc.Bugun = DegisiklikTarihi Then
			FL.SELECTED(satirNo)  = "E"
			FL.DOSYA_ADI(satirNo) = DosyaAdi
			FL.DOSYA_BOYUTU(satirNo) = DosyaBoyutu
			FL.DEGISIKLIK_TARIHI(satirNo) = DegisiklikTarihi
			FL.DEGISIKLIK_SAATI(satirNo) = DegisiklikSaati
		Else
			FL.SELECTED(satirNo)  = "H"
		End If
	Next

	FL.Sort("<DEGISIKLIK_TARIHI+<DEGISIKLIK_SAATI")
	FL.SetRowAID 0,0,0
	
	Dim Par
	Set Par=Nothing
	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "GELENDOSYALAR", SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, Par

	'Msgbox FL.GetREcCount
End Sub
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub DosyaIndir()

	Set FL = Doc.GetTableObject("FTP_DOSYA_LIST")
	Set FTP_INFO = Doc.GetTableObject("FTP_INFO")

	FixRemotePath = Trim(FTP_INFO.FIX_REMOTE_PATH)
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

	local_path1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataRoot() & "\EDI\FORD\GELEN\"
	If Right(local_path1, 1) <> "\" Then local_path1 = local_path1 & "\"
	
	If Doc.IsBlank(OTOSP1E) Then Set OTOSP1E = Doc.GetTableObject("OTOSP1E")
	
	kullanici = Trim(OTOSP1E.UID)
	sifre = Trim(OTOSP1E.PASSWORD)

	For i=1 to FL.GetRecCount 
		If FL.SELECTED(i)="E" Then
			local_path = local_path1 & Trim(FL.DOSYA_ADI(i))
			remote_path = FixRemotePath & Trim(FL.DOSYA_ADI(i))

			k = FtpGet(kullanici, sifre, local_path, remote_path)
	
			'if trim(k) <> 0 Then local_path = ""
		End If
	Next 
	
	If k<>0 Then 
		Msgbox "Dosyalar Alýnamadý !!!"
	Else
		Msgbox "Dosyalar Alýndý"
	End If

End Sub
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function FtpGet(kullanici, sifre, local_path, remote_path)
	Set p=Doc.CreateSObject("Parameters")

	Set FTP_INFO = Doc.GetTableObject("FTP_INFO")
	ServerName = Trim(FTP_INFO.SERVER_ADI)

	'Call ParselURLGetPort(ServerName,Port)
	'if CInt(Port)>0 then
	'	p.SetParameter "PORT",CInt(Port)
	'end if

	FtpGet = Doc.FtpGetFile(ServerName, kullanici, sifre, remote_path, local_path, p)
End Function
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function Getd7Date(byVal Tarih)
	Tarih = trim(Tarih)
	if Len(Tarih) <> 8 Then Exit Function
	Getd7Date = Left(Tarih,4) & "/" & Mid(Tarih, 5, 2) & "/" & Right(Tarih, 2)
	Set d7Date = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	d7Date.SetDate Getd7Date
	if Not d7Date.IsValid Then Getd7Date = ""
End Function
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function Getd7Date2(byVal Tarih)
	Tarih = trim(Tarih)
	if Len(Tarih) < 8 Then Exit Function
	Getd7Date2 = Left(Tarih,4) & "/" & Mid(Tarih, 5, 2) & "/" & Mid(Tarih, 7, 2)
	Set d7Date = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	d7Date.SetDate Getd7Date2
	if Not d7Date.IsValid Then Getd7Date2 = ""
End Function

Function GetUDFStr()
	UDFStr = ""
'	Set U10T = Doc.Select1("dd333", "UFLD10T", "EVRAKNO='" & KTA_Adi & "'", "", -1)
	Set U10T = Doc.GetTableObject("UFLD10T")
	For i = 1 to U10T.GetRowCount()
		AlanAdi = trim(U10T.VARCODE(i))
		AlanIndex = U10T.VARINDEX(i)
		if trim(AlanIndex) <> "" Then
			AlanAdi = AlanAdi & "_" & trim(AlanIndex)
		End if
		Aciklama = trim(U10T.VARASPNAME(i))
		AlanTuru = trim(U10T.VARTYPE(i))
		Grupkodu = trim(U10T.VERIFIKASYONTEXT3(i))
		if AlanTuru = "D" Then
			UDFStr = UDFStr & "COMBOBOX D=" & AlanAdi & " CAPTION=" & Chr(34) & Aciklama & Chr(34) & vbCrLf
		Elseif AlanTuru = "T" and trim(Grupkodu) <> "" Then
			UDFStr = UDFStr & "COMBOBOX D=" & AlanAdi & " CAPTION=" & Chr(34) & Aciklama & Chr(34) & vbCrLf
		Else
			UDFStr = UDFStr & "EDITTEXT D=" & AlanAdi & " CAPTION=" & Chr(34) & Aciklama & Chr(34) & vbCrLf
		End if
	Next
	GetUDFStr = UDFStr
End Function

Function GetAddField2Str(TabloAdi, TabloAdiStr)
	TableStr = "Set MTableT=Doc.CreateTransactionalTableObject(""" & TabloAdiStr & "=STACK"",""IO"")" & vbcrlf

	Set U10T = Doc.GetTableObject("UFLD10T")
	For i = 1 to U10T.GetRowCount()
		AlanAdi = trim(U10T.VARCODE(i))
		AlanIndex = U10T.VARINDEX(i)
		if trim(AlanIndex) <> "" Then
			AlanAdi = AlanAdi & "_" & trim(AlanIndex)
		End if
		Aciklama = trim(U10T.VARASPNAME(i))
		AlanTuru = trim(U10T.VARTYPE(i))
		Grupkodu = trim(U10T.VERIFIKASYONTEXT3(i))
		Tablo = trim(U10T.VERIFIKASYONTEXT4(i))
		Uzunluk = U10T.VARLEN(i)
		Ondalik = U10T.VARSIG(i)
		if AlanTuru = "D" Then
			Str1 = TabloAdi & ".Addfield2 """ & AlanAdi & """, ""DATE"",10,0,""L"","""","""""
		Elseif AlanTuru = "T" and trim(Grupkodu) <> "" Then
			Str1 = TabloAdi & ".Addfield2 """ & AlanAdi & """, ""CHAR""," & Uzunluk & "," & Ondalik & ",""L"","""",Grupkodu"
		Elseif AlanTuru = "T" and trim(Tablo) <> "" Then
			Str1 = TabloAdi & ".Addfield2 """ & AlanAdi & """, ""CHAR""," & Uzunluk & "," & Ondalik & ",""L"",""F2=DO_BRW('"" & Tablo & ""')"","""""
		Elseif AlanTuru = "T" Then
			Str1 = TabloAdi & ".Addfield2 """ & AlanAdi & """, ""CHAR""," & Uzunluk & "," & Ondalik & ",""L"","""","""""
		Elseif AlanTuru = "N" Then
			Str1 = TabloAdi & ".Addfield2 """ & AlanAdi & """, ""DOUBLE""," & Uzunluk & "," & Ondalik & ",""R"","""","""""
		End if
		TableStr = TableStr & Chr(9) & Str1 & vbcrlf
	Next
	GetAddField2Str = TableStr
End Function

Sub MsgBoxToTxt(MesajBaslik, Mesaj)
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	tmpFolder = fso.GetSpecialFolder(2)
	dosyaAdi = tmpFolder & "\Hata.txt"
	Set HataFile = Fso.OpenTextFile(dosyaAdi, 2, True)
	HataFile.WriteLine(MesajBaslik & " : " & vbcrlf & Mesaj)
	HataFile.Close
	Set wshShell = CreateObject("WSCript.shell")
	wshshell.run "notepad " & dosyaAdi, 1, True
	set wshshell = nothing
End Sub

Sub AddAllFields(MTableT)
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("", "LISTET")
	For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)
		AlanAdi = Grid(i,0)
		if AlanAdi = "KOD" or AlanAdi = "AD" Then
			Aciklama = Grid(i,2)
			AlanTuru = Grid(i,4)
			Grupkodu = ""
			Tablo = ""
			Uzunluk = Grid(i,5)
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			if AlanTuru = "D" Then
				MTableT.Addfield2 AlanAdi, "DATE",10,0,"L","",""
			Elseif AlanTuru = "C" and trim(Grupkodu) <> "" Then
				MTableT.Addfield2 AlanAdi, "CHAR",Uzunluk,Ondalik,"L","",Grupkodu
			Elseif AlanTuru = "C" and trim(Tablo) <> "" Then
				MTableT.Addfield2 AlanAdi, "CHAR",Uzunluk,Ondalik,"L","F2=DO_BRW('" & Tablo & "')",""
			Elseif AlanTuru = "C" Then
				MTableT.Addfield2 AlanAdi, "CHAR",Uzunluk,Ondalik,"L","",""
			Elseif AlanTuru = "N" Then
				MTableT.Addfield2 AlanAdi, "DOUBLE",Uzunluk,Ondalik,"R","",""
			End if
		End if
	Next
End Sub

Sub AddUDEFFields(MTableT)
	Set U10T = Doc.Select1("dd333", "UFLD10T", "EVRAKNO='STOK00'", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to U10T.GetRowCount()
		AlanAdi = "UDEFF__" & trim(U10T.VARCODE(i))
		AlanIndex = U10T.VARINDEX(i)
		if trim(AlanIndex) <> "" Then
			AlanAdi = AlanAdi & "_" & trim(AlanIndex)
		End if
		Aciklama = trim(U10T.VARASPNAME(i))
		AlanTuru = trim(U10T.VARTYPE(i))
		Grupkodu = trim(U10T.VERIFIKASYONTEXT3(i))
		Tablo = trim(U10T.VERIFIKASYONTEXT4(i))
		Uzunluk = U10T.VARLEN(i)
		Ondalik = U10T.VARSIG(i)

		if AlanTuru = "D" Then
			MTableT.Addfield2 AlanAdi, "DATE",10,0,"L","",""
		Elseif AlanTuru = "T" and trim(Grupkodu) <> "" Then
			MTableT.Addfield2 AlanAdi, "CHAR",Uzunluk,Ondalik,"L","",Grupkodu
		Elseif AlanTuru = "T" and trim(Tablo) <> "" Then
			MTableT.Addfield2 AlanAdi, "CHAR",Uzunluk,Ondalik,"L","F2=DO_BRW('" & Tablo & "')",""
		Elseif AlanTuru = "T" Then
			MTableT.Addfield2 AlanAdi, "CHAR",Uzunluk,Ondalik,"L","",""
		Elseif AlanTuru = "N" Then
			MTableT.Addfield2 AlanAdi, "DOUBLE",Uzunluk,Ondalik,"R","",""
		End if
	Next
End Sub

Sub AlanlariDoldur(AnaTablo, MainTableT)
	MainTableT.Empty
	Alanlar1 = MainTableT.GetFieldNames("")
	For i = 1 to AnaTablo.GetRowCount()
		satirNo = MainTableT.AddRow()
		For each Alan in Alanlar1
			if InStr(1,Alan, "UDEFF__") > 0 or Alan = "KOD" or Alan = "AD" Then
				if InStr(1,Alan, "UDEFF__") = 0 Then
					AlanDegeri = LISTET.GetFieldValue(Alan, i)
				Else
					AlanAdiIndex = GetAlanAdiIndex(Mid(Alan, 8), "STOK00")
					KTA_Alan = AlanAdiIndex(0)
					KTA_Index = AlanAdiIndex(1)

					AlanDegeri = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", LISTET.KOD(i), KTA_Alan, KTA_Index)
				End if
				MainTableT.SetFieldValue Alan, satirNo, AlanDegeri
			End if
		Next
	Next
End Sub

Sub KTA_Yaz()
	Set MTableT = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLET")
	Set AnaTablo = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")
	Alanlar = MTableT.GetFieldNames("")
	For i = 1 to MTableT.GetRowCount()
		nret = Doc.UFLD00_CREATEEDITTABLE("T_U0001", "STOK00", MTableT.KOD(i))
		Set T_U1 = Doc.GetTableObject("T_U0001")   
		For each Alan in Alanlar
			if InStr(1,Alan, "UDEFF__") > 0 Then
				KTA_Alan = Mid(Alan, 8)
				AlanDegeri = MTableT.GetFieldValue(Alan, i)
				K = T_U1.SetFieldValue(KTA_Alan,-1,AlanDegeri)
				T_U1.Exec "SAVE" 
			End if
		Next 
	Next
End Sub
Function GetAlanAdiIndex(AlanAdi, KTA_Tablo)
	AlanAdi = trim(AlanAdi)
	Dim AlanArr(1)
	AlanArr(0) = AlanAdi
	AlanArr(1) = 0

	GetAlanAdiIndex = AlanArr
	tire = Instr(1,AlanAdi, "_")
	If tire = 0 Then Exit Function

	If Right(AlanAdi,1) =  "_" Then Exit Function
	If Right(AlanAdi,1) < "0" or Right(AlanAdi,1) > "9" Then Exit Function

	Set U10T = Doc.Select1("dd3333", "UFLD10T", "EVRAKNO='STOK00'&VARCODE='" & AlanAdi & "'", "", -1)
	if U10T.GetRowCount() > 0 and Len(AlanAdi) <= Len(U10T.VARCODE) Then Exit Function

	Uzunluk = Len(AlanAdi)
	if Uzunluk < 3 Then Exit Function
	For i = Uzunluk-1 to Uzunluk-3 step -1
		chr1 = Mid(AlanAdi, i, 1)
		if chr1 = "_" Then
			AlanArr(0) = Left(AlanAdi, i-1)
			AlanArr(1) = Doc.CDbl(Mid(AlanAdi, i+1))
		End if
	Next
	GetAlanAdiIndex = AlanArr
End Function
Function GetScreenWidthAndHeight()
	Dim ScrArr(1)
	ScrArr(0) = 0
	ScrArr(1) = 0

	Set IE = CreateObject("InternetExplorer.Application")
	IE.Visible = False
	IE.Navigate ("about:blank")
	Set Scr = IE.Document.parentWindow.screen
	Width = Scr.Width
	Height = Scr.Height
	AvailableWidth = Scr.availwidth
	AvailableHeight = Scr.availheight
	BitsPerPixel = Scr.colordepth

	ScrArr(0) = AvailableWidth
	ScrArr(1) = AvailableHeight

	Set Scr = Nothing
	IE.Quit
	Set IE = Nothing
	GetScreenWidthAndHeight = ScrArr
End Function

Function GetMainTableStr()
	MainTableStr = ""
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("", "LISTET")
	For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)
		AlanAdi = Grid(i,0)
		if AlanAdi = "KOD" or AlanAdi = "AD" Then
			Aciklama = Replace(Grid(i,2), "\n", " ")
			Aciklama = Replace(Aciklama, chr(13), " ")
			Aciklama = Replace(Aciklama, chr(10), " ")
			AlanTuru = Grid(i,4)
			Grupkodu = ""
			Tablo = ""
			if AlanTuru = "D" Then
				MainTableStr = MainTableStr & "COMBOBOX D=" & AlanAdi & " CAPTION=" & Chr(34) & Aciklama & Chr(34) & vbCrLf
			Elseif AlanTuru = "C" and trim(Grupkodu) <> "" Then
				MainTableStr = MainTableStr & "COMBOBOX D=" & AlanAdi & " CAPTION=" & Chr(34) & Aciklama & Chr(34) & vbCrLf
			Else
				MainTableStr = MainTableStr & "EDITTEXT D=" & AlanAdi & " CAPTION=" & Chr(34) & Aciklama & Chr(34) & vbCrLf
			End if
		End if
	Next
	GetMainTableStr = MainTableStr
End Function

Function GetUDFStr()
	UDFStr = ""
	Set U10T = Doc.Select1("dd333", "UFLD10T", "EVRAKNO='STOK00'", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to U10T.GetRowCount()
		AlanAdi = "UDEFF__" & trim(U10T.VARCODE(i))
		AlanIndex = U10T.VARINDEX(i)
		if trim(AlanIndex) <> "" Then
			AlanAdi = AlanAdi & "_" & trim(AlanIndex)
		End if
		Aciklama = trim(U10T.VARASPNAME(i))
		AlanTuru = trim(U10T.VARTYPE(i))
		Grupkodu = trim(U10T.VERIFIKASYONTEXT3(i))
		if AlanTuru = "D" Then
			UDFStr = UDFStr & "COMBOBOX D=" & AlanAdi & " CAPTION=" & Chr(34) & Aciklama & Chr(34) & vbCrLf
		Elseif AlanTuru = "T" and trim(Grupkodu) <> "" Then
			UDFStr = UDFStr & "COMBOBOX D=" & AlanAdi & " CAPTION=" & Chr(34) & Aciklama & Chr(34) & vbCrLf
		Else
			UDFStr = UDFStr & "EDITTEXT D=" & AlanAdi & " CAPTION=" & Chr(34) & Aciklama & Chr(34) & vbCrLf
		End if
	Next
	GetUDFStr = UDFStr
End Function

Sub Listele(Depo)
	Set MTABLEDEPOOZET = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLEDEPOOZET")
	MTABLEDEPOOZET.Empty

	Qstr = " SELECT "
	Qstr = Qstr & " S01_KOD, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " STOKADI, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " LOTNUMBER, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " S01_AMBCODE, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " SF_MIKTAR, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " SF_UNIT, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " SERINO, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " IRSALIYENO, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " SEVKTARIHI, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " BOYAKODU "
		
	Qstr = Qstr & " FROM "
	
	Qstr = Qstr & " ( "
	Qstr = Qstr & " (SELECT "

	Qstr = Qstr & " KOD S01_KOD, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " LOTNUMBER, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " SERINO, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " AMBCODE S01_AMBCODE, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " SF_UNIT, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " SF_MIKTAR, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " VRI_VR_R1 IRSALIYENO, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " VRI_VR_R2 SEVKTARIHI, "
	Qstr = Qstr & " VRI_VR_R3 BOYAKODU "
	
	Qstr = Qstr & " FROM STOK01)A "

	Qstr = Qstr & " LEFT JOIN "
	Qstr = Qstr & " (SELECT KOD MEVCUTDEPOKODU, GK_1 DEPOGK1 FROM GDEF00)B "
	Qstr = Qstr & " ON A.S01_AMBCODE = B.MEVCUTDEPOKODU "

	Qstr = Qstr & " LEFT JOIN "
	Qstr = Qstr & " (SELECT KOD, AD STOKADI FROM STOK00)C "
	Qstr = Qstr & " ON C.KOD = A.S01_KOD "
	Qstr = Qstr & " ) "
	
	Qstr = Qstr & " WHERE 1=1 "
	Qstr = Qstr & " AND DEPOGK1 LIKE 'FASON%' "
	
	If Depo = "F_KARA" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND S01_AMBCODE LIKE '"&Depo&"' "
	If Depo = "F_BOYA" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND S01_AMBCODE LIKE '"&Depo&"' "
	If Depo = "F_KAPS" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND S01_AMBCODE LIKE '"&Depo&"' "
	If Depo = "F_LEHM" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND S01_AMBCODE LIKE '"&Depo&"' "
	If Depo = "F_BECE" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND S01_AMBCODE LIKE '"&Depo&"' "
	If Depo = "F_RVY7" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND S01_AMBCODE LIKE '"&Depo&"' "
	If Depo = "F_ELIF" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND S01_AMBCODE LIKE '"&Depo&"' "
	If Depo = "F_NILI" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND S01_AMBCODE LIKE '"&Depo&"' "
	If Depo = "F_TEZE" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND S01_AMBCODE LIKE '"&Depo&"' "
	If Depo = "F_ALKA" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND S01_AMBCODE LIKE '"&Depo&"' "
	If Depo = "F_OSAL" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND S01_AMBCODE LIKE '"&Depo&"' "
	If Depo = "F_YALC" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND S01_AMBCODE LIKE '"&Depo&"' "
			
	If Depo = "" Then Qstr = Qstr & " AND 1=1 "
	
	Qstr = Qstr & " ORDER BY STOKADI DESC "

	Set S01 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("XXTTXX", Qstr)

	KayitSayisi = S01.GetRecCount
	
	If KayitSayisi = 0 Then Exit Sub
	
	Set MTABLEN = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLEN")
	'If Depo <> "" Then
	'	Set LL2 = Doc.Select2G("TTYYUU", "XXTTXX", "S01_AMBCODE='"&Depo&"'", "", "S01_KOD+S01_AMBCODE", -1)
	'Else
		Set LL2 = Doc.Select2G("TTASASUU", "XXTTXX", "", "", "S01_KOD", -1)
	'End If
	
	KayitSayisi2 = LL2.GetRecCount
		
	If Depo = "F_KARA" Then MTABLEN.F_KARA_S = KayitSayisi2
	If Depo = "F_BOYA" Then MTABLEN.F_BOYA_S = KayitSayisi2
	If Depo = "F_KAPS" Then MTABLEN.F_KAPS_S = KayitSayisi2		
	If Depo = "F_LEHM" Then MTABLEN.F_LEHM_S = KayitSayisi2		
	If Depo = "F_BECE" Then MTABLEN.F_BECE_S = KayitSayisi2		
	If Depo = "F_RVY7" Then MTABLEN.F_RVY7_S = KayitSayisi2	
	If Depo = "F_ELIF" Then MTABLEN.F_ELIF_S = KayitSayisi2	
	If Depo = "F_NILI" Then MTABLEN.F_NILI_S = KayitSayisi2
	If Depo = "F_TEZE" Then MTABLEN.F_TEZE_S = KayitSayisi2
	If Depo = "F_ALKA" Then MTABLEN.F_ALKA_S = KayitSayisi2
	If Depo = "F_OSAL" Then MTABLEN.F_OSAL_S = KayitSayisi2
	If Depo = "F_YALC" Then MTABLEN.F_YALC_S = KayitSayisi2
	If Depo = "" Then MTABLEN.TUMU = KayitSayisi2
	
	MTABLEDEPOOZET.SetRowAID 1,1,1
	
	'OZET
	For i = 1 to KayitSayisi2
		Doc.StatusBarMessage "Depo Mevcutlarý Getiriliyor : " & i & " / " & KayitSayisi2
		satirNo = MTABLEDEPOOZET.AddRow()
		MTABLEDEPOOZET.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
		
		Depo = Trim(LL2.S01_AMBCODE(i))
		Miktar = LL2.SF_MIKTAR(i)
		
		MTABLEDEPOOZET.KOD = LL2.S01_KOD(i)
		MTABLEDEPOOZET.KOD_STOK00_AD = LL2.STOKADI(i)  
		MTABLEDEPOOZET.AMBCODE = Depo
		MTABLEDEPOOZET.SF_MIKTAR = Miktar
		MTABLEDEPOOZET.SF_UNIT = LL2.SF_UNIT(i)

		If Depo = "F_KARA" Then MTABLEDEPOOZET.F_KARA = Miktar
		If Depo = "F_BOYA" Then MTABLEDEPOOZET.F_BOYA = Miktar
		If Depo = "F_KAPS" Then MTABLEDEPOOZET.F_KAPS = Miktar			
		If Depo = "F_LEHM" Then MTABLEDEPOOZET.F_LEHM = Miktar		
		If Depo = "F_BECE" Then MTABLEDEPOOZET.F_BECE = Miktar		
		If Depo = "F_RVY7" Then MTABLEDEPOOZET.F_RVY7 = Miktar	
		If Depo = "F_ELIF" Then MTABLEDEPOOZET.F_ELIF = Miktar	
		If Depo = "F_NILI" Then MTABLEDEPOOZET.F_NILI = Miktar
		If Depo = "F_TEZE" Then MTABLEDEPOOZET.F_TEZE = Miktar
		If Depo = "F_ALKA" Then MTABLEDEPOOZET.F_ALKA = Miktar
		If Depo = "F_OSAL" Then MTABLEDEPOOZET.F_OSAL = Miktar
		If Depo = "F_YALC" Then MTABLEDEPOOZET.F_YALC = Miktar
	Next

	MTABLEDEPOOZET.SetRowAID 0,0,0
	MTABLEDEPOOZET.SetCurrentRow(1)
	Set LL2 = Nothing
End Sub

		If Depo = "F_NILI" Then MTABLEDEPODETAY.F_NILI = Miktar
		If Depo = "F_TEZE" Then MTABLEDEPODETAY.F_TEZE = Miktar
		If Depo = "F_ALKA" Then MTABLEDEPODETAY.F_ALKA = Miktar
		If Depo = "F_OSAL" Then MTABLEDEPODETAY.F_OSAL = Miktar
		If Depo = "F_YALC" Then MTABLEDEPODETAY.F_YALC = Miktar
	Next

Sub StokKodunuEkle
	Set S00X = Doc.Select2("dsda", "MAKROTABLES", "SELECTED='E'", "", -1)
	KayitSayisi = S00X.GetRecCount
	
	If KayitSayisi = 0 Then
		Msgbox "Seçili Satýr Bulunamadý..."
		Exit Sub
	End If

	Set S63T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK63T")
	
	For i = 1 To KayitSayisi
		StokKodu = Trim(S00X.KOD(i))
		SevkMik = S00X.SEVKMIKTARI(i)

		SatirNo = S63T.AddRow
		S63T.SetCurrentRow(SatirNo)

		S63T.KOD = StokKodu 
		Doc.CallFieldAfterValidate_Row "STOK63T", "KOD", SatirNo
		S63T.SF_MIKTAR = SevkMik
	Next

	S63T.SafePack
	Call Kapat
End Sub

Sub Aktarilacaklar
	Set MTABLES = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLES")
	If MTABLES.SEVKMIKTARI > 0 Then
		MTABLES.SELECTED = "E"
	Else
		MTABLES.SELECTED = "H"
	End If
End Sub

Sub StokSec
	Set S60E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60E")
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
	
	CariKodu = S60E.CH_KODU
	
	If Trim(CariKodu) = "" Then
		Msgbox "Önce Cari Kodu Seçilmelidir..."
		Exit Sub
	End If

 	Set Par=Nothing
 	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "FORM_STOKSEC", SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, Par

	CariKodu = S60E.CH_KODU

	'Set S00 = Doc.Select1("d3rrr4gh1", "STOK00", "GK_6='FASON-GIT'", "", -1)
	
	Qstr = "SELECT KOD, AD, GK_7, AP10 FROM STOK00"
	Qstr = Qstr & " WHERE 1=1 "
	Qstr = Qstr & " AND (Trim(GK_6) = 'FASON-GIT' OR Trim(GK_6) = 'FSN-GELGÝT') AND AP10 = '1'  AND Trim(GK_7) IS NOT NULL "
	Qstr = Qstr & " ORDER BY GK_7 DESC"

	Set S00 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("SQLTbl", Qstr)

	KayitSayisi = S00.GetRecCount
	
	If KayitSayisi = 0 Then
		Exit Sub
	End If

	Set MTableS = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLES")
	MTableS.Empty

	For i = 1 To KayitSayisi 
		StokKodu = Trim(S00.KOD(i))
		AktifPasif = S00.AP10(i)

		StokAdi = Trim(S00.AD(i))
		BoyaKodu = Trim(S00.GK_7(i))

		SatirNo = MTableS.AddRow
		MTableS.SetCurrentRow(SatirNo)

		MTableS.KOD = StokKodu 
		MTableS.AD = StokAdi 
		MTableS.BOYAKODU = BoyaKodu
	Next

	MTableS.SetCurrentRow(1)

End Sub

Sub CariYaz(CariKodu)
	Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
	Set S60E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60E")
	Set S63T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK63T")
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")	
	Set MTableS = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLES")

	EvrakNo = Trim(S60E.EVRAKNO)

	If EvrakNo = "" Then
		ret = Doc.New_Voucher
		S60E.AMBCODE = "FS-1"
		S60E.TARGETAMBCODE = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("KTA_CARI00", CariKodu, "DEPOSU",0))
		S60E.RSEVKTARIH = S60E.TARIH
		S60E.RSEVKSAAT = Doc.Saat(5)
	End If

	S60E.CH_KODU = CariKodu 
	Doc.CallFieldAfterValidate_Row "STOK60E", "CH_KODU", -1
		
	S63T.Empty
End Sub

Makro Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : OPS_2016 / Uygulama : MAKR7S
Makro Kodu : OTOSP1-01
Hangi Tablo için : OTOSP1
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : FOSN
Açýklama : Günlük programý satýþ sipariþine aktarma
Kod : 
Sub Makro1()
	OburGun = Doc.StrDate_Increment(Doc.BuGun,2)
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK40T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set ST40 = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")

	OTOSP1L.SafePack()
	if OTOSP1L.GetRecCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
	Firma = trim(OTOSP1L.ARA_SEVK(1))
	if Firma = "AS3WA" Then
		SipOnek = "D"
	ElseIf Firma = "ASDLA" Then
		SipOnek = "A"
	ElseIf Firma = "DUF4A" Then
		SipOnek = "0"
	ElseIf Firma = "AS4UA" Then
		SipOnek = "S"
	Else
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("Firma tanýmlý deðil", "Hata", MB_OK)
		Exit Sub
	End if
	For i = 1 to OTOSP1L.GetRecCount()
		Doc.StatusbarMessage "Sipariþler okunuyor : " & i & " / " & OTOSP1L.GetRecCount()
		Attrib = OTOSP1L.ATTRIB(i)
		TesTarih = OTOSP1L.RTESTARIH(i)
		Miktar = OTOSP1L.SF_MIKTAR(i)
		StokKodu = OTOSP1L.KOD(i)
		if ((Attrib = "G" and TesTarih >= OburGun)) and Miktar > 0 and _
				(trim(OTOSP1L.SEVK_EDILEN_FB(i)) <> "AUF9A" and trim(OTOSP1L.SEVK_EDILEN_FB(i)) <> "CVR1B") then
	
			ST40.AddRow
			satirNo = ST40.GetRecCount()
			ST40.KOD(satirNo) = StokKodu
			ST40.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo) = Miktar
			ST40.RTESTARIH(satirNo) = TesTarih
			ST40.REV_RTESTARIH(satirNo) = TesTarih
			ST40.CHSIPANO(satirNo) = OTOSP1L.SEVK_EDILEN_FB(i)
			ST40.ACIKKAPALI(satirNo) = Attrib
		end if
	Next
	ST40.Sort("REV_RTESTARIH+CHSIPNO")	

'	Call ExceleYaz(ST40)
'	exit sub

	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK40","")
	Set K = Doc1.CreateSObject("BATCHUPDATEMODE")
	Set ST40E = Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK40E")
	Set ST40T = Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK40T")

	EvrakSayisi = 10
	EvrakSatirSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Doc.Div(ST40.GetRecCount(), EvrakSayisi))
	SiparisSiraNo = 0
	For i = 1 to ST40.GetRecCount()
		if i mod EvrakSatirSayisi = 1 and i <> 1 then
			nret = Doc1.Save_Voucher()
			if nret <> 0 then
				k = doc.d7MsgBox(ST40E.EVRAKNO & " no.lu evrak kaydedilemedi. Ýþlem kesilmiþtir","dinamo",MB_OK)
				Exit Sub
			end if
			SiparisSiraNo = SiparisSiraNo + 1
			EvrakNo = SipOnek & SiparisSiraNO
			nret = Doc1.Load_Voucher(EvrakNo)
			if nret <> 0 then
				k = doc.d7MsgBox(EvrakNo & " no.lu evrak yüklenemedi. Ýþlem kesilmiþtir","dinamo",MB_OK)
				Exit Sub
			end if
			ST40T.Empty
			ST40E.MUSTERIKODU = OTOSP1E.CH_KODU
			ST40E.SHIPTOCODE = ""
			ST40E.TARIH = Doc.BuGun
			ST40E.GK_1 = "FOSN"
			ST40E.HOLDTOSEVK = "E"
		elseif i = 1 then
			EvrakNo = SipOnek & "0"
			nret = Doc1.Load_Voucher(EvrakNo)
			if nret <> 0 then
				k = doc.d7MsgBox(EvrakNo & " no.lu evrak yüklenemedi. Ýþlem kesilmiþtir","dinamo",MB_OK)
				Exit Sub
			end if
			ST40T.Empty
			ST40E.MUSTERIKODU = OTOSP1E.CH_KODU
			ST40E.SHIPTOCODE = ""
			ST40E.TARIH = Doc.BuGun
			ST40E.GK_1 = "FOSN"
			ST40E.HOLDTOSEVK = "E"
		end if
		Doc.StatusbarMessage "Sipariþ oluþturuluyor : " & EvrakNo & " - " & i & " / " & ST40.GetRecCount()
		ST40T.AddRow
		satirNo = ST40T.GetRecCount()
		ST40T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
		ST40T.KOD(satirNo) = ST40.KOD(i)
		ST40T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo) = ST40.SF_MIKTAR(i)
		ST40T.RTESTARIH(satirNo) = ST40.RTESTARIH(i)
		ST40T.CHSIPANO(satirNo) = ST40.CHSIPANO(i)
		ST40T.REV_RTESTARIH(satirNo) = ST40.REV_RTESTARIH(i)
	Next
	nret = Doc1.Save_Voucher()
	if nret <> 0 then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox(ST40E.EVRAKNO & " no.lu evrak kaydedilemedi. Ýþlem kesilmiþtir","dinamo",MB_OK)
		Exit Sub
	end if
	nret = Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher()
	Msgbox "Tamam"
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	EvrakListe = "E"
	TBL_E_Name = "STOK70E"
	TBL_T_Name = "STOK70T"
	index = 1
	MSGBOX NOTES(EvrakListe,TBL_E_Name,TBL_T_Name,index)

Function GetMusteri(CHKodu)
	GetMusteri = ""

	Select Case trim(CHKodu)
		Case "12010T01"
			GetMusteri = "TOFAÞ"
		Case "12010F01", "12010F03", "12010F04", "12020F04", "12020F05"
			GetMusteri = "FORD"
		Case "M T004"
			GetMusteri = "TÜRK TRAKTÖR"
		Case "120 10 01 004"
			GetMusteri = "RENAULT"
		Case "120 10 01 009"
			GetMusteri = "MAGNETI MARELLI MAKO"
		Case "120 03 003"
			GetMusteri = "ARÇELÝK"
		Case "120 03 003"
			GetMusteri = "ÜLKER"
	End Select
End Function

Function PAYMENTMEANS(EvrakListe,TBL_E_Name,TBL_T_Name,index) 'EvrakListe "E" ise üzerinde bulunal faturadan,  "L" ise liste sayfasýndan , 'index -1 ise dikkate alýnmamalý
	'PaymentMeans/PaymentMeansCode: Ödeme þeklinin kodu girilir. Bu eleman için UN/EDIFACT 4461 Ödeme Çeþitleri Kod Listesi kullanýlacaktýr.
	'PaymentMeans/PaymentDueDate: Son ödeme günü yýl-ay-gün formatýnda girilir.
	'PaymentMeans/PaymentChannelCode: Ödeme kanalý kodu girilir.
	'PaymentMeans/InstructionNote: Ödeme ile ilgili açýklamalar serbest metin olarak girilir.

	Doc.TempParameters_Set "PaymentMeans/PaymentMeansCode","2" 'sabit gurup kodu <<|EFTRU4461>>

	Doc.TempParameters_Set "PayeeFinancialAccount/ID","IBANTR12345567"
	Doc.TempParameters_Set "PayeeFinancialAccount/CurrencyCode","EURO" 'Dolu olmalý
	Doc.TempParameters_Set "PayeeFinancialAccount/PaymentNote","PayeeFinancialAccount/PaymentNote"

Function ORDERREFERENCE(EvrakListe,TBL_E_Name,TBL_T_Name,index) 'index -1 ise dikkate alýnmamalý
	Set TableE = Doc.GetTableObject(TBL_E_Name)
	Set TableT = Doc.GetTableObject(TBL_T_Name)
	if GetMusteri(TableE.CH_KODU) = "TOFAÞ" Then
		SiparisNo = GetTofasSipNo(TableE, TableT)
		SiparisTarihi = TableE.TARIH
		if trim(SiparisNo) = "" Then
			Doc.SetErrorNumber(1)
		End if
	Elseif GetMusteri(TableE.CH_KODU) = "FORD" Then
		SiparisNo = GetFordSipNo(TableE, TableT)
		SiparisTarihi = TableE.TARIH
		if trim(SiparisNo) = "" Then
			Doc.SetErrorNumber(1)
		End if
	Elseif GetMusteri(TableE.CH_KODU) = "MAGNETI MARELLI MAKO" Then
		Call GetCHSipNoTarih(TableE.EVRAKNO, SiparisNo, SiparisTarihi)

		if trim(SiparisNo) = "" Then
			Doc.SetErrorNumber(1)
		End if
	End if

	if trim(SiparisNo) <> "" Then
		Doc.TempParameters_Set "OrderReference/ID",SiparisNo
		Doc.TempParameters_Set "OrderReference/IssueDate", SiparisTarihi
		ORDERREFERENCE=TRUE
	End if
End Function

Function NOTES(EvrakListe,TBL_E_Name,TBL_T_Name,index) 'index -1 ise dikkate alýnmamalý
	NOTES = False

	Set TableE = Doc.GetTableObject(TBL_E_Name)
	Set TableT = Doc.GetTableObject(TBL_T_Name)
	count_note = 1
	if trim(TableE.S60_NOTES_1) <> "" Then
		Doc.TempParameters_Set "Note_" & count_note, trim(TableE.S60_NOTES_1)
		count_note = count_note  + 1
			NOTES = TRUE
	end if 
	if trim(TableE.S60_NOTES_2) <> "" Then
		Doc.TempParameters_Set "Note_" & count_note, trim(TableE.S60_NOTES_2)
		count_note = count_note  + 1
			NOTES = TRUE
	end if 
	if trim(TableE.S60_NOTES_3) <> "" Then
		Doc.TempParameters_Set "Note_" & count_note, trim(TableE.S60_NOTES_3)
		count_note = count_note  + 1
			NOTES = TRUE
	end if 
	if trim(TableE.S60_NOTES_4) <> "" Then
		Doc.TempParameters_Set "Note_" & count_note, trim(TableE.S60_NOTES_4)
		count_note = count_note  + 1
			NOTES = TRUE
	end if 
	
		yazi = Doc.Round(TableE.TL_KDVDAHILTOPLAM,2)
		son = ""
		pb =  trim(TableE.CH_KUR)
		
		if instr(Doc.NumToText(yazi),"%") > 0 Then
			if pb = "TL" Then
				son = "Kr"
			else	
				son = "Cent"
			end if 
		end if 
		Yalniz = replace(Doc.NumToText(yazi),"%" , pb) & son

		count_note = count_note  + 1
		Doc.TempParameters_Set "Note_" & count_note, "Yalnýz" & Yalniz	
		count_note = count_note  + 1
	Set s_70e = Doc.Select1("DSFDF", "STOK70E", "EVRAKNO='"&TableE.EVRAKNO&"' ", "" ,-1)
	Set s_70T = Doc.Select1("ERETT", "STOK70T", "EVRAKNO='"&TableE.EVRAKNO&"' ", "" ,-1)
	Doc.TempParameters_Set "Note_" & count_note, "Kur : " & " 1 " & trim(s_70T.PRICEUNIT(1)) & " " & Doc.NumFormat(s_70T.KUR(1),16,4) & "  TL" 
	count_note = count_note  + 1
	
	if trim(s_70e.CH_KUR)="TL" Then
		dv_dr = Doc.Div(s_70e.CH_KDVDAHILTOPLAM, s_70T.KUR(1))
		Doc.TempParameters_Set "Note_" & count_note, "Döviz Deðeri : " & Doc.NumFormat(dv_dr,16,2 ) & " " & trim(s_70T.PRICEUNIT(1)) 
		count_note = count_note  + 1
	else 	
		tl_dr = s_70e.CH_KDVDAHILTOPLAM * s_70T.KUR(1)
		Doc.TempParameters_Set "Note_" & count_note, "TL Deðeri : " & Doc.NumFormat(tl_dr,16,2 ) & "  TL"
		count_note = count_note  + 1
	end if 
		
	Doc.TempParameters_Set "Note_" & count_note, "Vade : " & Doc.StrToNorDate(s_70e.VALORTARIH)
	count_note = count_note  + 1

End Function

Function CUSTOMERMAIL(EvrakListe,TBL_E_Name,TBL_T_Name,index) 'index -1 ise dikkate alýnmamalý
	Set TableE = Doc.GetTableObject(TBL_E_Name)
	Set TableT = Doc.GetTableObject(TBL_T_Name)
	if GetMusteri(TableE.CH_KODU) = "TOFAÞ" Then
		CUSTOMERMAIL = "dm@tofas.com.tr"
	Elseif GetMusteri(TableE.CH_KODU) = "ARÇELÝK" Then
		if trim(TableE.SHIPTOCODE) = "" Then
			Doc.d7MsgBox "Sevk Adres kodu seçilmemiþ", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
			Doc.SetErrorNumber(1) 
			Exit Function
		End if
		Set S0J = Doc.RunSQLQuery("ASDag", "SELECT EMAIL FROM SHPT00J WHERE EVRAKNO='" & Doc.RightJustify(trim(TableE.SHIPTOCODE), 10) & "'")
		if S0J.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
			Doc.d7MsgBox "Geçersiz sevk adres kodu", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
			Doc.SetErrorNumber(1) 
			Exit Function
		Else
			eMail = trim(S0J.EMAIL)
			if eMail = "" Then
				Doc.d7MsgBox "Sevk adres kartýnda e-mail adresi girilmemiþ", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
				Doc.SetErrorNumber(1) 
				Exit Function
			End if
		End if
		CUSTOMERMAIL = eMail
	End if
End Function

Function GetTofasSipNo(TableE, TableT)
	Vade = Doc.CDateToInt(TableE.VALORTARIH) - Doc.CDateToInt(TableE.TARIH)
	if Vade >= 85 Then
		GetTofasSipNo = "200017518122013Z012"
	Elseif Vade >= 55 and Vade <= 65 Then
		GetTofasSipNo = "200017519122013Z007"
	End if
End Function
Sub GetCHSipNoTarih(FaturaNo, SipNo, Tarih)
	SipNo = ""
	Tarih = ""
	QStr = "SELECT EVRAKNO, CHSIPNO, TARIH"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK40E E"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE EVRAKNO IN ("
	QStr = QStr & "   SELECT SIPNO FROM STOK70T WHERE EVRAKNO='" & Doc.RightJustify(trim(FaturaNo), 10) & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " )"
	QStr = QStr & " ORDER BY E.EVRAKNO"

	Set S40E = Doc.RunSQLQuery("asdfasdgar", QStr)
	if S40E.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
	
	For i = 1 to S40E.GetRowCount()
		if trim(S40E.CHSIPNO(i)) = "" Then
			Doc.d7MsgBox "Sipariþ No : " & trim(S40E.EVRAKNO(i)) & " müþteri sipariþ no girilmemiþ", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
			Exit Sub
		End if
		if trim(SipNo) <> "" Then SipNo = SipNo & ","
		SipNo = SipNo & trim(S40E.CHSIPNO(1))

		if trim(Tarih) <> "" Then Tarih = Tarih & ","
		Tarih = Tarih & Replace(S40E.TARIH(1), "/", "-")
	Next
End Sub
Sub GetIrsaliyeNoTarih(FaturaNo, IrsaliyeNo, IrsaliyeTarihi)
	IrsaliyeNo = ""
	IrsaliyeTarihi = ""
	QStr = "SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(E.OR_IRSALIYESIRANO) IS NULL THEN TRIM(E.EVRAKNO) ELSE TRIM(E.OR_IRSALIYESIRANO) END IRSALIYE_NO,"
	QStr = QStr & "  E.TARIH"
	QStr = QStr & "  FROM STOK60E E"
	QStr = QStr & "  WHERE EVRAKNO IN ("
	QStr = QStr & "    SELECT IRSALIYENO FROM STOK70T WHERE EVRAKNO='" & Doc.RightJustify(trim(FaturaNo), 10) & "'"
	QStr = QStr & "  )"
	QStr = QStr & " ORDER BY E.EVRAKNO"
	Set S60E = Doc.RunSQLQuery("asdfasdgar", QStr)
	if S60E.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub

	For i = 1 to S60E.GetRowCount()
		if trim(IrsaliyeNo) <> "" Then IrsaliyeNo = IrsaliyeNo & "-"
		IrsaliyeNo = IrsaliyeNo & trim(S60E.IRSALIYE_NO(1))

		if trim(IrsaliyeTarihi) <> "" Then IrsaliyeTarihi = IrsaliyeTarihi & ","
		IrsaliyeTarihi = IrsaliyeTarihi & Replace(S60E.TARIH(1), "/", "-")
	Next
End Sub

Function TABLOLAR(EvrakListe,TBL_E_Name,TBL_T_Name)
	Set TableE = Doc.GetTableObject(TBL_E_Name)
	Set TableT = Doc.GetTableObject(TBL_T_Name)
	if GetMusteri(TableE.CH_KODU) = "MAGNETI MARELLI MAKO" Then
		Call GetIcmalTable(TBL_E_Name,TBL_T_Name, "IRSALIYENO")
		TABLOLAR=TRUE 'iþlem yapýldý ise TRUE olmalý.
	Else
		Call GetIcmalTable(TBL_E_Name,TBL_T_Name, "")
		TABLOLAR=TRUE 'iþlem yapýldý ise TRUE olmalý.
	End if
End Function

Sub GetIcmalTable(TBL_E_Name,TBL_T_Name, EkIcmalStr)
	IcmalStr = "KOD+KDV_ORANI+KDVTYPE+KDVMUAFTYPE+KDVMUAFTYPE_NOT+YVERART_1+OTVTYPE+OR_FIYAT+TL_FIYAT+PRICEUNIT+ISKONTO_EFEKTIF+KUR"
	if trim(EkIcmalStr) <> "" Then
		IcmalStr = IcmalStr & "+" & EkIcmalStr
	End if
	Set TBL_T=Doc.GetTableObject(TBL_T_Name)

	Set TBL_Icmal = Doc.Select2G("_3333_TRTTT", TBL_T_Name, "NONE", "","",-1)
	TBL_Icmal.Empty

	Call IcmalAlanlariniEkle(TBL_Icmal, IcmalStr, YeniIcmalStr)

	Call TabloyuEkle(TBL_Icmal, TBL_T)

	Call YeniIcmalAlanlarinaAktar(TBL_Icmal, IcmalStr, YeniIcmalStr)

	TBL_Icmal.GroupBy2(YeniIcmalStr)

	Call OncekiAlanlaraGeriYaz(TBL_Icmal, IcmalStr, YeniIcmalStr)
	
	Call OrijinalTabloyaGeriAktar(TBL_Icmal, TBL_T)

	'Doc.ShowTableDynForm2 TBL_Icmal.GetAppName, Replace(IcmalStr, "+", ",") & "," & Replace(YeniIcmalStr, "+", ",")
End Sub
Sub IcmalAlanlariniEkle(TBL_Icmal, IcmalStr, YeniIcmalStr)
	IcmalStr = Replace(IcmalStr, " ", "")
	IcmalAlanArr = Split(IcmalStr, "+")
	YeniIcmalStr = ""
	For Each AlanAdi in IcmalAlanArr
		YeniAlan = AlanAdi & "_STR"
		TBL_Icmal.AddField2 YeniAlan,"CHAR",30,0,"L","",""
		if trim(YeniIcmalStr) <> "" Then YeniIcmalStr = YeniIcmalStr & "+"
		YeniIcmalStr = YeniIcmalStr & YeniAlan
	Next
End Sub
Sub YeniIcmalAlanlarinaAktar(TBL_Icmal, IcmalStr, YeniIcmalStr)
	Set TBLT = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	IcmalAlanArr = Split(IcmalStr, "+")
	YeniIcmalAlanArr = Split(YeniIcmalStr, "+")
	For i = 1 to TBL_Icmal.GetRowCount()
		For j = 0 to uBound(IcmalAlanArr)
			AlanAdi = IcmalAlanArr(j)
			YeniIcmalAlanAdi = YeniIcmalAlanArr(j)

			AlanDegeri = TBL_Icmal.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i)

			TBL_Icmal.SetFieldValueNV YeniIcmalAlanAdi, i, CStr(AlanDegeri)
		Next
	Next
End Sub
Sub OncekiAlanlaraGeriYaz(TBL_Icmal, IcmalStr, YeniIcmalStr)
	Set TBLT = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")

	IcmalAlanArr = Split(IcmalStr, "+")
	YeniIcmalAlanArr = Split(YeniIcmalStr, "+")
	For i = 1 to TBL_Icmal.GetRowCount()
		For j = 0 to uBound(IcmalAlanArr)
			AlanAdi = IcmalAlanArr(j)
			YeniIcmalAlanAdi = YeniIcmalAlanArr(j)
			AlanDegeri = TBL_Icmal.GetFieldValue(YeniIcmalAlanAdi, i)
			if NumerikMi(TBLT, AlanAdi) Then
				AlanDegeri = Doc.Cdbl(AlanDegeri)
			Else
				AlanDegeri = RTrim(AlanDegeri)
			End if
			TBL_Icmal.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, i, AlanDegeri
		Next
	Next	
End Sub
Function NumerikMi(Tablo, AlanAdi)
	Set AlanBilgisi = Tablo.GetFieldDef(AlanAdi)
	if AlanBilgisi.IsNumeric() Then
		NumerikMi = True
	Else
		NumerikMi = False
	End if
End Function
Sub TabloyuEkle(TBL_Icmal, TBL_T)
	For i = 1 to TBL_T.GetRowCount()
		satirNo = TBL_Icmal.AddRow
		TBL_Icmal.CopyRowFromOtherTable_SimilarFields_S satirNo, TBL_T, i
	Next
End Sub
Sub OrijinalTabloyaGeriAktar(YeniTable, EskiTable)
	EskiTable.Empty
	For i = 1 to YeniTable.GetRowCount()
		satirNo = EskiTable.AddRow
		EskiTable.CopyRowFromOtherTable_SimilarFields_S satirNo, YeniTable, i
	Next
End Sub
Function HalkaliDepolar()
	HalkaliDepolar = False
	QStr = "SELECT DISTINCT AMBCODE"
	QStr = QStr & "  FROM STOK60E E"
	QStr = QStr & "  WHERE EVRAKNO IN ("
	QStr = QStr & "    SELECT IRSALIYENO FROM STOK70T WHERE EVRAKNO='" & Doc.RightJustify(trim(FaturaNo), 10) & "'"
	QStr = QStr & "  )"
	QStr = QStr & " AND E.AMBCODE IN('IM1','MA1','MA2','MA3')"
	Set S60E = Doc.RunSQLQuery("asdfasdgar", QStr)
	if S60E.GetRowCount() > 0 Then HalkaliDepolar = True
End Function
Sub GetFTTable(TBL_E_Name,TBL_T_Name)
	Set TBL_T = Doc.GetTableObject(TBL_T_Name)
	For i = 1 to TBL_T.GetRowCount()
		if trim(TBL_T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)) = "KG" then
			TBL_T.SF_MIKTAR(i) = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK70T",TBL_T.ARTNO(i), "ADET",0)
			if TBL_T.SF_MIKTAR(i) = 0 Then
				Doc.d7MsgBox i & ". satýr KTA 'ya miktar girilmemiþ", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
				Doc.SetErrorNumber(1)
				Exit Sub
			End if
			TBL_T.SF_SF_UNIT(i) = "Adt"

			TBL_T.TL_FIYAT(i) = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK70T",TBL_T.ARTNO(i), "FIYAT",0)
			if TBL_T.TL_FIYAT(i) = 0 Then
				Doc.d7MsgBox i & ". satýr KTA 'ya fiyat girilmemiþ", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
				Doc.SetErrorNumber(1)
				Exit Sub
			End if
		End if
	Next
End Sub
Function GetFordSipNo(TableE, TableT)
	GetFordSipNo = ""
	SipNoStr = TableE.S60_NOTES_1
	if trim(SipNoStr) = "" Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Notlar 1 'e Ford referans numarasý (IN, FR, YTS, CPX v.b.) yazýlmalýdýr", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
		Exit Function
	End if
	if InStr(1, trim(SipNoStr),"IN") = 1 or InStr(1, trim(SipNoStr),"FR") = 1 Then
		if Not ((InStr(1, trim(SipNoStr),"IN") = 1 and Len(trim(SipNoStr)) = 8) _
					or (InStr(1, trim(SipNoStr),"FR") = 1) and Len(trim(SipNoStr)) = 7) Then
			Doc.d7MsgBox "Notlar 1 'e 8 haneli IN ya da 7 haneli FR numarasý yazýlmalýdýr", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
			Exit Function
		End if
		SiparisNo = "SBIIN_" & Right(String(20,"0") & trim(SipNoStr), 20)
	Else
		SiparisNo = trim(SipNoStr)
	End if
	if Len(SiparisNo) <> 26 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Not-1 alanýndaki sipariþ No hatalý. IN ile baþlayan numaralar 8 hane, FR ile baþlayan numaralar 7 hane, diðerleri 26 hane olmalýdýr", "Ýþlem kesildi", MB_OK
		Exit Function
	End if
	GetFordSipNo = SiparisNo
End Function

Function Makro1()
	Doc.WinMaximize
	Set MTable = Doc.CreateTableObject("MAKROTABLE=STACK", "IO")
	MTable.AddField2 "B_KOD","CHAR",24,0,"L","F2=DO_BRW('STOK00')",""

	MTable.AddField2 "SERINO","CHAR",20,0,"L","",""
	MTable.AddField2 "E_TARIH","DATE",10,0,"L","",""
	MTable.AddField2 "MUSTERIKODU","CHAR",16,0,"L","F2=DO_BRW('CARI00')",""
	MTable.AddField2 "MUSTERIADI","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	MTable.AddField2 "MUSTERISIPINO","CHAR",10,0,"R","F2=DO_BRW('STOK40E')",""
	MTable.AddField2 "REZERVE","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	MTable.AddField2 "AMBCODE","CHAR",6,0,"L","F2=DO_BRW('GDEF00')",""
	MTable.AddField2 "REZERVE","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	MTable.REZERVE = "T"

	QStr = GetQStr(" AND 1=0")

	Set S01D = Doc.RunSQLQuery("STOK_DETAY", QStr)
	S01D.SetFieldAlign "ALLOC_EVRAKNO", "R"
	S01D.SetFieldAlign "ALLOC_SIPNO", "R"
	S01D.SetFieldAlign "ALLOC_SIPARTNO", "R"
	S01D.SetFieldAlign "ALLOC_MPSEVNO", "R"
	S01D.SetFieldAlign "ALLOC_MPSARTNO", "R"
	S01D.SetFieldAlign "VRI_NUM1", "R"
	S01D.SetFieldAlign "VRI_NUM2", "R"
	S01D.SetFieldToDate "REFTARIH1"
	
	S01D.SetRowAID 0,0,0

	Call F2Degistir(S01D.GetAppName, "KOD", "STOK00")
	Call F2Degistir(S01D.GetAppName, "ALLOC_SIPNO", "STOK40E")
	Call F2Degistir(S01D.GetAppName, "ALLOC_MPSEVNO", "MMPS10E")
	Call F2DegistirGeco(S01D.GetAppName, "SELECTED", "|GENEH=", "H")	

	QStr = GetQStrOzet("AND 1=0")
	Set S01O = Doc.RunSQLQuery("STOK_OZET", QStr)
	Call F2Degistir(S01O.GetAppName, "KOD", "STOK00")
	Call F2DegistirGeco(S01O.GetAppName, "SELECTED", "|GENEH=", "H")	

	MakroKodu = SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME
	FormKodu = "GNPRGSTOK"
	Makro1 = Doc.RunMacro2("MAKR7S.FORM", "GetDynFormStr2", MakroKodu, FormKodu)	
End Function

Sub F2Degistir(TabloStr, AlanAdi, ByVal BrwTable)
	BrwTable = "'" & BrwTable & "'"
	Set tbl=Doc.GetRowsetObject(TabloStr)
	Set fd=tbl.GetFieldDef_E(AlanAdi)
	fd.F2Fnc="DO_BRW(" & Replace(BrwTable,"'", """") & ")"
	tbl.SetFieldProperties1 AlanAdi,fd
End Sub
Sub F2DegistirGeco(TabloStr, AlanAdi, GrupKodu, KontrolOp)
	Set Tbl = Doc.GetRowsetObject(TabloStr)
	Set fd = Tbl.GetFieldDef_E(AlanAdi)
	fd.GrupKodu = GrupKodu
	fd.F2Fnc = "DO_SBRW_GECO(""" & GrupKodu & """)"
	if trim(KontrolOp) = "E" Then
		fd.FTFFnc = "G." & trim(GrupKodu) 'Çalýþmýyor
	Else
		fd.FTFFnc = ""
	End if
	Tbl.SetFieldProperties1 AlanAdi,fd
End Sub
Sub cmdSuz()
	Set STOK_DETAY = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK_DETAY")
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")

	WhereStr = ""
	WhereStr = WhereStr & GetKriterStr(MTable, "B_KOD", "E_KOD", "S10A", "KOD")
	WhereStr = WhereStr & GetKriterStr(MTable, "", "E_TARIH", "S10A", "TARIH")
	if trim(MTable.AMBCODE) <> "" Then
		WhereStr = WhereStr & " AND " & GetAdLikeStr2("S10A.AMBCODE", MTable.AMBCODE)
	End if
	if trim(MTable.LOTNUMBER) <> "" Then
		WhereStr = WhereStr & " AND " & GetAdLikeStr2("S10A.LOTNUMBER", MTable.LOTNUMBER)
	End if
	if trim(MTable.SERINO) <> "" Then
		WhereStr = WhereStr & " AND " & GetAdLikeStr2("S10A.SERINO", MTable.SERINO)
	End if
	if trim(MTable.MUSTERIKODU) <> "" Then
		WhereStr = WhereStr & " AND (CASE WHEN S40T.MUSTERIKODU IS NULL THEN D.CH_MUSTERI ELSE S40T.MUSTERIKODU END)='" & MTable.MUSTERIKODU & "'"
	End if
	if trim(MTable.REZERVE) = "S" Then
		WhereStr = WhereStr & " AND S10A.ALLOC_SYSSTATUS=' '"
	Elseif trim(MTable.REZERVE) = "R" Then
		WhereStr = WhereStr & " AND S10A.ALLOC_SYSSTATUS<>' '"
	End if

	if trim(MTable.STOK_ADI) <> "" Then
		WhereStr = WhereStr & " AND " & GetAdLikeStr2("S00.AD", MTable.STOK_ADI)
	End if
	WhereStr = WhereStr & GetKriterStr(MTable, "MUSTERISIPINO", "", "S10A", "ALLOC_SIPNO")


	QStr = GetQStr(WhereStr)
	Set S01D = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sdfsdgfsdh", QStr)
	STOK_DETAY.Empty
	STOK_DETAY.AppendTable(S01D)
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	Set TFile = fso.CreateTextFile("e:\deneme\stok20.txt")

	FormStr = GetDynFormStr("_GNPRGMPS3", "GNPRGMPS3")
	TFile.WriteLine FormStr
	TFile.Close
End Sub

Function GetDynFormStr2(MakroKodu, FormKodu)
	Call GetScrRes(EkranYuksekligi, EkranEni)
	msgbox EkranYuksekligi & 	"---" & 	EkranEni
	YukseklikFarki = EkranYuksekligi - (768 - 30)
	EnFarki = EkranEni - 1024

	EkranFormu = Doc.RunMacro2("MAKR7S.FORM", "GetDynFormStr", MakroKodu, FormKodu)

	Call ReplaceForm2(EkranFormu, EnFarki, YukseklikFarki)

	GetDynFormStr2 = EkranFormu
End Function
Function GetDynFormStr(MakroKodu, FormKodu)
	QStr = "SELECT *"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM MAKR7SF"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE EVRAKNO='" & MakroKodu & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " ORDER BY SRNUM"
	Set DD = Doc.RunSQLQuery("asdfasdf", QStr)
	FormStr = ""
	Bulundu = False
	Pos1 = 0
	For i = 1 to DD.GetRowCount()
		FormStr = FormStr & DD.SCRIPTTEXT_RO(i)
		if Pos1 = 0 Then
			Pos1 = InStr(1, FormStr, "FORM " & trim(FormKodu) & " ")
			if Pos1 > 0 Then FormStr = Mid(FormStr, Pos1)
		End if
		if Pos1 > 0 Then
			Pos = InStr(1, FormStr, "ENDFORM")
			If Pos > 0 Then
				FormStr = Left(FormStr, Pos + Len("ENDFORM") - 1)
				Exit For
			End if
		End if
	Next
	GetDynFormStr = FormStr
End Function
Sub GetScrRes(Height, Width)
	Height = 0
	Width = 0
	Set ParWorkArea = Doc.CreateSObject("Parameters")
	bRetCode = Doc.DesktopGetWorkArea(ParWorkArea)
	If bRetCode Then
		Width = ParWorkArea.GetParameter("RIGHT")
		Height = ParWorkArea.GetParameter("BOTTOM")
	End if
End Sub
Sub ReplaceForm2(EkranFormu, EnFarki, YukseklikFarki)
	AyracStr = "@_@"
	Do
		Pos = InStr(1, EkranFormu, AyracStr)
		if pos = 0 Then Exit Do
		BaslangicPos = Pos

		Pos = InStr(Pos+1, EkranFormu, AyracStr)
		if pos = 0 Then Exit Do
		Pos2 = BaslangicPos + Len(AyracStr)
		Str1 = Mid(EkranFormu, Pos2, Pos - Pos2)
		Str1 = Replace(Str1, "WFARK", EnFarki)
		Str1 = Replace(Str1, "HFARK", YukseklikFarki)

		YeniEn = Mat(Str1)
		EkranFormu = Left(EkranFormu, BaslangicPos - 1) & YeniEn & Mid(EkranFormu, Pos + Len(AyracStr))
	Loop
End Sub
Sub ReplaceForm(EkranFormu, Aranan, Fark)
	Pos1 = InStr(1, EkranFormu, Aranan)
	if Pos1 > 0 Then
		Pos2 = Pos1 + Len(Aranan)
		Pos3 = InStr(Pos2 + 1, EkranFormu, "@")
		Str1 = Mid(EkranFormu, Pos2, Pos3 - Pos2)
		Str1 = Replace(Str1, "FARK", Fark)
		YeniEn = Mat(Str1)
		EkranFormu = Left(EkranFormu, Pos1 - 1) & YeniEn & Mid(EkranFormu, Pos3 + 1)
	End if
End Sub
Function Mat(Str1)
	Mat = 0
	Set Q1 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sdfasdf", "SELECT " & Str1 & " SONUC FROM DUAL")
	if Q1.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Function
	Mat = Q1.SONUC
End Function

Sub DetayiGoster
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("CARADAGORE_TABLE")
	EvrakNo = Trim(MTable.EVRAKNO)
	
	QStr = "SELECT EVRAKNO, "
	QStr = QStr & "  TARIH, "
	QStr = QStr & "  KOD, "
	QStr = QStr & "   '--------------------------------------------------' STOK_ADI, "
	QStr = QStr & "  SF_MIKTAR, "
	QStr = QStr & "  SF_SF_UNIT, "
	QStr = QStr & "  CH_KODU "
	QStr = QStr & "  FROM STOK74T "
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE 1=0 "
	
	Set S74T_BOS = Doc.RunSQLQuery("CARADAGORE_TABLE2", QStr)
	S74T_BOS.SetFieldToDate("TARIH")
		
	SQL = "SELECT EVRAKNO, "
	SQL = SQL & "  TARIH, "
	SQL = SQL & "  S74T.KOD, "
	SQL = SQL & "  S00.STOKADI, "
	SQL = SQL & "  SF_MIKTAR, "
	SQL = SQL & "  SF_SF_UNIT, "
	SQL = SQL & "  CH_KODU "
	SQL = SQL & "FROM ( "
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT KOD, "
	SQL = SQL & "  SF_MIKTAR, "
	SQL = SQL & "  SF_SF_UNIT, "
	SQL = SQL & "    EVRAKNO, "
	SQL = SQL & "    TARIH, "
	SQL = SQL & "    CH_KODU, "
	SQL = SQL & "    '--------------------------------------------------' STOKADI "
	SQL = SQL & "  FROM STOK74T "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) S74T "
	SQL = SQL & "LEFT JOIN "
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT KOD, AD STOKADI FROM STOK00 "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) S00 "
	SQL = SQL & "ON S74T.KOD = S00.KOD ) "
	SQL = SQL & "WHERE 1=1"
	SQL = SQL & " AND Trim(EVRAKNO) = '"&EvrakNo&"' "
	
	Set S74T_SQL = Doc.RunSQLQuery("a22S99S22sas", SQL)

	If S74T_SQL.GetRecCount>0 Then	
		S74T_BOS.CopyTable(S74T_SQL)
	End If
	
	Dim Par
	Set Par=Nothing
	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "CARIADAGORESATIR_FORMU", SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME,Par	
	S74T_BOS.SetCurrentRow(1)
End Sub

Sub Sec
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("CARADAGORE_TABLE")
	EvrakNo = Trim(MTable.EVRAKNO)
	Doc.Load_Voucher EvrakNo
	Doc.RUN_APP_CANCEL
End Sub

Sub cmd_ara
	Set MTableC = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("CARADAGORE_TABLE")
	MTable.Empty

	If TedarikciAdi <> "" Then
		AranacakKelime = TedarikciAdi
	Else
		AranacakKelime = Trim(MTableC.ARANACAK)
	End If
		
	AcikKapaliSecimi = MTableC.AK
	
	SQL = "SELECT EVRAKNO, "
	SQL = SQL & "  TARIH, "
	SQL = SQL & "  CH_KODU, "
	'VALORORANI SATIRSAYISI ÝÇÝN ÖRNEK BÝR ALAN ÝÇÝN ALINDI.
	SQL = SQL & "  CH_ADI, VALORORANI, "
	SQL = SQL & " FATURATYPE, OR_FATURASIRANO, OR_FATURATARIHI "	
	SQL = SQL & "FROM ( "
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT EVRAKNO, TARIH, CH_KODU, "
	SQL = SQL & " FATURATYPE, OR_FATURASIRANO, OR_FATURATARIHI "		
	SQL = SQL & " FROM STOK74E "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) S74E "
	SQL = SQL & "LEFT JOIN "
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT KOD, AD CH_ADI FROM CARI00 "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) C00 "
	SQL = SQL & " ON S74E.CH_KODU = C00.KOD "
	
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN "
	SQL = SQL & " (SELECT EVRAKNO S74E_EVRAKNO, COUNT(KOD) VALORORANI  FROM STOK74T GROUP BY EVRAKNO) S74T "
	SQL = SQL & " ON S74E.EVRAKNO = S74T.S74E_EVRAKNO )"
	
	SQL = SQL & "WHERE 1=1 "

	'EVRAKTAKI ACIKKAPALI DATABASEDE TUTULMUYOR. BU NEDENLE FARKLI SEKILDE AYARLANMALI. !!!
	'If AcikKapaliSecimi = "1" Then
	'	SQL = SQL & " AND ACIKKAPALI <> 'K' "
	'End If	
	
	'If AcikKapaliSecimi = "2" Then
	'	SQL = SQL & " AND ACIKKAPALI = 'K' "
	'End If	
	
	If AranacakKelime <> "" Then
		SQL = SQL & " AND " & GetAdLikeStr2("CH_ADI", AranacakKelime)
	End If
	
	SQL = SQL & "ORDER BY CH_ADI ASC, TARIH DESC "	
	
	Set S74E_ARA = Doc.RunSQLQuery("aSS21332sas", SQL)

	If S74E_ARA.GetRecCount>0 Then	
		MTable.SetFieldToDate("TARIH")
		MTable.SetFieldAlign "EVRAKNO", "R"	
		MTable.SetFieldToDate("OR_FATURATARIHI")
		MTable.CopyTable(S74E_ARA)
	End If

	MTable.SetCurrentRow(1)	
End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Cariadicindeara

	Set S74E_1 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK74E")	
	EkrandakiTedarikciKodu = S74E_1.CH_KODU
		
	Set MTableC=Doc.CreateTableObject("MAKROTABLE=STACK","IO")
	MTableC.Addfield2 "ARANACAK","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	MTableC.Addfield2 "AK","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	MTableC.AK = "3"
	
	'VALORORANI SATISRSAYISI ÝÇÝN ALINAN ÖRNEK ALAN OLDU.
	QStr = "SELECT EVRAKNO, TARIH, CH_KODU, '--------------------------------------------------' CH_ADI, VALORORANI, "
	QStr = QStr & " FATURATYPE, OR_FATURASIRANO, OR_FATURATARIHI "
	QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK74E "
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE 1=0 "
		
	Set S74E_BOS = Doc.RunSQLQuery("CARADAGORE_TABLE", QStr)
	S74E_BOS.SetFieldToDate("TARIH")
	S74E_BOS.SetFieldAlign "EVRAKNO", "R"	
	
	SQL = "SELECT EVRAKNO, "
	SQL = SQL & "  TARIH, "
	SQL = SQL & "  CH_KODU, "
	SQL = SQL & "  CH_ADI, VALORORANI, " 
	SQL = SQL & " FATURATYPE, OR_FATURASIRANO, OR_FATURATARIHI "	
	SQL = SQL & " FROM ( "
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT EVRAKNO, TARIH, CH_KODU, "
	SQL = SQL & " FATURATYPE, OR_FATURASIRANO, OR_FATURATARIHI "		
	SQL = SQL & " FROM STOK74E "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) S74E "
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN "
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT KOD, AD CH_ADI FROM CARI00 "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) C00 "
	SQL = SQL & " ON S74E.CH_KODU = C00.KOD "
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN "
	SQL = SQL & " (SELECT EVRAKNO S74T_EVRAKNO, COUNT(KOD) VALORORANI FROM STOK74T GROUP BY EVRAKNO) S74T "
	SQL = SQL & " ON S74E.EVRAKNO = S74T.S74T_EVRAKNO "
	SQL = SQL & " ) "
	
	SQL = SQL & " WHERE 1=1 "

	If Trim(EkrandakiTedarikciKodu) <> "" Then
		SQL = SQL & " AND  CH_KODU = '"& EkrandakiTedarikciKodu &"' "
	End If			
	
	SQL = SQL & " ORDER BY  CH_ADI ASC, TARIH DESC "
	
	Set S74E_SQL = Doc.RunSQLQuery("aSS22sas", SQL)
	
	S74E_SQL.SetFieldToDate("TARIH")
	S74E_SQL.SetFieldAlign "EVRAKNO", "R"	
	S74E_SQL.SetFieldToDate("OR_FATURATARIHI")
			
	If S74E_SQL.GetRecCount>0 Then	
		S74E_BOS.CopyTable(S74E_SQL)
	End If
	
	Dim Par
	Set Par=Nothing
	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "CARIADAGOREARA_FORMU", SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME,Par	
	S74E_BOS.SetCurrentRow(1)

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------
Function GetAdLikeStr2(ByVal AlanAdi, Aranan)
	While InStr(1, Aranan, "  ") > 0
		Aranan = Replace(Aranan, "  ", " ")
	Wend
	Arr1 = Split(Aranan, " ")
	For each x in Arr1
		if trim(OutChar) <> "" Then OutChar = OutChar & " AND"
		if trim(OutChar2) <> "" Then OutChar2 = OutChar2 & " AND"
		if trim(OutChar3) <> "" Then OutChar3 = OutChar3 & " AND"
		if trim(OutChar4) <> "" Then OutChar4 = OutChar4 & " AND"
		if trim(OutChar5) <> "" Then OutChar5 = OutChar5 & " AND"
	
		OutChar = OutChar & " UPPER(" & AlanAdi & ") LIKE '%" & UCase(x) & "%'"
		OutChar2 = OutChar2 & " REPLACE(UPPER(" & AlanAdi & "),',','.') LIKE '%" & UCase(x) & "%'"
		OutChar3 = OutChar3 & " REPLACE(UPPER(" & AlanAdi & "),'.',',') LIKE '%" & UCase(x) & "%'"
		OutChar4 = OutChar4 & " REPLACE(UPPER(" & AlanAdi & "),'Ý','I') LIKE '%" & UCase(x) & "%'"
		OutChar5 = OutChar5 & " REPLACE(UPPER(" & AlanAdi & "),'I','Ý') LIKE '%" & UCase(x) & "%'"
	Next
	
	GetAdLikeStr2 = "(" & OutChar & ") or (" & OutChar2 & ") or (" & OutChar3 & ") or (" & OutChar4 & ") or (" & OutChar5 & ")"
	GetAdLikeStr2 = "(" & GetAdLikeStr2 & ")"
End Function

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub UrunAgaciniPatlat
	Set MT_B01E = Doc.GetTableObject("MTABLE_B01E")
	EsasMiktar = MT_B01E.ESASMIKTAR
	ReceteKodu = MT_B01E.MAMULCODE  
	
	If EsasMiktar = 0 Then 
		Mssgbox "Esas Miktar Belirtilmemiþ."
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	ret = Doc.Calc_Bom("M","M",ReceteKodu,1,EsasMiktar,"","","","","","","","") 
	Set Tbmrsys = Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
	 
	Set BomPatlak = 	Doc.Select2G("xxtable1", "_WBMRSYS_SELECT", "BOMREC_INPUTTYPE='H' & IALTSEVIYEBULUNDU='' ", "", "BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE", -1)
	'Doc.ShowTableDynForm "xxtable1"
	KayitSayisi = BomPatlak.GetRecCount
	If KayitSayisi = 0 Then Exit Sub
	Tbmrsys.Empty
	
	For i = 1 To KayitSayisi
		satirno = Tbmrsys.AddRow
		Tbmrsys.SetCurrentRow(satirno)

		BomrecKaynakCode = BomPatlak.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(i)
		StokAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", BomrecKaynakCode, "")
		Birim = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", BomrecKaynakCode, "")
		Miktar = BomPatlak.KAYNAKMIKTART(i)
		
		Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE = BomrecKaynakCode
		Tbmrsys.STOKADI = StokAdi
		Tbmrsys.KAYNAKMIKTART = Miktar
		Tbmrsys.BIRIM = Birim
	Next
	
	Tbmrsys.SetCurrentRow(1)
End Sub

Açýklama : LÝSTE TABINDAN ÜRÜN AÐACI EVRAÐININDAKÝ GK1 Ý GÜNCELLE
Kod : 
Sub Makro1
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("BOMU01", "")
	Set TableE = Doc1.GetTableObject("BOMU01E")
	Set LST = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")
	
	KayitSayisi = LST.GetRecCount
	
	If KayitSayisi = 0 Then Exit Sub

	For i = 1 to 5' KayitSayisi
		EvrakNo = Trim(LST.EVRAKNO(i))
		Doc1.Load_Voucher EvrakNo
		Set TableE = Doc1.GetTableObject("BOMU01E")
	
		GK1Value = Trim(TableE.GK_1)

		If GK1Value <> "OK" Then
			TableE.GK_1 = "NOT_OK"
			Doc1.Save_Voucher
		End If
		Set TableE = Nothing
	Next
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	KULLANICI=Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName)
	'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	If KULLANICI="FX" Then
		If LISTET.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
		For i = 2 TO LISTET.GetRowCount()
			Doc.Load_Voucher Listet.EVRAKNO(i)
			Doc.Delete_Voucher
		Next
		Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
	End If
	LISTET.Empty
End Sub
