Sub EDI_DOSYA_ICERIGINI_OKU(TmpDosyaAdi)
	Set wshShell = CreateObject("WSCript.shell")
	wshshell.run "notepad " & TmpDosyaAdi, 1, True
	set wshshell = nothing
End Sub
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub FtpyeGonder
		Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
		Set S60E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60E")
		
		TmpDosyaAdi = Trim(MTable.DOSYAYOLU)
		DosyaAdi = Trim(MTable.DOSYAADI)
		RemotePath = Trim(MTable.REMOTEPATH)
		FtpServer = Trim(MTable.FTPSERVER)
		
		GrupKodu1 = Trim(S60E.GK_1)	
		If GrupKodu1 = "TEST" Then
			'Gönderilecek EDÝ dosyasýný okutmak için
			Msgbox "Sadece EDI' ye Gönderilecek Dosyayý Görmek Ýçindir. " & vbcrlf & "FTP' ye Dosya Gönderilmeyecektir..."
			Call EDI_DOSYA_ICERIGINI_OKU(TmpDosyaAdi)
			Exit Sub
		End If
	
		FtpYanit= FtpSendFile(TmpDosyaAdi, RemotePath)

		If FtpYanit=0 Then 
			k = Doc.d7msgbox("FTP Sitesine Dosya Yazdýrýlmýþtýr.", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
			S60E.NOTES_1="ELEKTRONIK HAT (EDI) ILE GONDERILMISTIR"
			S60E.GK_1="ASN_OK"
			nret = Doc.Save_Voucher
			
			If nret <> 0 Then
				k = doc.d7MsgBox("Evrak Kaydedilemedi. Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir","Freedom ERP", MB_OK)
				Exit Sub
			End If
			Doc.RUN_APP_CANCEL
		Else
			k = Doc.d7msgbox("HATA!!!" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "FTP Sitesine dosya yazdýrýlamamýþtýr." & "Lütfen Tekrar Deneyiniz.", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		End If
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function FtpSendFile(local_path, RemotePath)
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Dosya Gönderiliyor..."
	
	Set par = Doc.CreateSobject("Parameters")

	ServerName = "ftp://ftp.map.com.tr"
	FtpUsername = "cavo"
	FtpPassword = "c4v0%1234"

	FtpSendFile = Doc.FtpPutFile(ServerName, FtpUsername, FtpPassword, local_path, RemotePath, par)
End Function

Sub DetayiGoster
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("CARADAGORE_TABLE")
	EvrakNo = Trim(MTable.EVRAKNO)
	
	QStr = "SELECT ACIKKAPALI, "
	QStr = QStr & "  EVRAKNO, "
	QStr = QStr & "  TARIH, "
	QStr = QStr & "  KOD, "
	QStr = QStr & "   '--------------------------------------------------' STOK_ADI, "
	QStr = QStr & "  SF_MIKTAR, "
	QStr = QStr & "  SF_SF_UNIT, "
	QStr = QStr & "  RTESTARIH, "
	QStr = QStr & "  CH_KODU, PROJEKODU_TR "
	QStr = QStr & "  FROM STOK46T "
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE 1=0 "
	
	Set S46T_BOS = Doc.RunSQLQuery("CARADAGORE_TABLE2", QStr)
	S46T_BOS.SetFieldToDate("TARIH")
	S46T_BOS.SetFieldToDate("RTESTARIH")
		
	SQL = "SELECT ACIKKAPALI, "
	SQL = SQL & "  EVRAKNO, "
	SQL = SQL & "  TARIH, "
	SQL = SQL & "  S46T.KOD, "
	SQL = SQL & "  S00.STOKADI, "
	SQL = SQL & "  SF_MIKTAR, "
	SQL = SQL & "  SF_SF_UNIT, "
	SQL = SQL & "  RTESTARIH, "
	SQL = SQL & "  CH_KODU, PROJEKODU_TR "
	SQL = SQL & "FROM ( "
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT ACIKKAPALI, "
	SQL = SQL & "    KOD, "
	SQL = SQL & "  SF_MIKTAR, "
	SQL = SQL & "  SF_SF_UNIT, "
	SQL = SQL & "  RTESTARIH, "
	SQL = SQL & "    EVRAKNO, "
	SQL = SQL & "    TARIH, "
	SQL = SQL & "    CH_KODU, "
	SQL = SQL & "    '--------------------------------------------------' STOKADI, PROJEKODU_TR "
	SQL = SQL & "  FROM STOK46T "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) S46T "
	SQL = SQL & "LEFT JOIN "
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT KOD, AD STOKADI FROM STOK00 "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) S00 "
	SQL = SQL & "ON S46T.KOD = S00.KOD ) "
	SQL = SQL & "WHERE 1=1"
	SQL = SQL & " AND Trim(EVRAKNO) = '"&EvrakNo&"' "
	
	Set S46T_SQL = Doc.RunSQLQuery("a22S99S22sas", SQL)

	If S46T_SQL.GetRecCount>0 Then	
		S46T_BOS.CopyTable(S46T_SQL)
	End If
	
	Dim Par
	Set Par=Nothing
	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "CARIADAGORESATIR_FORMU", SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME,Par	
	S46T_BOS.SetCurrentRow(1)
End Sub

Sub cmd_ara
	Set MTableC = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("CARADAGORE_TABLE")
	MTable.Empty

	If TedarikciAdi <> "" Then
		AranacakKelime = TedarikciAdi
	Else
		AranacakKelime = Trim(MTableC.ARANACAK)
	End If
		
	AcikKapaliSecimi = MTableC.AK
	
	SQL = "SELECT ACIKKAPALI, "
	SQL = SQL & "  EVRAKNO, "
	SQL = SQL & "  TARIH, "
	SQL = SQL & "  CH_KODU, "
	'ODEMEGUNU SATIRSAYISI ÝÇÝN ÖRNEK BÝR ALAN ÝÇÝN ALINDI.
	SQL = SQL & "  CH_ADI, ODEMEGUNU, PROJEKODU "
	SQL = SQL & "FROM ( "
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT ACIKKAPALI, EVRAKNO S46E_EVRAKNO, TARIH, CH_KODU, PROJEKODU FROM STOK46E "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) S46E "
	SQL = SQL & "LEFT JOIN "
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT KOD, AD CH_ADI FROM CARI00 "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) C00 "
	SQL = SQL & " ON S46E.CH_KODU = C00.KOD "
	
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN "
	SQL = SQL & " (SELECT EVRAKNO, COUNT(KOD) ODEMEGUNU  FROM STOK46T GROUP BY EVRAKNO) S46T "
	SQL = SQL & " ON S46E.S46E_EVRAKNO = S46T.EVRAKNO )"
	
	SQL = SQL & "WHERE 1=1 "

	'EVRAKTAKI ACIKKAPALI DATABASEDE TUTULMUYOR. BU NEDENLE FARKLI SEKILDE AYARLANMALI. !!!
	'If AcikKapaliSecimi = "1" Then
	'	SQL = SQL & " AND ACIKKAPALI <> 'K' "
	'End If	
	
	'If AcikKapaliSecimi = "2" Then
	'	SQL = SQL & " AND ACIKKAPALI = 'K' "
	'End If	
	
	If AranacakKelime <> "" Then
		SQL = SQL & " AND " & GetAdLikeStr2("CH_ADI", AranacakKelime)
	End If
	
	SQL = SQL & "ORDER BY CH_ADI ASC, TARIH, PROJEKODU DESC "	
	
	Set S46E_ARA = Doc.RunSQLQuery("aSS21332sas", SQL)

	If S46E_ARA.GetRecCount>0 Then	
		MTable.SetFieldToDate("TARIH")
		MTable.SetFieldAlign "EVRAKNO", "R"	
	
		MTable.CopyTable(S46E_ARA)
	End If

	MTable.SetCurrentRow(1)	
End Sub

Sub Cariadicindeara

	Set S46E_1 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK46E")	
	EkrandakiTedarikciKodu = S46E_1.CH_KODU
		
	Set MTableC=Doc.CreateTableObject("MAKROTABLE=STACK","IO")
	MTableC.Addfield2 "ARANACAK","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	MTableC.Addfield2 "AK","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	MTableC.AK = "3"
	
	'ODEMEGUNU SATISRSAYISI ÝÇÝN ALINAN ÖRNEK ALAN OLDU.
	QStr = "SELECT ACIKKAPALI, EVRAKNO, TARIH, CH_KODU, '--------------------------------------------------' CH_ADI, ODEMEGUNU, PROJEKODU FROM STOK46E "
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE 1=0 "
		
	Set S46E_BOS = Doc.RunSQLQuery("CARADAGORE_TABLE", QStr)
	S46E_BOS.SetFieldToDate("TARIH")
	S46E_BOS.SetFieldAlign "EVRAKNO", "R"	
	
	'Doc.ShowTableDynForm "CARADAGORE_TABLE"	
	'EXIT SUB
	
	SQL = "SELECT ACIKKAPALI, "
	SQL = SQL & "  EVRAKNO, "
	SQL = SQL & "  TARIH, "
	SQL = SQL & "  CH_KODU, "
	SQL = SQL & "  CH_ADI, ODEMEGUNU, PROJEKODU  "
	SQL = SQL & " FROM ( "
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT ACIKKAPALI, EVRAKNO S46E_EVRAKNO, TARIH, CH_KODU, PROJEKODU FROM STOK46E "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) S46E "
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN "
	SQL = SQL & "  (SELECT KOD, AD CH_ADI FROM CARI00 "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) C00 "
	SQL = SQL & "ON S46E.CH_KODU = C00.KOD "
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN "
	SQL = SQL & " (SELECT EVRAKNO, COUNT(KOD) ODEMEGUNU FROM STOK46T GROUP BY EVRAKNO) S46T "
	SQL = SQL & " ON S46E.S46E_EVRAKNO = S46T.EVRAKNO "
	SQL = SQL & " ) "
	
	SQL = SQL & " WHERE 1=1 "

	If Trim(EkrandakiTedarikciKodu) <> "" Then
		SQL = SQL & " AND  CH_KODU = '"& EkrandakiTedarikciKodu &"' "
	End If			
	
	SQL = SQL & " ORDER BY  CH_ADI ASC, TARIH, PROJEKODU DESC "
	
	Set S46E_SQL = Doc.RunSQLQuery("aSS22sas", SQL)
	
	S46E_SQL.SetFieldToDate("TARIH")
	S46E_SQL.SetFieldAlign "EVRAKNO", "R"	
	
	If S46E_SQL.GetRecCount>0 Then	
		S46E_BOS.CopyTable(S46E_SQL)
	End If
	
	Dim Par
	Set Par=Nothing
	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "CARIADAGOREARA_FORMU", SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME,Par	
	S46E_BOS.SetCurrentRow(1)

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------
Function GetAdLikeStr2(ByVal AlanAdi, Aranan)
	While InStr(1, Aranan, "  ") > 0
		Aranan = Replace(Aranan, "  ", " ")
	Wend
	Arr1 = Split(Aranan, " ")
	For each x in Arr1
		if trim(OutChar) <> "" Then OutChar = OutChar & " AND"
		if trim(OutChar2) <> "" Then OutChar2 = OutChar2 & " AND"
		if trim(OutChar3) <> "" Then OutChar3 = OutChar3 & " AND"
		if trim(OutChar4) <> "" Then OutChar4 = OutChar4 & " AND"
		if trim(OutChar5) <> "" Then OutChar5 = OutChar5 & " AND"
	
		OutChar = OutChar & " UPPER(" & AlanAdi & ") LIKE '%" & UCase(x) & "%'"
		OutChar2 = OutChar2 & " REPLACE(UPPER(" & AlanAdi & "),',','.') LIKE '%" & UCase(x) & "%'"
		OutChar3 = OutChar3 & " REPLACE(UPPER(" & AlanAdi & "),'.',',') LIKE '%" & UCase(x) & "%'"
		OutChar4 = OutChar4 & " REPLACE(UPPER(" & AlanAdi & "),'Ý','I') LIKE '%" & UCase(x) & "%'"
		OutChar5 = OutChar5 & " REPLACE(UPPER(" & AlanAdi & "),'I','Ý') LIKE '%" & UCase(x) & "%'"
	Next
	
	GetAdLikeStr2 = "(" & OutChar & ") or (" & OutChar2 & ") or (" & OutChar3 & ") or (" & OutChar4 & ") or (" & OutChar5 & ")"
	GetAdLikeStr2 = "(" & GetAdLikeStr2 & ")"
End Function

Sub SendMail(MailTo,MailHeader,MailMessage, DosyaAdi)
	On Error Resume Next
	cdoSendUsingPickup = 1 
	cdoSendUsingPort = 2 
	cdoAnonymous = 0
	cdoBasic = 1
	cdoNTLM = 2 'NTLM


	'if Doc.Getd7UserName = "FX" Then
	if True Then
		'MailFrom = "Freedom Bilgilendirme <cavofreedom1@gmail.com>" 
		'mailserver = "smtp.gmail.com"
		'mailUser = "cavofreedom1@gmail.com"
		'mailPass = "Cavo123123"
		SMTPPort = 465
		UseSSL = True
		SMTPAuth = cdoBasic
	Else
		MailFrom = "Freedom Bilgilendirme <erp@cavo.com.tr>" 

		'mailserver = "192.168.0.7"
		'mailUser = "intranet\erp"
		'mailPass = "Passw0rd"
		'SMTPPort = 587
		UseSSL = False
		SMTPAuth = cdoBasic
	End if
	Set CDO = CreateObject("CDO.Message")
	'msgbox MailFrom & ", " & MailTo & "," & MailHeader & "," & MailMessage
	CDO.From = trim(MailFrom)
	CDO.To = MailTo
	CDO.Subject = MailHeader
	CDO.TextBody = MailMessage
	
	if trim(DosyaAdi) <> "" Then
		CDO.AddAttachment("file://" & DosyaAdi)
	End if
	CDO.Configuration.Fields.Item _
	("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/sendusing") = cdoSendUsingPort 
	
	CDO.Configuration.Fields.Item _
	("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpserver") = trim(mailserver)
	if Err.Number > 0 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Mail Gönderilemedi", "", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if
	
	CDO.Configuration.Fields.Item _
	("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpauthenticate") = SMPTAuth
	
	CDO.Configuration.Fields.Item _
	("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/sendusername") = trim(mailUser)
	if Err.Number > 0 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Mail Gönderilemedi", "", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if
	
	CDO.Configuration.Fields.Item _
	("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/sendpassword") = trim(mailPass)
	if Err.Number > 0 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Mail Gönderilemedi", "", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if
	
	CDO.Configuration.Fields.Item _
	("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpserverport") = SMTPPort
	if Err.Number > 0 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Mail Gönderilemedi", "", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if
	
	CDO.Configuration.Fields.Item _
	("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpusessl") = UseSSL
	
	CDO.Configuration.Fields.Item _
	("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpconnectiontimeout") = 60
	
	CDO.Configuration.Fields.Item _
	("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpAuthenticate") = cdoBasic

'	CDO.Configuration.Fields.Item _
'	("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/NNTPAccountName") = mailUser '"USERNAME"
'	CDO.Configuration.Fields.Item _
'	("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/SaveSentItems") = TRUE

	CDO.Configuration.Fields.Update
	CDO.Send

	if Err.Number <> 0 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "CDO Hata : " & Err.Number & vbcrlf & Err.Description & vbcrlf & "Mail Gönderilemedi", "", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if
End Sub
Function GetTableHTML(Table, ByVal HTMLBaslik, TabloBaslikArray)
	HTMLBaslik = Replace(HTMLBaslik, vbcrlf, "<br>")
	HTMLBaslik = "<p><b><font style=""font-size:20px"" face=""Verdana"">" & HTMLBaslik & "</font></b></p>"
	FieldArr = Table.GetFields()

	HTMLStr = ""
	HTMLStr = "<html  lang='tr-TR'><body>" & HTMLBaslik
	HTMLStr = HTMLStr & "<table border=1 cellspacing=0 cellpadding=2>"
	if trim(TabloBaslikArray(0)) <> "" Then
		HTMLStr = HTMLStr & "<tr>"
		For each Baslik in TabloBaslikArray
			HTMLStr = HTMLStr & "<th bgcolor=#EEEEFF><font style=""font-size:12px"" face=""Verdana"">" & Baslik & "</font></th>"
		Next
		HTMLStr = HTMLStr & "</tr>"
	End if

	For i=1 to Table.GetRecCount
		HTMLStr = HTMLStr & "<tr>"
		For j = 0 to uBound(FieldArr,1)
			if j <= uBound(TabloBaslikArray) Then
				AlanTuru = FieldArr(j, 2)
				AlanDegeri = Table.GetFieldValue(FieldArr(j,0), i)
				Align = "left"
				if AlanTuru = "DOUBLE" Then
					Align = "right"
					FontTuru = "Courier New"
					FontSize = 14
				Elseif AlanTuru = "DATE" Then
					AlanDegeri = Doc.StrToNorDate(AlanDegeri)
					FontTuru = "Verdana"
					FontSize = 12
				Elseif AlanTuru = "CHAR" Then
					AlanDegeri = trim(AlanDegeri)
					FontTuru = "Verdana"
					FontSize = 12
				End if
				HTMLStr = HTMLStr & "<td align=" & Align & "><font style=""font-size:" & FontSize & "px"" face=""" & FontTuru & """>" & AlanDegeri & "</font></td>"
			End if
		Next
		HTMLStr = HTMLStr & "</tr>"
	Next
	HTMLStr = HTMLStr & "</table></body></html>"
	GetTableHTML = HTMLStr
End Function
Sub ShowTableHTMLMessage(Table, ByVal HTMLBaslik, TabloBaslikArray)
	HTMStr = GetTableHTML(Table, HTMLBaslik, TabloBaslikArray)
	Call ShowHTML(HTMStr)
End Sub
Sub ShowHTML(HTMStr)
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	'DosyaAdi = fso.GetSpecialFolder(2) & "\skt" & Replace(Doc.BuGun, "/","") & Doc.Saat(6) & ".html"
	DosyaAdi = fso.GetSpecialFolder(2) & "\skt" & Timer & ".html"
	Set TFile = fso.OpenTextFile(DosyaAdi,2,true)
	TFile.WriteLine HTMStr
	TFile.Close
	Doc.ShellExecute DosyaAdi
End Sub

Sub FtpyeGonder
		Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")

		RemotePath = Trim(MTable.REMOTEPATH)
		FtpServer = Trim(MTable.FTPSERVER)
		
		GrupKodu1 = Trim(S60E.GK_1)	
		If GrupKodu1 = "TEST" Then
			'Gönderilecek EDÝ dosyasýný okutmak için
			Msgbox "Sadece EDI' ye Gönderilecek Dosyayý Görmek Ýçindir. " & vbcrlf & "FTP' ye Dosya Gönderilmeyecektir..."
			Call EDI_DOSYA_ICERIGINI_OKU(TmpDosyaAdi)
			Exit Sub
		End If
	
		FtpYanit= FtpSendFile(TmpDosyaAdi, RemotePath)

		If FtpYanit=0 Then 
			k = Doc.d7msgbox("FTP Sitesine Dosya Yazdýrýlmýþtýr.", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
			S60E.NOTES_1="ELEKTRONIK HAT (EDI) ILE GONDERILMISTIR"
			S60E.GK_1="ASN_OK"
			nret = Doc.Save_Voucher
			
			If nret <> 0 Then
				k = doc.d7MsgBox("Evrak Kaydedilemedi. Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir","Freedom ERP", MB_OK)
				Exit Sub
			End If
			Doc.RUN_APP_CANCEL
		Else
			k = Doc.d7msgbox("HATA!!!" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "FTP Sitesine dosya yazdýrýlamamýþtýr." & "Lütfen Tekrar Deneyiniz.", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		End If
End Sub

Function FtpSendFile(local_path, RemotePath)
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Dosya Gönderiliyor..."
	
	Set par = Doc.CreateSobject("Parameters")

	ServerName = "ftp://ftp.map.com.tr"
	FtpUsername = "cavo"
	FtpPassword = "c4v0%1234"

	FtpSendFile = Doc.FtpPutFile(ServerName, FtpUsername, FtpPassword, local_path, RemotePath, par)
End Function

	Doc1.BatchExportBegin(exportdosyaIsmi)
	Dim par1
	Set par1 = Doc1.CreateSObject("Parameters")
	par1.SetParameter "BATCHOPT","MT_LOAD_OR_NEW"

	For i = 1 to LISTET.GetRecCount()
		EvrakNo = LISTET.EVRAKNO(i)
		if trim(EvrakNo) <> "" then
			Doc1.Load_Voucher(Doc.RightJustify(EvrakNo,10))
			Doc1.BatchExport1 exportdosyaIsmi,par1
		end if
	Next

	Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher()
	Doc1.BatchExportEnd(exportdosyaIsmi)

	Doc1.DeleteDocumentNoUI docname,""		
	Set par1=Nothing
	Set Doc1 = Nothing

	MsgBox(exportdosyaIsmi & " Ýsimli dosyya Export Tamamlandý!")
End Sub

'Option Explicit
Public batchmod
'batchmod="MT_NEW" '"MT_LOAD_OR_NEW"
batchmod= "MT_LOAD_OR_NEW"
Sub Makro1()
	Dim i
	Dim Doc1
	Dim appkod
	Dim evrakno	
	Dim retcode
	Dim exported	
	Dim evraktype
	Dim hedeffirmakodu
	Dim exportdosyaIsmi
	Dim hedeffirmadizini
	Dim firmalarindizini

	exported=FALSE
	appkod=Doc.GetDocType()
	hedeffirmakodu=""

	firmalarindizini=Doc.Getd7Directory_DataRoot()
	hedeffirmadizini=firmalarindizini+"\"+hedeffirmakodu
	
	Set Doc1=Doc.CreateDocumentNOUI(appkod,"")
	If Doc1 Is Nothing Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Doc1 Oluþturulamadý","dinamo",MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End If 
	Dim par1
	Set par1=Doc1.CreateSObject("Parameters")
	par1.SetParameter "BATCHOPT",batchmod
	exportdosyaIsmi="C:\SF-d7EXPORT.xml"
	Doc.BatchExportBegin(exportdosyaIsmi)


	For i=1 to LISTET.GetRecCount()
'		evraktype=LISTET.EVRAKTYPE(i)	
		evrakno=LISTET.EVRAKNO(i)		
'		if trim(evrakno)<>"" and Trim(evraktype)<>"" then
		if trim(evrakno)<>"" then
			retcode = Doc1.Load_Voucher(evrakno)
			if retcode=0 then
				exported=TRUE
				Doc1.BatchExport1 exportdosyaIsmi,par1
			end if
		end if
	Next

	Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher()	
	Doc1.BatchExportEnd(exportdosyaIsmi)

	Doc1.DeleteDocumentNoUI appkod,""
	Set par1=Nothing

	if Trim(hedeffirmakodu)="" then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "["+exportdosyaIsmi+"] Dosyasý Oluþturuldu...","dinamo",MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	end if


	if exported and Trim(hedeffirmakodu)<>"" then
		Dim Doc3
		Set Doc3=Doc.CreateDocumentNOUI2("BATCHI","",hedeffirmadizini)
		If Doc3 Is Nothing Then
			Doc.d7MsgBox "Doc3 Oluþturulamadý","dinamo",MB_OK
			Exit Sub
		End If

		Dim msg
		Dim errorflag
		errorflag=FALSE
		msg="Aktarýlamayan Faturalar"+chr(10)+chr(13)
		msg=msg+"======================="+chr(10)+chr(13)
		Dim E_BATCHIE
		Dim T_BATCHIT
		Set E_BATCHIE=Doc3.GetTableObject("BATCHIE")
		Set T_BATCHIT=Doc3.GetTableObject("BATCHIT")
		E_BATCHIE.FILENAME=Trim(exportdosyaIsmi)
		Doc3.RunCommand("CMD_DO_IMPORT")
		for i=1 to T_BATCHIT.GetRecCount()
			if Trim(T_BATCHIT.APP(i))=Trim(appkod) then
				if Trim(T_BATCHIT.RESULT(i))<>"OK" then
					errorflag=TRUE
					msg=msg+"["+Trim(T_BATCHIT.APP(i))+"][Eski:"+Trim(T_BATCHIT.XMLEN(i))+"][Yeni:"+Trim(T_BATCHIT.DBLEN(i))+"]"+chr(10)+chr(13)
				end if
			end if
		next
		if errorflag then
			Doc.d7MsgBox msg,"dinamo",MB_OK
		end if
		Doc3.DeleteDocumentNoUI "BATCHI",""
		Set Doc3 = Nothing
	end if
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	Set LISTEE = Doc.CreateTableObject("LISTEE=STACK", "IO")
	LISTEE.AddField2 "B_EVRAKNO", "CHAR", 10, 0, "R", "F2=DO_BRW('KTT_DBG0E')", ""
	LISTEE.AddField2 "E_EVRAKNO", "CHAR", 10, 0, "R", "F2=DO_BRW('KTT_DBG0E')", ""
	LISTEE.AddField2 "B_TARIH", "DATE", 10, 0, "L", "", ""
	LISTEE.AddField2 "E_TARIH", "DATE", 10, 0, "L", "", ""

	Set KTT_DBG0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DBG0T")
	KTT_DBG0T.Setd7FieldEvent "PERSKODU","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "PERSKODU_AV"

	Set LISTET = Doc.RunSQLQuery("LISTET", "SELECT EVRAKNO, TARIH, NOTES FROM KTT_DBG0E WHERE 1=0")

End Sub
Sub cmdSuz()
	Set LISTEE = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTEE")
	Set LISTET = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")

	QStr = "SELECT EVRAKNO, " & GetNorDateStr("TARIH") & ", NOTES "
	QStr = QStr & " FROM KTT_DBG0E"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE 1=1"
	QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH>='" & LISTEE.B_TARIH & "'"
	if trim(LISTEE.E_TARIH) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH<='" & LISTEE.E_TARIH & "'"
	End if
	QStr = QStr & " AND EVRAKNO>='" & LISTEE.B_EVRAKNO & "'"
	if trim(LISTEE.E_EVRAKNO) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND EVRAKNO<='" & LISTEE.E_EVRAKNO & "'"
	End if
	Set KT = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dfsdfhsj", QStr)
	LISTET.CopyTable(KT)
End Sub
Function GetNorDateStr(TarihFldName)
	GetNorDateStr = "TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(" & TarihFldName & ", 'YYYY/MM/DD'),'DD/MM/YYYY')"
End Function
Sub PERSKODU_AV()
	Set KTT_DBG0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DBG0T")
	KTT_DBG0T.PERSADI = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("PERS00", "AD", KTT_DBG0T.PERSKODU, "")
End Sub
Sub cmdSec()
	Set LISTET = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")
	Doc.Load_Voucher LISTET.EVRAKNO
End Sub

Sub RECCALC_IAFTERROWCHANGE
	Set LST = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")
	Set MTableT = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLESP")
	MTableT.Empty
	
	EvrakNoValue = LST.EVRAKNO
	If EvrakNoValue = "" Then Exit Sub
			
	Set KTTLSTRNS = Doc.Select1("dsfsdf", "KTT_LISTLEARNS", "EVRAKNO='"&EvrakNoValue&"' ", "", -1)
	KayitSayisi = KTTLSTRNS.GetRecCount
	If KayitSayisi = 0 Then Exit Sub
	
	For i = 1 To KayitSayisi
		StokKodu = KTTLSTRNS.STOKKOD(i)

		SatirNo=MTableT.AddRow
		MTableT.SetCurrentRow(SatirNo)
		MTableT.STOKKOD = StokKodu

		If StokKodu <> "" Then
			STOKADI = Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, ""))
			MTableT.STOKKOD_AD = STOKADI
		End If

		Set STOK0GT1=Doc.Select1("_STOK0G2", "STOK0GT", "STOKCODE='"&StokKodu&"' ","",-1)
		If STOK0GT1.GetRecCount>0 Then
			CHKodu=Trim(STOK0GT1.KOD)
			MTableT.CHKOD = CHKodu
			CHADI = Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", CHKodu, ""))
			MTableT.CHKOD_AD = CHADI
		End If
	Next
	MTableT.SetCurrentRow 1
End Sub

Sub cmdSuz()
	Set LISTEE = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTEE")
	Set LISTET = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")

	Kriter_Proses = LISTEE.PROSESKODU
	Kriter_Departman = LISTEE.DEPARTMAN
	Kriter_Tarih = LISTEE.DEPARTMAN
	Kriter_Departman = LISTEE.DEPARTMAN
	Kriter_ProblemTarihB = LISTEE.PROBLEMTARIHB
	Kriter_ProblemTarihE = LISTEE.PROBLEMTARIHE
	
	QStr = "SELECT "
	QStr = QStr & " EVRAKNO, "
	QStr = QStr & " TARIH, "
	QStr = QStr & " TARIH1, "
	QStr = QStr & " GK_1, "
	QStr = QStr & " GK_2, "
	QStr = QStr & " ITEM, "
	QStr = QStr & " GELSEKLI, "
	QStr = QStr & " EA_1, "
	QStr = QStr & " HATATANIMI, "	
	QStr = QStr & " LESSON, "	
	QStr = QStr & " CAUSE, "	
	QStr = QStr & " ACTION, "		
	QStr = QStr & " PROSESAD "		
	
	QStr = QStr & " FROM "
	
	QStr = QStr & " ( "
	QStr = QStr & " (SELECT  " 
	QStr = QStr & " EVRAKNO, "
	QStr = QStr & " TARIH, "
	QStr = QStr & " TARIH1, "
	QStr = QStr & " GK_1, "
	QStr = QStr & " GK_2, "
	QStr = QStr & " ITEM, "
	QStr = QStr & " GELSEKLI, "
	QStr = QStr & " EA_1, "
	QStr = QStr & " HATATANIMI, "	
	QStr = QStr & " LESSON, "	
	QStr = QStr & " CAUSE, "	
	QStr = QStr & " ACTION "		
	QStr = QStr & " FROM KTT_LISTLEARN ) KTTLSTLRN"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN "
	QStr = QStr & " (SELECT EVRAKNO EVRNO, KOD, AD PROSESAD FROM GECOUST WHERE TRIM(EVRAKNO)='!HATA_KODU') GCST "
	QStr = QStr & " ON KTTLSTLRN.GK_1=GCST.KOD "
	QStr = QStr & " ) "
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE 1=1"
	
	If Trim(Kriter_Proses) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND GK_1 IN ('"&Kriter_Proses&"') "
	End If
	
	If Trim(Kriter_Departman) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND GK_2 IN ('"&Kriter_Departman&"') "
	End If

	If Trim(Kriter_ProblemTarihB) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH1>='" & Kriter_ProblemTarihB & "' "
	End If
	
	If Trim(Kriter_ProblemTarihE) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH1<='" & Kriter_ProblemTarihE & "' "
	End If

	QStr = QStr & " ORDER BY TARIH1 DESC "

	Set KT = Doc.RunSQLQuery("df6sdfhsj", QStr)
	'KT.SetFieldToDate("TARIH")
	'KT.SetFieldToDate("TARIH1")
	
	'doc.ShowTableDynForm "dfsdfhsj"
	LISTET.CopyTable(KT)
End Sub

	Set LISTET = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")
	EvrakNo = LISTET.EVRAKNO

	par.SetParameter "TABNO","1"    
	Doc.TabSelect par

Sub DosyaYukle()
	Set JI=Doc.GettableObject("KTT_JOB_IT")
	if trim(JI.FULLFILENAME0)="" Then Exit Sub
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	tmpFullPath=trim(JI.FULLFILENAME0)
	Set objFile = fso.GetFile(tmpFullPath)
	DosyaAdi=fso.GetFileName(objFile)
	QFolder="\\192.168.0.3\FreedomSQL\QualityMFiles\"&trim(JI.EVRAKNO)
	if not fso.FolderExists(QFolder) Then
		fso.CreateFolder QFolder
	End if
	hedef=QFolder&"\"&DosyaAdi
	fso.CopyFile tmpFullPath, hedef
	
	if trim(JI.FN_01)="" Then
		JI.FN_01=hedef
		Call DosyalariEkle()
		Exit Sub
	Elseif trim(JI.FN_02)="" Then
		JI.FN_02=hedef
		Call DosyalariEkle()
		Exit Sub
	Elseif trim(JI.FN_03)="" Then
		JI.FN_03=hedef
		Call DosyalariEkle()
		Exit Sub
	Elseif trim(JI.FN_04)="" Then
		JI.FN_04=hedef
		Call DosyalariEkle()
		Exit Sub
	Else
		msgbox "4'ten fazla dosya eklenemez."
	End if
End Sub

Sub CmdSuz()
	Set MTableE=Doc.GettableObject("KRITERLER")
	Set LIST=Doc.GettableObject("LISTET")
	Doc.RunCommand "ID_APP_CANCEL"
	LIST.Empty
	Qstr="SELECT * FROM KTT_JOB_IT K"
	Qstr=Qstr&" WHERE 1=1  "
	if trim(MTableE.PERSNO)<>"" Then
		Qstr=Qstr&"  AND K.PERSNO='"&MTableE.PERSON&"'"
	End if
	Qstr=Qstr&" AND K.TARIH>='"&MTableE.TARIHB&"'"
	if trim(MTableE.TARIHE)<>"" Then
		Qstr=Qstr&" AND K.TARIH<='"&MTableE.TARIHE&"'"
	End if
	Set LIST2=Doc.RunSqlQuery("123sd",Qstr)
	if LIST2.Getreccount()=0 then Exit Sub
	
	For i=1 to LIST2.Getreccount()
		SatirNo=LIST.Addrow
		LIST.SetCurrentrow(SatirNo)
		LIST.AP10(SatirNo)=LIST2.AP10(i)
		LIST.EVRAKNO(SatirNo)=LIST2.EVRAKNO(i)
		LIST.TARIH(SatirNo)=LIST2.TARIH(i)
		LIST.PERSNO(SatirNo)=LIST2.PERSNO(i)
		LIST.GK_1(SatirNo)=LIST2.GK_1(i)
		LIST.GK_2(SatirNo)=LIST2.GK_2(i)
		LIST.GK_3(SatirNo)=LIST2.GK_3(i)
		LIST.GK_4(SatirNo)=LIST2.GK_4(i)
		LIST.HZ_NO(SatirNo)=LIST2.HZ_NO(i)
		LIST.ONAY_NO(SatirNo)=LIST2.ONAY_NO(i)
		LIST.TARIH1(SatirNo)=LIST2.TARIH1(i)
		LIST.TARIH2(SatirNo)=LIST2.TARIH2(i)
	Next
End Sub

Sub CmdSec()
	Set LIST=Doc.GettableObject("LISTET")
	SatirNo=LIST.GetCurrentrow()
	if trim(LIST.EVRAKNO(SatirNo))="" Then Exit Sub
	Doc.Load_Voucher(LIST.EVRAKNO(SatirNo))
End Sub

Sub Eposta()
	Set JI=Doc.GettableObject("KTT_JOB_IT")
	
	ForReading = 1
	
	Dim ToAddress
	Dim FromAddress
	Dim MessageSubject
	Dim MyTime
	Dim MessageBody
	Dim MessageAttachment
	Dim ol, ns, newMail
	MyTime = Doc.Stime(6)
	ToAddress = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("UDEF", "EMAIL",JI.PERSNO, "")
	MessageSubject ="Ölçüm Sonucu"
	MessageBody = "Sayýn Yetkili; " &vbCrLf& "Ölçüm Raporunuz ektedir."&vbCrLf&"Saygýlarýmýzla"
	MessageAttachment =DosyaAdi
	Set ol = CreateObject("Outlook.Application")
	Set ns = ol.getNamespace("MAPI")
	Set newMail = ol.CreateItem(olMailItem)
	newMail.Subject = MessageSubject
	newMail.Body = MessageBody& vbCrLf & MyTime
	newMail.RecipIents.Add(ToAddress)
	if trim(JI.KN_01)<>"" Then
		newMail.Attachments.Add(trim(JI.KN_01))
	End if
	if trim(JI.KN_02)<>"" Then
		newMail.Attachments.Add(trim(JI.KN_02))
	End if
	if trim(JI.KN_03)<>"" Then
		newMail.Attachments.Add(trim(JI.KN_03))
	End if
	if trim(JI.KN_04)<>"" Then
		newMail.Attachments.Add(trim(JI.KN_01))
	End if
	newMail.Display
	'newMail.Send
	
End Sub

Sub DosyaYukle()
	Set JI=Doc.GettableObject("KTT_JOB_IT")
	if trim(JI.FULLFILENAME0)="" Then Exit Sub
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	tmpFullPath=trim(JI.FULLFILENAME0)
	Set objFile = fso.GetFile(tmpFullPath)
	DosyaAdi=fso.GetFileName(objFile)
	QFolder="\\192.168.0.3\FreedomSQL\QualityMFiles"&trim(JI.EVRAKNO)
	if not fso.FolderExists(QFolder) Then
		fso.CreateFolder QFolder
	End if
	hedef=QFolder&"\"&DosyaAdi
	fso.CopyFile tmpFullPath, hedef
	
	if trim(JI.FN_01)="" Then
		JI.FN_01=hedef
		Call DosyalariEkle()
		Exit Sub
	Elseif trim(JI.FN_02)="" Then
		JI.FN_02=hedef
		Call DosyalariEkle()
		Exit Sub
	Elseif trim(JI.FN_03)="" Then
		JI.FN_03=hedef
		Call DosyalariEkle()
		Exit Sub
	Elseif trim(JI.FN_04)="" Then
		JI.FN_04=hedef
		Call DosyalariEkle()
		Exit Sub
	Else
		msgbox "4'ten fazla dosya eklenemez."
	End if
End Sub

Sub CmdSuz()
	Set MTableE=Doc.GettableObject("KRITERLER")
	Set LIST=Doc.GettableObject("LISTET")
	Doc.RunCommand "ID_APP_CANCEL"
	LIST.Empty
	Qstr="SELECT * FROM KTT_JOB_IT K"
	Qstr=Qstr&" WHERE 1=1  "
	if trim(MTableE.PERSNO)<>"" Then
		Qstr=Qstr&"  AND K.PERSNO='"&MTableE.PERSON&"'"
	End if
	Qstr=Qstr&" AND K.TARIH>='"&MTableE.TARIHB&"'"
	if trim(MTableE.TARIHE)<>"" Then
		Qstr=Qstr&" AND K.TARIH<='"&MTableE.TARIHE&"'"
	End if
	Set LIST2=Doc.RunSqlQuery("123sd",Qstr)
	if LIST2.Getreccount()=0 then Exit Sub
	
	For i=1 to LIST2.Getreccount()
		SatirNo=LIST.Addrow
		LIST.SetCurrentrow(SatirNo)
		LIST.AP10(SatirNo)=LIST2.AP10(i)
		LIST.EVRAKNO(SatirNo)=LIST2.EVRAKNO(i)
		LIST.TARIH(SatirNo)=LIST2.TARIH(i)
		LIST.PERSNO(SatirNo)=LIST2.PERSNO(i)
		LIST.GK_1(SatirNo)=LIST2.GK_1(i)
		LIST.GK_2(SatirNo)=LIST2.GK_2(i)
		LIST.HZ_NO(SatirNo)=LIST2.HZ_NO(i)
		LIST.ONAY_NO(SatirNo)=LIST2.ONAY_NO(i)
		LIST.TARIH1(SatirNo)=LIST2.TARIH1(i)
		LIST.TARIH2(SatirNo)=LIST2.TARIH2(i)
	Next
End Sub

Sub CmdSec()
	Set LIST=Doc.GettableObject("LISTET")
	SatirNo=LIST.GetCurrentrow()
	if trim(LIST.EVRAKNO(SatirNo))="" Then Exit Sub
	Doc.Load_Voucher(LIST.EVRAKNO(SatirNo))
End Sub

Sub Eposta()
	'MailGonder(strTo, DosyaAdi)
	ForReading = 1
	
	Dim ToAddress
	Dim FromAddress
	Dim MessageSubject
	Dim MyTime
	Dim MessageBody
	Dim MessageAttachment
	Dim ol, ns, newMail
	MyTime = Doc.Stime(6)
	ToAddress = strTo
	MessageSubject ="Ölçüm Sonucu"
	MessageBody = "Sayýn Yetkili; " &vbCrLf& "Ölçüm Raporunuz ektedir."&vbCrLf&"Saygýlarýmýzla"
	MessageAttachment =DosyaAdi
	Set ol = CreateObject("Outlook.Application")
	Set ns = ol.getNamespace("MAPI")
	Set newMail = ol.CreateItem(olMailItem)
	newMail.Subject = MessageSubject
	newMail.Body = MessageBody& vbCrLf & MyTime
	newMail.RecipIents.Add(ToAddress)
	newMail.Attachments.Add(MessageAttachment)
	newMail.Display
	newMail.Send
	
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	Set BT=Doc.GettableObject("KTT_BELGET")
	Set BE=Doc.GettableObject("KTT_BELGEE")
	BE.AddField2 "TALEPEDEN_AD","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	BE.AddField2 "TO_1_AD","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	BE.AddField2 "TO_2_AD","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	BE.AddField2 "CC_1_AD","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	BE.AddField2 "GK1_AD","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	BE.AddField2 "GK2_AD","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	BE.AddField2 "FULLFILENAME0","CHAR",256,0,"L","F2=DO_SYSBRW_FILENAME()",""
	Set MTableT = Doc.CreateTransactionalTableObject("MAKROTABLET=KTT_BELGET(NOFILE)", "IO")
	
	BE.Setd7FieldEvent "PERSNO","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "PERSNO_AV"
	BE.Setd7FieldEvent "GK_1","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "GK_1_AV"
	BE.Setd7FieldEvent "TO_1","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "TO_1_AV"
	BE.Setd7FieldEvent "TO_2","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "TO_2_AV"
	BE.Setd7FieldEvent "CC_1","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "CC_1_AV"
	BE.Setd7FieldEvent "GK_2","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "GK_2_AV"

Sub DosyaYukle()
	Set BE=Doc.GettableObject("KTT_BELGEE")
	if trim(BE.FULLFILENAME0)="" Then Exit Sub
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	KlasorAdi1=trim(BE.FULLFILENAME0)
	KlasorAdi = fso.GetParentFolderName(KlasorAdi1)
	Set Klasor = fso.GetFolder(KlasorAdi)
	
	For each dosya in Klasor.Files
		Call AddATCTable(dosya,fso)
	Next
	
End Sub

Sub AddATCTable(dosya,fso)
	Set BE=Doc.GettableObject("KTT_BELGEE")
	Set MTableT=Doc.GettableObject("MAKROTABLET")
	EvrakNo=trim(BE.EVRAKNO)
	Hedef="\\cverpsrv\FreedomSQL\Evrak_Kayit\"&EvrakNo
	if not fso.FolderExists(Hedef) Then
		fso.CreateFolder Hedef
	End if
	DosyaAdi=fso.GetFileName(dosya)
	HedefDosyaAdi=hedef&"\"&DosyaAdi
	fso.CopyFile dosya,HedefDosyaAdi
	
	MTableT.Addrow
	SatirNo=MTableT.GetrecCount
	MTableT.SetCurrentrow(SatirNo)
	MTableT.FILENAME(SatirNo)=HedefDosyaAdi
End Sub

Sub cmdKriterler()
	Set Par=Nothing
	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "KRITER_FORM",SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME,Par
End Sub

Sub CmdSuz()
	Set MTableE=Doc.GettableObject("KRITERLER")
	Set LIST=Doc.GettableObject("LISTET")
	Doc.RunCommand "ID_APP_CANCEL"
	LIST.Empty
	Qstr="SELECT * FROM KTT_JOB_IT K"
	Qstr=Qstr&" WHERE 1=1  "
	if trim(MTableE.PERSNO)<>"" Then
		Qstr=Qstr&"  AND K.PERSNO='"&MTableE.PERSON&"'"
	End if
	Qstr=Qstr&" AND K.TARIH>='"&MTableE.TARIHB&"'"
	if trim(MTableE.TARIHE)<>"" Then
		Qstr=Qstr&" AND K.TARIH<='"&MTableE.TARIHE&"'"
	End if
	Set LIST2=Doc.RunSqlQuery("123sd",Qstr)
	if LIST2.Getreccount()=0 then Exit Sub
	
	For i=1 to LIST2.Getreccount()
		SatirNo=LIST.Addrow
		LIST.SetCurrentrow(SatirNo)
		LIST.AP10(SatirNo)=LIST2.AP10(i)
		LIST.EVRAKNO(SatirNo)=LIST2.EVRAKNO(i)
		LIST.TARIH(SatirNo)=LIST2.TARIH(i)
		LIST.PERSNO(SatirNo)=LIST2.PERSNO(i)
		LIST.GK_1(SatirNo)=LIST2.GK_1(i)
		LIST.GK_2(SatirNo)=LIST2.GK_2(i)
		LIST.HZ_NO(SatirNo)=LIST2.HZ_NO(i)
		LIST.ONAY_NO(SatirNo)=LIST2.ONAY_NO(i)
		LIST.TARIH1(SatirNo)=LIST2.TARIH1(i)
		LIST.TARIH2(SatirNo)=LIST2.TARIH2(i)
	Next
End Sub

Sub CmdSec()
	Set LIST=Doc.GettableObject("LISTET")
	SatirNo=LIST.GetCurrentrow()
	if trim(LIST.EVRAKNO(SatirNo))="" Then Exit Sub
	Doc.Load_Voucher(LIST.EVRAKNO(SatirNo))
End Sub

Sub Eposta()
	Set BE=Doc.GettableObject("KTT_BELGEE")
	Set BT=Doc.GettableObject("KTT_BELGET")
	Doc.Save_voucher
	ForReading = 1
	Dim ToAddress
	Dim FromAddress
	Dim MessageSubject
	Dim MyTime
	Dim MessageBody
	Dim MessageAttachment
	Dim ol, ns, newMail
	MyTime = Doc.Stime(6)
	ToAddress = strTo
	MessageSubject ="Evrak Kayýt"
	MessageBody = "Sayýn Yetkili; " &vbCrLf& "Evrak kayýt Bölümüne ulaþan Belgeleriniz ektedir."&vbCrLf&"Saygýlarýmýzla"
	MessageAttachment =DosyaAdi
	Set ol = CreateObject("Outlook.Application")
	Set ns = ol.getNamespace("MAPI")
	Set newMail = ol.CreateItem(olMailItem)
	newMail.Subject = MessageSubject
	newMail.Body = MessageBody& vbCrLf & MyTime
	
	For i=1 to 5
		if i=1 and trim(BE.TO_1_AD(1))<>"" Then
			ToAddress=trim(BE.TO_1_AD(1))
			newMail.RecipIents.Add(ToAddress)
		End if
		if i=2 and trim(BE.TO_2_AD(1))<>"" Then
			ToAddress=trim(BE.TO_2_AD(1))
			newMail.RecipIents.Add(ToAddress)
		End if
		if i=3 and trim(BE.CC_1_AD(1))<>"" Then
			ToAddress=trim(BE.CC_1_AD(1))
			newMail.RecipIents.Add(ToAddress)
		End if
		
		if i=4 and trim(BE.EMAIL(1))<>"" Then
			ToAddress=trim(BE.EMAIL(1))
			newMail.RecipIents.Add(ToAddress)
		End if
		Adres_1=trim(BE.EMAIL(1))&trim(BE.CC_1_AD(1))&trim(BE.TO_2_AD(1))&trim(BE.TO_1_AD(1))
		if i=5 and trim(Adres_1)="" Then
			ToAddress="nagihan.ozcan@cavo.com.tr"
			newMail.RecipIents.Add(ToAddress)
		End if
	Next
	
	if BT.Getreccount()>0 Then
		For i=1 to BT.Getreccount()
			MessageAttachment=trim(BT.FILENAME(i))
			newMail.Attachments.Add(MessageAttachment)
		Next
	End if
	newMail.Display
	'newMail.Send
	
End Sub

Function Makro1()
	'Doc.WinMaximize
	if Doc.IsBlank(KTT_DOF00E) Then Set KTT_DOF00E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DOF00E")
	if Doc.IsBlank(KTT_DOF00T) Then Set KTT_DOF00T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DOF00T")
	KTT_DOF00E.Setd7FieldEvent "DUZENLEYEN","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "DUZENLEYEN_AV"
	KTT_DOF00E.Setd7FieldEvent "FLYT_TURU","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "FLYT_TURU_AV"
	KTT_DOF00E.Setd7FieldEvent "SONUC","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "SONUC_AV"
	KTT_DOF00T.Setd7FieldEvent "PERS_KODU","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "PERS_KODU_AV"
	KTT_DOF00E.SetFieldToDate "ELOG_LOGTARIH"
	Set MTable = Doc.CreateTableObject("LISTEE=STACK","IO")
	MTable.Addfield2 "EVRAKNOB","CHAR",10,0,"R","F2=DO_BRW('KTT_DOF00E')",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "EVRAKNOE","CHAR",10,0,"R","F2=DO_BRW('KTT_DOF00E')",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "TARIHB","DATE",10,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "TARIHE","DATE",10,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "DUZENLEYENB","CHAR",16,0,"L","F2=DO_BRW('PERS00')",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "DUZENLEYENE","CHAR",16,0,"L","F2=DO_BRW('PERS00')",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "ACIKKAPALI","CHAR",1,0,"L","","|AKTYPE2"
	MTable.Addfield2 "SONUC","CHAR",10,0,"L","","!DOF_SNC"
	QStr1 = GetQStr1()
	QStr = QStr1 & " WHERE 1=0"
	Set MTableT = Doc.RunSQLQuery("LISTET", QStr)
	Set U10T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("adsfasdfa", "SELECT VARCODE FROM UFLD10T WHERE EVRAKNO='UYG00' AND VARTYPE='D'")
	For i = 1 to U10T.GetRowCount()
		MTableT.SetFieldToDate(trim(U10T.VARCODE(i)))
	Next
	MTableT.SetFieldAlign "EVRAKNO", "R"
	MTableT.SetRowAID 0,0,0
	MakroKodu = SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME
	FormKodu = "GNPRGUYG0"
	'Makro1 = Doc.RunMacro2("MAKR7S.FORM", "GetDynFormStr2", MakroKodu, FormKodu)
End Function
Sub BeforeSave2()
	Call DosyalariAgKlasoruneKopyala()
End Sub

Sub DUZENLEYEN_AV()
	if Doc.IsBlank(KTT_DOF00E) Then Set KTT_DOF00E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DOF00E")
	if trim(KTT_DOF00E.DUZENLEYEN) = "" Then
		KTT_DOF00E.DZNLYN_ADI = ""
		Exit Sub
	End if

	QStr = "SELECT AD FROM PERS00 WHERE KOD='" & KTT_DOF00E.DUZENLEYEN & "'"
	Set P00 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sdfsdg", QStr)
	if P00.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Geçersiz Personel Kodu", "", MB_OK
		KTT_DOF00E.DUZENLEYEN = ""
		KTT_DOF00E.DZNLYN_ADI = ""
		Exit Sub
	End if
	KTT_DOF00E.DZNLYN_ADI = P00.AD(1)
End Sub

Sub PERS_KODU_AV()
	Call PersonelAdiHesapla(-1)
End Sub

Sub PersonelAdiHesaplaAll()
	if Doc.IsBlank(KTT_DOF00T) Then Set KTT_DOF00T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DOF00T")
	For i = 1 to KTT_DOF00T.GetRowCount()
		Call PersonelAdiHesapla(i)
	Next
End Sub

Sub PersonelAdiHesapla(satirNo)
	if Doc.IsBlank(KTT_DOF00T) Then Set KTT_DOF00T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DOF00T")
	if satirNo = -1 Then satirNo = KTT_DOF00T.GetCurrentRow()
	
	if trim(KTT_DOF00T.PERS_KODU(satirNo)) = "" Then
		KTT_DOF00T.PERS_ADI(satirNo) = ""
		Exit Sub
	End if

	QStr = "SELECT AD FROM PERS00 WHERE KOD='" & KTT_DOF00T.PERS_KODU(satirNo) & "'"
	Set P00 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sdfsdg", QStr)
	if P00.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Geçersiz Personel Kodu : " & trim(KTT_DOF00T.PERS_KODU(satirNo)), "", MB_OK
		KTT_DOF00T.PERS_KODU(satirNo) = ""
		KTT_DOF00T.PERS_ADI(satirNo) = ""
		Exit Sub
	End if
	KTT_DOF00T.PERS_ADI(satirNo) = P00.AD(1)
End Sub

Sub FLYT_TURU_AV()
	if Doc.IsBlank(KTT_DOF00E) Then Set KTT_DOF00E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DOF00E")
	KTT_DOF00E.FLYT_AD = Doc.GetGecoValue("!DOF_FLYT", "AD", KTT_DOF00E.FLYT_TURU, -1)
End Sub

Sub AfterLoad2() 'AfterLoad Çaðýrýyor
	Call DUZENLEYEN_AV()
	Call FLYT_TURU_AV()
	Call PersonelAdiHesaplaAll()
End Sub

Sub cmdSuz()
	Set MTableT = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")
	Set LISTEE = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTEE")

	QStr1 = GetQStr1
	QStr = QStr1 & " WHERE 1=1"

	QStr = QStr & GetQStr(LISTEE, "EVRAKNOB", "EVRAKNOE", "KTT", "EVRAKNO")
	QStr = QStr & GetQStr(LISTEE, "TARIHB", "TARIHE", "KTT", "TARIH")
	QStr = QStr & GetQStr(LISTEE, "DUZENLEYENB", "DUZENLEYENB", "KTT", "DUZENLEYEN")
	if trim(LISTEE.ACIKKAPALI) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND KTT.ACIKKAPALI='" & LISTEE.ACIKKAPALI & "'"
	End if
	if trim(LISTEE.SONUC) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND KTT.SONUC='" & LISTEE.SONUC & "'"
	End if

	QStr = QStr & " ORDER BY KTT.EVRAKNO"
	Set Tbl1 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dfgstjsk", QStr)
	MTableT.SetRowAID 1,1,1
	MTableT.Empty
	MTableT.AppendTable(Tbl1)
	MTableT.SetRowAID 0,0,0
End Sub

Sub cmdSec()
	Set MTableT = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")
	Doc.Load_Voucher MTableT.EVRAKNO
	Set par = Doc.CreateSObject("Parameters")
	par.SetParameter "TABNAME","Düzeltici/Önleyici Faaliyet"
	'par.SetParameter "TABNO","2"   
	Doc.TabSelect par
End Sub
Function GetQStr(KriterTbl, AlanB, AlanE, Tablo, Alan)
	GetQStr = ""
	GetQStr = GetQStr & " AND " & Tablo & "." & Alan & ">='" & KriterTbl.GetFieldValue(AlanB, 1) & "'"
	if trim(KriterTbl.GetFieldValue(AlanE, 1)) <> "" Then
		GetQStr = GetQStr & " AND " & Tablo & "." & Alan & "<='" & KriterTbl.GetFieldValue(AlanE, 1) & "'"
	End if
End Function
Function GetQStr1()
	QStr1 = "SELECT KTT.*,"
	QStr1 = QStr1 & " GDUZENLEYEN.AD DUZENLEYEN_AD"
	QStr1 = QStr1 & " FROM KTT_DOF00E KTT"
	QStr1 = QStr1 & " LEFT JOIN PERS00 GDUZENLEYEN ON GDUZENLEYEN.KOD=KTT.DUZENLEYEN"
	GetQStr1 = QStr1
End Function

Sub F2Degistir(TabloStr, AlanAdi, ByVal BrwTable)
 BrwTable = "'" & BrwTable & "'"
 Set tbl=doc.GetRowsetObject(TabloStr)
 Set fd=tbl.GetFieldDef_E(AlanAdi)
 fd.F2Fnc="DO_BRW(" & Replace(BrwTable,"'", """") & ")"
 tbl.SetFieldProperties1 AlanAdi,fd
End Sub

Sub TARIH_AV()
	Set KTT_DOF00E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DOF00E")
	if trim(KTT_DOF00E.TARIH) = "" Then Exit Sub
End Sub

Function StrDate_Increment_IsGunu(Tarih, IsGunu)
	Isgunu1 = Abs(IsGunu)
	Isaret = Doc.Div(IsGunu, Isgunu1)
	Set d7Date = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	d7Date.SetDate(Tarih)
	Do
		sayac1 = sayac1 + 1
		d7Date.Increment(1 * Isaret)
		HaftaninGunu = d7Date.GetDOW
		if HaftaninGunu >= 1 and HaftaninGunu <= 5 Then
			Sayac = Sayac + 1
		End if
		if Sayac1 > IsGunu1 * 5 Then Exit Do
	Loop While Sayac < IsGunu1
	StrDate_Increment_IsGunu = d7Date.GetRevDate()
End Function

Sub SONUC_AV()
	Set KTT_DOF00E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DOF00E")
	if trim(KTT_DOF00E.SONUC) = "" Then
		KTT_DOF00E.ACIKKAPALI = "A"
		KTT_DOF00E.TARIH_KPGR = ""
	Else
		KTT_DOF00E.ACIKKAPALI = "K"
		KTT_DOF00E.TARIH_KPGR = Doc.BuGun
	End if
End Sub

Sub DosyalariAgKlasoruneKopyala()
	Set KTT = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DOF00ATC")
	KTT.SafePack
	if KTT.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
	For i = 1 to KTT.GetRowCount()
		HedefDosyaAdi = DosyaKopyala(KTT.FILE_NAME1(i))
		if trim(HedefDosyaAdi) <> "" Then KTT.FILE_NAME1(i) = HedefDosyaAdi
	Next
End Sub

Function DosyaKopyala(ByVal DosyaAdi)
	DosyaKopyala = ""
	HedefAnaKlasor = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataRoot & "kablodoc"
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	if Not fso.FolderExists(HedefAnaKlasor) Then Exit Function
	DosyaAdi = Trim(DosyaAdi)
	if DosyaAdi = "" Then Exit Function
	if Not fso.FileExists(DosyaAdi) Then Exit Function
	HedefKlasor = HedefAnaKlasor & "\DOF"
	if Not KlasorYoksaYarat(fso,HedefKlasor) Then Exit Function
	Set Dosya = fso.GetFile(DosyaAdi)
	If UCase(Dosya.ParentFolder.Path) = UCase(HedefKlasor) Then Exit Function
	HedefDosyaAdi = HedefKlasor & "\" & Dosya.Name
	if fso.FileExists(HedefDosyaAdi) Then
		if Doc.d7MsgBox(HedefDosyaAdi & " adlý dosya zaten var, üzerine yazýlsýn mý?", "Dikkat", MB_YESNO) <> 6 Then
			Exit Function
		End if
	End if
	fso.CopyFile DosyaAdi, HedefDosyaAdi
	if fso.FileExists(HedefDosyaAdi) Then DosyaKopyala = HedefDosyaAdi
End Function

Function KlasorYoksaYarat(fso,HedefKlasor)
	KlasorYoksaYarat = False
	if fso.FolderExists(HedefKlasor) Then
		KlasorYoksaYarat = True
		Exit Function
	End if
	
	fso.CreateFolder HedefKlasor
	KlasorYoksaYarat = fso.FolderExists(HedefKlasor)
End Function
Sub cmdMailGonderMain()
	Set KTT_DOF00E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DOF00E")
	Set MTable = Doc.CreateTableObject("MAIL_HEADER=STACK", "IO")
	MTable.AddField2 "KONU","CHAR",70,0,"L","",""
	MTable.AddField2 "MESAJ","CHAR",500,0,"L","",""

	Set MTableT = Doc.CreateTransactionalTableObject("MAIL_LIST=STACK", "IO")
	MTableT.AddField2 "EMAIL","CHAR",100,0,"L","",""
	MTableT.AddField2 "AD_SOYAD","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	Call EMAIL_F2Degistir()

	MTable.KONU = "Düzeltici / Önleyici Faaliyet Bildirimi - " & trim(KTT_DOF00E.EVRAKNO)
	MTable.MESAJ = KTT_DOF00E.HATA
	Set Par = Nothing
	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "MAIL_GONDER", SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME,Par
End Sub
Sub cmdMailGonder()
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAIL_HEADER")
	eMailList = GetEMailList()
	if trim(eMailList) = "" Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Alýcý Seçilmemiþ", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if
	Konu = trim(MTable.KONU)
	Mesaj = trim(MTable.MESAJ)
	DosyaAdi = GetDosyaList()
	Doc.RunMacro4 "MAKR7S.FREEMAIL", "SendMail", eMailList, Konu, Mesaj, DosyaAdi
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Gönderiliyor..."
	Doc.RUN_APP_OK
End Sub
Function GetEMailList()
	EMailList = ""
	Set MTableT = Doc.GetTableObject("MAIL_LIST")
	For i = 1 to MTableT.GetRowCount()
		if trim(MTableT.EMAIL(i)) <> "" Then
			if trim(EMailList) <> "" Then EMailList = EMailList & ","
			EMailList = EMailList & trim(MTableT.EMAIL(i))
		End if
	Next
	GetEMailList = EMailList
End Function
Function GetDosyaList()
	DosyaAdi = ""
	Set ATC = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DOF00ATC")
	ATC.SafePack
	For i = 1 to ATC.GetRowCount()
		if trim(ATC.FILE_NAME1(i)) <> "" Then
			if trim(DosyaAdi) <> "" Then DosyaAdi = DosyaAdi & ","
			DosyaAdi = DosyaAdi & trim(ATC.FILE_NAME1(i))
		End if
	Next
	GetDosyaList = DosyaAdi
End Function
Sub EMAIL_F2Degistir()
	Set Tbl = Doc.GetTableObject("MAIL_LIST")
	AlanAdi = "EMAIL"
	RetFieldStr = "EMAIL=1,AD_SOYAD=2"
	BrowseTable = "BRW_UDEF_1"
	BrowseCaption = "Kullanýcý Tanýmlarý"
	Width1 = 500
	Height1 = 500

	Set FieldDef = Tbl.GetFieldDef_E(AlanAdi)

	QStr = "SELECT U.EMAIL, U.AD_SOYAD, U.KOD" & vbCrLf 
	QStr = QStr & " FROM UDEF U" & vbCrLf 
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE 1=1 AND U.AP10='1'" & vbCrLf 
	QStr = QStr & " AND (UPPER(U.EMAIL) LIKE STRUPPER('@@@CR1@@@') " & vbCrLf 
	QStr = QStr & " OR TRIM('@@@CR1@@@') IS NULL)"
	QStr = QStr & " AND TRIM(U.EMAIL) IS NOT NULL"
	QStr = QStr & " ORDER BY UPPER(U.EMAIL)"

	QStr = "'" & Replace(QStr, "'", "\:q") & "'"

	ColStr = "'<COL COLLEN=200p>e-Mail</COL>'"
	ColStr = ColStr & ",'<COL COLLEN=280p>Kullanýcý Adý</COL>'"
	ColStr = ColStr & ",'<COL>Kullanýcý Kodu</COL>'"

	BrowseFunc = "F2=DO_SQL_BRW("
	BrowseFunc = BrowseFunc & "'" & BrowseTable & "'"
	BrowseFunc = BrowseFunc & ",'" & RetFieldStr & "'"
	BrowseFunc = BrowseFunc & "," & QStr
	BrowseFunc = BrowseFunc & ",'" & BrowseCaption & "'"
	BrowseFunc = BrowseFunc & ",'W=" & Width1 & "p,H=" & Height1 & "p'"
	BrowseFunc = BrowseFunc & "," & ColStr
	BrowseFunc = BrowseFunc & ")"
	BrowseFunc = Replace(BrowseFunc, "'", """")

	FieldDef.F2Fnc = BrowseFunc
	Tbl.SetFieldProperties1 AlanAdi,FieldDef		
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
Set KTT_ENT_B = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_ENT_B")
Set KTT_ENT_T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_ENT_T")

Kod : 
Sub Makro1()
	Set KTT_T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DBG0T")
	Set KTT_E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DBG0E")
	KTT_E.EVRAKTABLO = "1"
	KTT_T.SetMustEnter "KOLONNO","E"
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub ExceldenAktar
	Set KTT_E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DBG0E")
	Set KTT_T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DBG0T")
		
	KTT_T.SafePack

	DosyaYolu = Trim(KTT_E.DOSYA)
	TumAlanlariDoluKolonNo = Trim(KTT_E.DOLUKOLON)
	BilgiBaslangicSatiri = KTT_E.STARTROW
	UygulamaKodu = Trim(KTT_E.UYGULAMA) 
	BaglananTablo = Trim(KTT_E.BAGTABLO) 
	TestSatirSayisi = KTT_E.TESTSAYISI
	EvrakTabloSecimi = KTT_E.EVRAKTABLO
	
	Set KTTDBG0T = Doc.Select2("dsasf", "KTT_DBG0T", "EVRAKKOD='*'", "", -1)
	
	If EvrakTabloSecimi = "2" Then
		If KTTDBG0T.GetRecCount = 0 Then
			Msgbox "EVRAKKOD Alanýnda STOKXXE gibi EVRAK TABLO ADI Girilmelidir."
			Exit Sub
		End If
		
		If KTTDBG0T.GetRecCount > 1 Then
			Msgbox "Birden Fazla EVRAKKOD Alanýna Giriþ Yapýlmýþ. Tek Olmalý."
			Exit Sub
		End If		
	End If
	
	If TumAlanlariDoluKolonNo = "" Then
		Msgbox "Tüm Satýrlarý Dolu Kolon No Alaný Dolu Olmalýdýr..."
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	
	If Not fso.FileExists(DosyaYolu) Then
		Msgbox DosyaYolu & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Dosya Bulunamadý...."
		Exit Sub
	End If		
	
	If BilgiBaslangicSatiri = "" Then
		Msgbox "Bilgi Baþlangýç Satýr Numarasý Zorunludur..."
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	KayitSayisi = KTT_T.GetRecCount
	
	If KayitSayisi = 0 Then Exit Sub

	Redim KolonNo(KayitSayisi) 
	Redim KolonTipi(KayitSayisi)
	Redim BaglananAlan(KayitSayisi)
	
	Set Excel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb = Excel.Workbooks.Open(DosyaYolu)
	Set Sheet = Wb.ActiveSheet
	Set Sh1 = Wb.Sheets(1)

	SonSatir = Sheet.Cells(Sheet.Rows.Count,TumAlanlariDoluKolonNo).End(-4162).row

	If SonSatir = 0 Then
		Msgbox "Aktarýlacak Satýr Bulunamadý..."
		Exit Sub
	End If
			
	ToplamAktarilacakKayitSayisi = SonSatir - (BilgiBaslangicSatiri-1)
	
	If TestSatirSayisi > 0 Then
		If TestSatirSayisi > ToplamAktarilacakKayitSayisi Then
			Msgbox "Test Satýr Sayýsý, Aktarýlacak Satýr Sayýsýndan Fazla. Test Satýr Deðerini Azaltýn..."
			Exit Sub
		Else
			SonSatir = TestSatirSayisi
		End If
	Else
		SonSatir = Sheet.Cells(Sheet.Rows.Count,TumAlanlariDoluKolonNo).End(-4162).row - (BilgiBaslangicSatiri+1)
	End If
	
	k = Doc.d7MsgBox(SonSatir & " Satýr Excelden Aktarýlacak. Onaylýyor musunuz ?", "Freedom", MB_YESNO)
	if k<>6 Then Exit Sub	
	
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI(UygulamaKodu, "")
	Set KTTTable = Doc1.GetTableObject(BaglananTablo)
	Set KTTLRNS = Doc1.GetTableObject("KTT_LISTLEARNS")
	
	For j = BilgiBaslangicSatiri To SonSatir + (BilgiBaslangicSatiri+1)
		If EvrakTabloSecimi = "1" Then
			Doc1.New_Voucher
		Else
			Doc.StatusBarMessage "Excelden Aktarýlýyor...... :  " & j & " / " & SonSatir 

			For i = 1 To KayitSayisi
				KolonNo(i-1) = Trim(KTT_T.KOLONNO(i))
				KolonTipi(i-1) = Trim(KTT_T.KOLONTIPI(i))
				BaglananAlan(i-1) = Trim(KTT_T.BAGLANANA(i))
				
				Deger = Trim(Sh1.Range(KolonNo(i-1)&j))
				
				If KolonTipi(i-1) = "D" Then
				 Deger = Getd7RevDate(Deger)
				End If
				
				If KolonTipi(i-1) = "V" or KolonTipi(i-1) = "T" Then
				 'Deger = UCASE(Deger)
				End If

				'uzun yazýlarý satýr satýr yazdýrmak için
				If Trim(KolonNo(i-1)) = "K" OR Trim(KolonNo(i-1)) = "I" OR Trim(KolonNo(i-1)) = "J" Then
					Deger = Replace(Deger, "   ", "")
					Deger = Replace(Deger, "  ", "")
					Deger = SplitString(Deger, 160)
				End If

				KTTTable.SetFieldValue BaglananAlan(i-1), -1, Deger
		
				'Evrak içindeki Tabloya yazdýrma seçiliyse
				If Trim(BaglananAlan(i-1)) = "EVRAKNO" Or Trim(BaglananAlan(i-1)) = "KOD" Then	
					Doc1.Load_Voucher Deger
				ElseIf Trim(BaglananAlan(i-1)) = "STOKKOD" Then
					KTTLRNS.Empty
					SatirNo = KTTLRNS.Addrow
					KTTLRNS.SetCurrentRow(SatirNo)
					KTTLRNS.STOKKOD = Deger
					Doc1.Save_Voucher
					Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
				End If
			Next
		End If
		
		If doc.ErrorNumber Then
			MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
			Exit Sub
		End If	
		
		'Doc1.Save_Voucher
		'Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
	Next

	Wb.Close
	Excel.Quit
	Set Excel = Nothing	
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function SplitString(strMain, SplitWidth)
   If SplitWidth <= 0 Then
      SplitWidth = 1 '-- you may want to raise an error here
   End If
   
   If Len(strMain) > 0 Then
      n = (Len(strMain) - 1) \ SplitWidth
 
      If n > 0 Then
					ReDim arTemp(n) 
					For i = 0 To n
						arTemp(i) = Mid(strMain, i * SplitWidth + 1, SplitWidth)
					Next
					
					For each Baslik in arTemp
						HTMLStr = HTMLStr & Baslik & vbcrlf
					Next
				End If
   Else 
      ReDim arTemp(0) 
      HTMLStr = "" 
   End If
		
		SplitString = HTMLStr
   'msgbox SplitString
End Function
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function Getd7RevDate(Tarih)
	Getd7RevDate = Year(Tarih) & "/" & Right("0" & Month(Tarih), 2) & "/" & Right("0" & Day(Tarih), 2)
End Function

Sub EDI_DOSYA_ICERIGINI_OKU(TmpDosyaAdi)
	Set wshShell = CreateObject("WSCript.shell")
	wshshell.run "notepad " & TmpDosyaAdi, 1, True
	set wshshell = nothing
End Sub
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub FtpyeGonder
		Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
		Set S60E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60E")
		
		TmpDosyaAdi = Trim(MTable.DOSYAYOLU)
		DosyaAdi = Trim(MTable.DOSYAADI)
		RemotePath = Trim(MTable.REMOTEPATH)
		FtpServer = Trim(MTable.FTPSERVER)
		
		GrupKodu1 = Trim(S60E.GK_1)	
		If GrupKodu1 = "TEST" Then
			'Gönderilecek EDÝ dosyasýný okutmak için
			Msgbox "Sadece EDI' ye Gönderilecek Dosyayý Görmek Ýçindir. " & vbcrlf & "FTP' ye Dosya Gönderilmeyecektir..."
			Call EDI_DOSYA_ICERIGINI_OKU(TmpDosyaAdi)
			Exit Sub
		End If
	
		FtpYanit= FtpSendFile(TmpDosyaAdi, RemotePath)

		If FtpYanit=0 Then 
			k = Doc.d7msgbox("FTP Sitesine Dosya Yazdýrýlmýþtýr.", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
			S60E.NOTES_1="ELEKTRONIK HAT (EDI) ILE GONDERILMISTIR"
			S60E.GK_1="ASN_OK"
			nret = Doc.Save_Voucher
			
			If nret <> 0 Then
				k = doc.d7MsgBox("Evrak Kaydedilemedi. Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir","Freedom ERP", MB_OK)
				Exit Sub
			End If
			Doc.RUN_APP_CANCEL
		Else
			k = Doc.d7msgbox("HATA!!!" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "FTP Sitesine dosya yazdýrýlamamýþtýr." & "Lütfen Tekrar Deneyiniz.", "FreedomERP",MB_OK)
		End If
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function FtpSendFile(local_path, RemotePath)
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Dosya Gönderiliyor..."
	
	Set par = Doc.CreateSobject("Parameters")

	ServerName = "ftp://ftp.map.com.tr"
	FtpUsername = "cavo"
	FtpPassword = "c4v0%1234"

	FtpSendFile = Doc.FtpPutFile(ServerName, FtpUsername, FtpPassword, local_path, RemotePath, par)
End Function
